name: Siteinspire
best_for: Long-running, restrained editorial curation (10,000+ sites since 2008); best for typographic, editorial and studio sites with staying power, and the only big gallery with a public no-auth MCP server
how_to_use: In a browser, browse /websites and combine Styles, Types and Subjects filters; agents use the read-only MCP (search_sites for free text, all_categories then list_websites for one category, explore_websites for 2-3 category intersections)
zh: 克制耐看的网站画廊（2008 年起 1 万+ 站），偏字体与编辑排版；另有免登录的只读 MCP，智能体可直接检索。
zh_how: 人工浏览用 /websites 叠加风格、类型、题材筛选；智能体接入 MCP：自由文本用 search_sites，单一分类先 all_categories 再 list_websites，2-3 个分类交集用 explore_websites。
caveats: Pages and the REST API answer plain fetches with a Vercel Security Checkpoint (429, checked 2026-09-27); the MCP endpoint and llms.txt respond
Screenshots and descriptions are Siteinspire's copyright; the index may be used for non-commercial research with attribution

name: A1 Gallery
best_for: Broad, well-tagged curation of current sites, each broken into interior pages and sections with a measured colour palette, type stack and spacing
how_to_use: Browse /type/<landing|portfolio|shop>, /category/<ai|finance|technology>, /style/<dark|minimal|big-type> or /technology/<framer|webflow|next-js>; use /sections and /pages for one section or page type; agents connect the MCP for JSON with measured design tokens
zh: 标签齐全的当代网站画廊，每站拆成内页与区块并附实测配色、字体与间距；另有 MCP 供智能体取结构化数据。
zh_how: 按 /type、/category、/style、/technology 路径筛；只看某类区块或页面走 /sections、/pages；智能体用免费账号 OAuth 接入 MCP（每天 50 次）。
caveats: The MCP needs OAuth against a free A1 account: 50 requests a day, Pro raises it to 2,000

name: Recent Design
best_for: Daily human-curated design inspiration and the successor of Godly (godly.website redirected here, checked 2026-09-27): websites by category plus OG images, App Store screenshots, app icons and a ranked list of design agent skills
how_to_use: Start at /websites and filter by category (AI, SaaS, Portfolio, Ecommerce, Agency); /og-images and /app-icons for those formats; /skills ranks design skills by installs
zh: 每日人工策展的灵感站，Godly 的继承者；除分类网站外还收 OG 图、应用商店截图、应用图标，并有按安装量排的设计 skills 榜。
caveats: Curation follows current fashion: date what you take

name: Minimal Gallery
best_for: Minimal websites: whitespace, type-led layouts, quiet palettes
how_to_use: Category filters in the header (portfolio, agency, e-commerce, etc.)
zh: 极简网站灵感库，专收留白、字体主导的安静页面；找低饱和、排版驱动的参考时按分类筛选。
caveats: SiteGround bot check ("One moment, please...") blocks scripts and headless browsers

name: Httpster
best_for: Eclectic, personality-rich sites; a counterweight to SaaS sameness
how_to_use: Filter by /type/<industry>/ (29 types) or /style/<colourful|brutalist|dark|fullscreen>/; open the live site before borrowing a layout, captures flatten motion and type rendering
zh: 收录风格各异、有性格的网站画廊，专门对冲 SaaS 同质化；想跳出模板感时按类型翻找。

name: Hover States
best_for: Alternative and experimental web design where interaction is the idea
how_to_use: Watch the capture videos; open the site for the real behaviour
zh: 收录以交互为创意的实验性网站画廊，先看录屏短片筛选，再打开原站体验真实行为。

name: Klikkentheke
best_for: Websites by and for graphic designers: type-driven, cultural, anti-template
how_to_use: Use when a brief asks for editorial or art-school energy
zh: 收录平面设计师自己做、给同行看的网站，字体驱动、反模板；brief 要编辑感或艺术学院气质时翻它。
caveats: SiteGround bot check ("One moment, please...") blocks scripts

name: Curated Design
best_for: Clean multi-category gallery with consistent full-page captures
how_to_use: Filter /inspiration/ by style or industry, or use /sections/ for one section type; every card clicks straight through to the live site
zh: 分类齐整的网站画廊，全页截图规格统一；适合按类目快速横向扫一遍找方向。

name: Seesaw
best_for: Fast-moving curation of new sites, tagged by type, style and even typeface
how_to_use: Use /category/<ai|agency|crypto|design…> and the tag filters (typeface, framework) to find live sites that use a given font or stack
zh: 更新快的新站收录，标签细到风格、字体和框架；想找用某种字体的真实网站时来这里筛。

name: Best Website Gallery
best_for: One curator's long-running pick of quality sites with colour and tag filters
how_to_use: Use /sites with the colour, tag and country filters (e.g. /sites/country/switzerland); the daily pick archive lives under /sites/sotd/
zh: 一位策展人长期维护的优质网站选集，可按颜色和标签筛选；找特定色调或门类的参考时用。

name: Maxibestof
best_for: Opinionated library of studio and portfolio sites plus the sections they are built from (hundreds of heroes, footers and feature blocks) and the fonts they use
how_to_use: Use /sections/<hero|feature|pricing|footer…> for one section type and /typefaces for fonts in use with pairings; llms.txt lists every catalogue URL
zh: 偏工作室与作品集的网站库，另拆出区块库（数百个 hero、页脚、功能区）与在用字体库；查单一区块或字体搭配时用。
caveats: The homepage answers scripts with a Cloudflare challenge (403, 2026-09-27); /sections and llms.txt were readable

name: Siiimple
best_for: Minimalist sites archive; useful second source after Minimal Gallery
how_to_use: Browse /category/<type>/ (60+ categories such as application, architecture, art-gallery) when Minimal Gallery has too few examples in a vertical
zh: 极简主义网站档案馆，按分类浏览；找简约风格时当 Minimal Gallery 之外的第二来源用。

name: Web Design Museum
best_for: History of web design 1991-2006; reference for retro, Y2K and early-web aesthetics
how_to_use: Browse by year or by site timeline
zh: 1991–2006 年网页设计史档案馆，可按年份或站点时间线浏览；做复古、Y2K 或早期互联网美学时来取证。
caveats: Cloudflare challenge for scripts (403, 2026-09-27): open in a browser

name: The Whimsical Web
best_for: Curated list of personal and small sites with an extra bit of fun; a direct antidote to templated SaaS pages
how_to_use: Use when a brief asks for personality or delight; take one quirky interaction per site, not the whole look
zh: 收录有趣、有个性的个人小站；想给产品加点“人味”和惊喜时挑一个有趣的交互来学，别照搬整站。

name: One Page Love
best_for: 9,000+ human-curated one-page sites and landing pages since 2008, each with a full-length screenshot, a written review and tags for genre, style, platform, typeface and page sections
how_to_use: Use /genre/<landing-page|saas|portfolio>, /sections for one section type and typeface pages to see a font in use; agents add the free no-key MCP and ask for e.g. "3 pricing-table examples"
zh: 2008 年起人工精选的单页站与落地页（9000+），每站有整页截图、点评和体裁、风格、平台、字体、区块标签；另有免费免密钥 MCP。
zh_how: 按 /genre/<体裁>、/sections 区块、字体页筛；智能体接入 https://api.onepagelove.com/mcp，直接问“给我 3 个定价表示例”。
caveats: Curated by founder Rob Hope from 2008 to 2026, then by new owner Piet Terheyden
The JSON API is in private beta; the MCP is free and rate-limited by IP

name: Land-book
best_for: Largest well-filtered landing-page gallery, updated daily, with a section library (hero, features, pricing, FAQ, CTA, footer…) cropped from featured sites
how_to_use: Browse /design/landing-page, /design/portfolio or /design/ecommerce, and /sections/<hero|pricing|faq|footer> for one section type; /motion collects animated sites
zh: 筛选最细、每日更新的落地页画廊，另有从入选站点裁出的区块库（hero、定价、FAQ、CTA、页脚）；做营销页时的主力参考。
caveats: Cloudflare challenge for scripts and agents (403, 2026-09-27); open in a browser
Also sells Webflow and Framer templates: judge the gallery, not the store

name: Lapa Ninja
best_for: Landing pages with full-page screenshots, grouped by industry and by colour
how_to_use: Use /category/<industry>/ pages; full-length captures show section order
zh: 落地页截图库，整页长图能看出区块顺序；按行业和配色分组，写 landing page 结构前先翻。
caveats: Cloudflare challenge for scripts (403, 2026-09-27): open in a browser

name: SaaS Landing Page
best_for: SaaS-only landing pages, also sliced by page type (pricing, features, about)
how_to_use: Filter by page type to compare one kind of page across products
zh: 只收 SaaS 落地页的图库，可按定价、功能、关于等页面类型筛选，横向对比同类页面的做法。
caveats: SiteGround bot check ("One moment, please...") blocks scripts

name: Saaspo
best_for: SaaS sites indexed by page type, section type, style and stack
how_to_use: Go straight to a section type (hero, pricing, testimonials, footer)
zh: SaaS 站点库，按页面、区块类型与风格索引；写 hero、定价、页脚时直接查对应区块。
caveats: Cloudflare challenge for scripts (403, 2026-09-27): open in a browser

name: Landingfolio
best_for: Landing pages plus a component-level view (hero, pricing, FAQ, CTA); templates are paid
how_to_use: Use /inspiration/<landing-page|pricing|about|login> and the components view to compare one section; agents connect the MCP (free account token) to pull real screenshots while building
zh: 落地页灵感库，可按 hero、定价、FAQ、CTA 等组件拆开对比；灵感页免费，模板付费。
caveats: Templates and the component library are paid; the inspiration pages are free

name: Landing Love
best_for: Landing pages chosen for their motion, shown as video captures
how_to_use: Filter /categories/, /style/ and /collection/<gsap|webgl|threejs>/ (or /platform/<webflow|framer>/) and watch the full-page video for scroll and load choreography
zh: 专收动效出色的落地页，以视频录屏展示；滚动与加载编排是关键时来这里看。

name: LP Archive (LPアーカイブ)
best_for: 46,000+ Japanese landing pages (LP), updated daily and searchable by industry, colour and taste
how_to_use: Filter by colour (/lp-archive/search?lp_color=1) or industry to study the dense, vertical Japanese LP genre; do not transplant it unchanged to Western audiences
zh: 4.6 万+ 日本长落地页（LP），每日更新，可按行业、颜色、调性筛；研究日式竖长营销页，但别原样搬给欧美用户。

name: Really Good Emails
best_for: The reference for email design, with code view per email
how_to_use: Browse /categories (welcome, receipt, newsletter, promotional…) or search by brand; every email has a code view to inspect the HTML
zh: 邮件设计的标杆参考，按场景分类且每封附 HTML 源码；做 onboarding、收据、newsletter 邮件时查它。

name: Navbar Gallery
best_for: Navigation only: navbars, mega menus, dropdowns, sidebars, mobile menus
how_to_use: Filter /type/<static|dropdowns|mega-menu|side-bar>; compare how sites fit many links plus a CTA and how the menu collapses on mobile
zh: 只收导航：导航栏、超级菜单、下拉、侧边栏和移动端菜单；链接多又带 CTA 时来这里对照。

name: Supahero
best_for: Hero sections only, a focused library of above-the-fold compositions
how_to_use: Scan for hero strategy (product shot, typographic, video, interactive) before choosing one
zh: 只收 Hero 首屏的专门库；定首屏策略（产品图、大字排版、视频、交互）之前先扫一遍。

name: Bento Grids
best_for: Bento-grid layouts collected from real sites
how_to_use: Reference for module sizing and rhythm when a bento section is justified
zh: 真实网站的 bento 网格布局合集，风潮已过；确定要用时再参考它的模块尺寸与节奏。
caveats: Bento sections became a 2023-24 template tell; use only when the content really is a set of unequal modules

name: Footer
best_for: Footers only: sitemap structure, legal, newsletter, big-type sign-offs
how_to_use: Filter /styles/<typographic|small-type|illustrative|grid> to compare sitemap depth, legal rows and big-type sign-offs
zh: 只收页脚的灵感站，看导航结构、法律信息、newsletter 与收尾大字排版的做法。

name: CTA Gallery
best_for: Call-to-action sections and buttons from real sites
how_to_use: Use /categories/<button|form|download|call-to-buy> to compare closing CTAs; judge copy and layout together
zh: 真实网站的 CTA 区块与按钮合集；打磨收尾段时对照别人的构图和文案写法。

name: Pricing Pages
best_for: Pricing pages and plan tables
how_to_use: Compare plan count, the recommended-plan emphasis and toggle patterns
zh: 定价页与方案表的专项画廊；对比方案数量、推荐方案的强调手法和切换开关的样式。

name: 404s
best_for: 404 pages: a good source for brand voice in error and empty states
how_to_use: Open /sites/<name> pages to judge tone and whether the error page still offers search or a way back
zh: 404 页面合集，错误页和空状态是品牌语气露脸的地方；找文案调性和插画路子时刷一遍。

name: Email Love
best_for: Curated email designs and components, tagged by type and brand
how_to_use: Filter by email type and brand when Really Good Emails lacks a category
zh: 按类型与品牌标签整理的邮件设计精选库；做邮件模板时翻，Really Good Emails 之外的第二来源。
caveats: Cloudflare challenge for scripts (403, 2026-09-27): open in a browser

name: Unsection
best_for: Section-first gallery (5,000+ sites) filterable by hero, features, pricing, FAQ, testimonials, team, footer and more
how_to_use: Open /category/<hero|feature|testimonial|cta|pricing>-section-design and compare ten solutions to the same section side by side
zh: 按区块分类的网站画廊（首屏、功能、定价、FAQ、页脚等，5000+ 站）；只纠结某一个区块时横向对比十个同类解法。

name: SANKOU!
best_for: Japanese web gallery with fine-grained filters; the closest high-quality reference for CJK typographic layout
how_to_use: Filter /category/<…>/ (191 categories: industry, page type, colour, layout, tool such as Framer or STUDIO) or /popular-sites/; credits name the studio, so follow good work to its makers
zh: 日本网站画廊，行业、页面、颜色、版式筛选很细；做中文排版时最接近的高质量参照。
zh_how: 按 /category/<分类>/ 筛（191 个分类：行业、页面类型、颜色、版式、Framer/STUDIO 等工具），或看 /popular-sites/；每站附制作方，顺藤摸瓜找好团队。

name: Dark Mode Design
best_for: Dark-themed sites only; study surface layering and accent restraint in dark UI
how_to_use: Open the live sites to read actual surface values
zh: 只收深色主题网站，研究暗色界面的表面层级与克制的强调色；要打开原站读真实色值。

name: Brutalist Websites
best_for: Web brutalism archive with short designer interviews
how_to_use: Reference for raw, anti-polish directions
zh: 粗野主义网站档案，附设计师短访谈；要做生糙、反精致的方向时来这里找参照。

name: Commerce Cream
best_for: Best-looking e-commerce storefronts, mostly Shopify
how_to_use: Browse by page type (home, product, collection, cart) to see storefront patterns under real Shopify constraints
zh: 好看电商店面的画廊，多为 Shopify；用来研究真实约束下的商品页与购物车模式。
caveats: Unreachable from our probe network on 2026-09-27 (TLS reset); search engines still index it, confirm in a browser

name: Ecomm.design
best_for: E-commerce sites filterable by platform, category and tech stack
how_to_use: Filter by platform (/platform/shopify-stores/, squarespace, bigcommerce) and by vertical; skip the agency and tool upsell pages
zh: 电商网站灵感库，可按平台、品类和技术栈筛选；做时尚、食品、美妆等垂直电商时按类目翻。

name: Bestfolios
best_for: Designer portfolios, case studies and resumes
how_to_use: Use for portfolio structure and case-study storytelling
zh: 设计师作品集、案例研究与简历的精选库；搭作品集结构、学案例叙事时参考。

name: personalsit.es
best_for: Directory of personal sites; human, idiosyncratic web design
how_to_use: Hit /random a few times, or /with-feed for sites that publish RSS; skim for non-commercial layout ideas
zh: 个人网站目录，全是不商业、有个性的排版与布局；想找非商业版式灵感时随手翻。

name: MUUUUU.ORG
best_for: Japanese long-scroll sites curated for craft
how_to_use: Filter by industry, colour, site type and expression (e.g. /category/interaction/page-transition); the daily SOTD carries production credits
zh: 日本长滚动网站精选，以工艺见长；研究纵向节奏和日英混排字体时的第一站。

name: 81-web.com
best_for: Japanese web design gallery with category and colour filters
how_to_use: Filter by category and colour; use when SANKOU! and MUUUUU.ORG lack the industry you need
zh: 日本网页设计画廊，可按类目与颜色筛选；CJK 排版参考的第二来源。

name: Responsive Web Design JP
best_for: Shows each site at desktop, tablet and phone widths side by side
how_to_use: Use /layout, /type and /technique to study how a composition re-arranges across desktop, tablet and phone
zh: 日本网站三端同屏展示，桌面、平板、手机排版并排对照；研究跨断点重排构图时用它。

name: Made in Webflow
best_for: Community showcase with cloneable projects; uneven quality, good for interaction mechanics
how_to_use: Filter to cloneables to inspect how an effect is built
zh: Webflow 社区作品库，含可克隆项目；质量参差，主要用来拆开看交互效果的实现方式。

name: Framer Gallery
best_for: Sites built in Framer; shows what is fashionable in the no-code design crowd
how_to_use: Filter by category and style to see what the no-code design crowd ships now
zh: Framer 官方作品画廊，反映无代码圈当下的流行风向；当趋势指标看，别当标准。
caveats: A trend indicator, not a standard

name: I/O 3000
best_for: Long-running Japanese gallery of domestic and overseas sites with category, tag and colour filters
how_to_use: Use /category/colors/ and the tags for Japanese corporate and recruiting sites; compare CJK headline sizes and line lengths
zh: 老牌日本网站画廊，可按类目、标签和颜色筛；看日企官网、招聘站的中日文标题字号与行长。

name: Web Design Clip
best_for: 6,000+ Japanese sites filterable by industry (company, recruit, estate…) and build tag (WordPress, Shopify, Next.js)
how_to_use: Filter /category/<industry>/ and /tag/<stack>/ to compare how Japanese sites set dense CJK content
zh: 收录 6000+ 日本网站，可按行业（企业、招聘、地产…）与技术标签筛；对比日本站点如何排布密集的中日文内容。

name: S5-Style
best_for: Japanese gallery of high-quality corporate, recruiting and service sites
how_to_use: Use as a third Japanese source after SANKOU! and MUUUUU.ORG when judging typographic refinement in CJK
zh: 高品质日本网站画廊，企业官网、招聘站、服务站居多；判断中日文排版精致度时的第三参考。

name: Korea Web Design
best_for: Curated Korean websites with separate desktop and mobile picks; the best public reference for Hangul typographic layout
how_to_use: Compare /site/ and /mobile-site/ picks; check Hangul headline scale and line-height against Japanese and Chinese sites before setting CJK type
zh: 精选韩国网站，桌面与移动分开收录；研究韩文排版最好的公开参考，定 CJK 字号行高前与中日站点对照。

name: Awwwards
best_for: Jury-scored showcase of ambitious web work; strongest for motion, WebGL and art direction
how_to_use: Use Sites of the Day, /websites/<category>/ and the Collections (transitions, scrolling, microinteractions); read the jury scores critically
zh: 网页设计奖项站点，看动效与视觉的野心天花板；评审不管可用性与转化，只当野心参考。
caveats: Juries reward spectacle; usability, accessibility and conversion are not judged

name: The FWA
best_for: Long-running award for cutting-edge digital experiences
how_to_use: Use for immersive and campaign-style references
zh: 老牌数字体验奖项，偏实验与沉浸式；做活动站或 campaign 类项目时来找前沿参照。
caveats: JavaScript-only site: plain fetches get an empty shell

name: CSS Design Awards
best_for: Award gallery scored on UI, UX and innovation
how_to_use: Browse /wotd-award-winners and read the separate UI, UX and innovation scores on each site page; use as a second jury after Awwwards
zh: 按 UI、UX 与创新三个维度打分的设计奖项站；拿它做 Awwwards 之外的第二意见。

name: The Webby Awards gallery
best_for: Searchable gallery of Webby winners and nominees across websites, apps, social, video and AI categories
how_to_use: Start at /winners/websites-and-mobile-sites and narrow by year and category to see what the industry rewarded; open the live work, not the thumbnail
zh: Webby 奖获奖与提名作品库，覆盖网站、应用、社媒、视频与 AI 类别；按年份和类别看业界奖励了什么。
caveats: Academy juries plus a public People's Voice vote: big-brand campaigns dominate and usability is not judged

name: GDWEB Design Awards
best_for: Korean web design award and gallery that local agencies use as a practical reference for corporate and brand sites
how_to_use: Browse the WEB selections (/sub/list.asp) for Korean corporate sites; pair with Korea Web Design for Hangul layout
zh: 韩国网页设计奖与作品库（지디웹），本地代理商常用的企业与品牌站参考；看韩文企业站时与 Korea Web Design 对照。
caveats: Old ASP site, Korean only

name: Marketing Examples
best_for: Short, concrete teardowns of copy, landing pages and conversion tactics
how_to_use: Read the copywriting and landing-page sections before writing a hero
zh: 营销拆解博客，用短篇幅分析文案、落地页和转化手法；动笔写 hero 区标题前先读几篇。

name: Julian Shapiro: Landing Pages
best_for: The clearest handbook on landing-page structure: hero, social proof, features, objections, CTA
how_to_use: Read once; use as the checklist for page narrative
zh: 讲落地页结构最清楚的指南：Hero、社会证明、特性、异议、CTA；当页面叙事的检查清单用。

name: Demand Curve: The Frontier library
best_for: Growth playbooks including above-the-fold and landing-page teardowns
how_to_use: Use the above-the-fold playbook when drafting a hero
zh: 增长团队的实操 playbook 合集，含首屏与落地页拆解；起草 hero 区前先看首屏那一篇。

name: GoodUI
best_for: UI patterns backed by A/B test results, including ones that lost
how_to_use: Look up a pattern in /patterns/ and its test results before arguing for it; /leaks/ shows A/B tests spotted on big products
zh: 带 A/B 测试结果的 UI 模式库，连输掉的方案也公开；提案前先查它有没有证据。
caveats: Full test details sit behind the paid membership

name: Swipe File
best_for: Large swipe file of ads, landing pages and copy with commentary
how_to_use: Browse /categories (ads, pricing structures, sales pages, before-and-after) when stuck on messaging; the notes explain why a swipe works
zh: 广告、落地页与文案的大型 swipe file，附点评；卡在文案表达时按格式检索。

name: Mailchimp Content Style Guide
best_for: Public content style guide: writing principles, voice and tone, grammar, web elements, email, social and accessible writing
how_to_use: Adopt its voice-and-tone and web-elements pages as default copy rules for buttons, errors and headings; the Markdown source is on GitHub
zh: Mailchimp 公开的内容风格指南：写作原则、语气语调、语法、网页元素、邮件与社媒写法；按钮、报错、标题文案的默认规则。

name: Mobbin
best_for: Largest library of real app screens and flows across iOS, Android and web, searchable by screen type, UI element and flow
how_to_use: Pick the platform (iOS, Android, Web), then search Screens, UI Elements or Flows by pattern name (paywall, empty state, onboarding, checkout); open an app to see its full flow in order. Agents can query the same library through the Mobbin MCP (see mobbin-mcp).
zh: 真实 App 界面与流程的最大图库，按页面类型、组件和流程检索；免费额度少且需登录。
zh_how: 先选平台（iOS、Android、Web），再按模式名搜索界面、组件或流程（付费墙、空状态、引导、结账）；点进某个 App 可按顺序看完整流程。agent 可通过 Mobbin MCP 检索同一资料库。
caveats: The free tier shows a small sample and needs sign-in; most screens and all flows need a paid plan.

name: Refero
best_for: Real product screens for web apps and iOS, searchable by page type, pattern and element; strong for SaaS
how_to_use: Search a page type or pattern (billing, empty state, data table, command palette, settings) and filter Web or iOS; compare three products before drawing. Its sister site Refero Styles holds extracted DESIGN.md files (see refero-styles).
zh: 真实产品的网页与 iOS 界面截图库，按页面类型、模式、元素可搜；做 SaaS 界面先搜它，部分内容需付费。
zh_how: 搜索页面类型或模式（账单、空状态、数据表、命令面板、设置），筛选 Web 或 iOS；动笔前先对比三个产品的做法。姊妹站 Refero Styles 提供提取好的 DESIGN.md。
caveats: Sign-in and a paid plan are needed beyond a partial preview; the page is JavaScript-rendered for agents.

name: Page Flows
best_for: Recorded user flows (video plus annotated screenshots) for onboarding, upgrading, cancelling and more
how_to_use: Mostly paywalled; use when the sequence, not a screen, is the question
zh: 录屏加标注的真实用户流程库，覆盖引导、升级、退订；问题是流程顺序而非单屏时查，多为付费。
caveats: Mostly paywalled.
screenlane.com now redirects here (checked 2026-09-27), so Screenlane is not a separate source.

name: Nicelydone
best_for: SaaS web-app screens and flows sorted by component and page
how_to_use: Browse by page (dashboard, settings, onboarding, billing) or by component; each entry links the live product so you can check the current state.
zh: 按页面和组件整理的 SaaS 产品截图库，做仪表盘、设置页、引导流程时直接翻。
caveats: Cloudflare challenge for agents (403 on 2026-09-27); open it in a real browser.

name: SaaSFrame
best_for: SaaS UI by category: dashboards, settings, modals, tables, emails, plus landing pages
how_to_use: Use the category index; part of the library is behind a paid plan
zh: 按类目整理 SaaS 界面：仪表盘、设置、弹窗、表格、邮件加落地页；部分库内容需付费。

name: UI Notes
best_for: Screens and flows of Chinese apps; the closest equivalent to Mobbin for the domestic market
how_to_use: Browse by app or by pattern (登录, 首页, 搜索, 个人中心, 支付) to see what mainland users already expect, including mini-program versions; pair with Mobbin for the global equivalent.
zh: 收录国内应用的界面与流程截图，相当于本土版 Mobbin；用来看国内用户习惯的模式。
zh_how: 按 App 或按模式（登录、首页、搜索、个人中心、支付）浏览，看国内用户已经习惯的做法，含小程序版本；需要海外对照时配合 Mobbin。

name: ScreensDesign
best_for: Mobile app flows as videos with onboarding and paywall focus
how_to_use: Use for subscription-app onboarding and paywall sequences; /store-screenshots/ holds App Store screenshot designs (it absorbed Scrnshts)
zh: 移动端流程录屏库，主打订阅制 App 的引导页和付费墙；另收 App Store 截图设计。
caveats: designvault.io now redirects here (checked 2026-09-27).

name: Paywall Screens
best_for: Paywall screens from subscription apps
how_to_use: Compare plan layout, trial framing and legal text placement
zh: 订阅制 App 付费墙截图库；比较套餐布局、试用话术与法务文案摆放位置时用。

name: Really Good UX
best_for: Annotated examples of good product UX moments, strongest on onboarding and activation
how_to_use: Filter by pattern; each example explains why it works
zh: 带批注的产品 UX 案例库，引导与激活类最强；按模式筛选，每条都解释为什么好。

name: UserOnboard
best_for: Step-by-step onboarding teardowns with commentary
how_to_use: Read one teardown before designing a first-run experience
zh: 各家产品新手引导的逐屏拆解加点评，做首次启动体验前先读一两篇找反面教材。

name: Collect UI
best_for: Concept shots grouped by component or screen type; pretty but unshipped - check against real-product libraries
how_to_use: Use only for visual treatment ideas
zh: 按组件归类的概念稿合集，好看但大多没上线；只取视觉处理灵感，别当落地依据。
caveats: Concept shots from Dribbble-style challenges, mostly never shipped; do not treat them as evidence of a working pattern.

name: Deceptive Patterns
best_for: Taxonomy and hall of shame of manipulative patterns, with legal cases
how_to_use: Check a growth idea against the Types list (confirmshaming, sneaking, obstruction and the rest) and the Laws and cases pages before shipping it.
zh: 暗黑模式的分类学与耻辱柱，附法律案例；增长点子上线前先对照类型表查一遍。

name: The Component Gallery
best_for: Every common UI component with its names and implementations across dozens of design systems, linked to their docs and code
how_to_use: Open /components/<name> (for example /components/accordion) to compare names, anatomy and behaviour across systems, each linked to its docs and code; /design-systems lists the sources.
zh: 组件横向对照表，同一个组件在几十个设计系统里的命名、结构和实现并排可查。

name: Checklist Design
best_for: Checklists of what a component, page or flow must include
how_to_use: Open the checklist for the component, page or flow you are about to hand off (for example login, pricing page, table) and tick each item against the design; missing states are the usual gap.
zh: 组件、页面、流程各自该包含什么的清单库；交付前拿对应清单逐项核对，防漏项。

name: UI Guideline
best_for: Component standards synthesised from many design systems: anatomy, properties, states
how_to_use: Open a component to see its anatomy, properties and states synthesised from several systems; copy the state list into the spec so none is forgotten.
zh: 汇总各大设计系统的组件规范，讲清部件结构、属性与状态；命名和列状态时来查。

name: Open UI
best_for: W3C community research on component anatomy, naming and behaviour across systems
how_to_use: Use the research pages per component (select, popover, tabs) for anatomy names and the cross-system comparison before naming parts or states in a spec; proposals here often become HTML features (popover, customizable select).
zh: W3C 社区的组件解剖研究，横向对比各系统的命名与行为；给部件和状态起名时查它的矩阵。

name: UI Playbook
best_for: Documented collection of component best practices
how_to_use: Quick reminder of do and don't per component
zh: 组件最佳实践速查，按组件列出该做和不该做；画稿前花两分钟过一遍避免低级错误。

name: UX Patterns for Developers
best_for: 90+ UI patterns, each documented with anatomy, best practices, accessibility and testing, framework-agnostic, with an MCP server and llms.txt for agents
how_to_use: Before building a pattern you have not specified (combobox, infinite scroll, date input), read its page or point the agent at /llms.txt or the MCP server.
zh: 92 个以上 UI 模式，每个都写了结构、最佳实践、无障碍与测试，并提供 MCP 与 llms.txt；实现陌生模式前先查。
zh_how: 实现还没写规格的模式（组合框、无限滚动、日期输入）前先读对应页面，或让 agent 读 /llms.txt、接入 MCP。

name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
best_for: Authoritative conventions for every Apple platform, including the current Liquid Glass material, layout, typography, navigation and app icons
how_to_use: Read the platform page, then the component pages (tab bars, toolbars, sheets) and Materials for Liquid Glass. The HTML is a JavaScript app; agents should fetch the same page as JSON: developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/design/human-interface-guidelines/<page>.json.
zh: Apple 各平台界面的权威规范，含 Liquid Glass 材质、布局、字体与导航；站点是 JS 应用，需用浏览器工具读。
zh_how: 先读平台总览，再读组件页（标签栏、工具栏、表单）和 Materials（Liquid Glass 材质）。网页是 JS 应用，agent 应改取同名 JSON：developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/design/human-interface-guidelines/<页面>.json。
caveats: Guidance changes every June with the new OS releases; check the page, not a remembered number.

name: Material Design 3
best_for: Google's system including M3 Expressive: colour roles and dynamic colour, type scale, shape, motion, adaptive layout, components
how_to_use: Read Foundations, then Styles (colour roles, type scale, shape, motion) and the component page; M3 Expressive adds the springs-based motion scheme and new components. The site needs a browser; agents can read the Material Web component docs as Markdown on GitHub.
zh: Google 的设计系统，含 M3 Expressive、动态取色、色彩角色、字阶、形状与动效；按 Foundations、Styles、Components 顺序读。
caveats: Every page answers a plain fetch with 'This website requires JavaScript'; the GitHub docs cover only the web components.

name: HarmonyOS Design
best_for: Official HarmonyOS guidelines: multi-device adaptive layout, HarmonyOS Sans, icons, motion, colour, plus resource downloads
how_to_use: Read the one-design-many-devices and layout pages first, then typography (HarmonyOS Sans), icons (HarmonyOS Symbol) and motion; downloads live under 设计资源. The portal needs a browser; the OpenHarmony UX design docs are the Markdown path for agents.
zh: 华为 HarmonyOS 官方设计规范，含多设备自适应布局、HarmonyOS Sans、图标与动效，附资源下载。
zh_how: 先读“一次设计、多端部署”和布局章节，再读字体（HarmonyOS Sans）、图标（HarmonyOS Symbol）与动效；资源下载在“设计资源”。门户需要浏览器，agent 可读 OpenHarmony 的 UX 设计文档（Markdown）。

entry_points.label: OpenHarmony UX design docs (Markdown, GitHub mirror)

caveats: The portal serves only a title to a plain fetch.
The OpenHarmony docs describe the open base system; HarmonyOS 5/6 visual features such as 沉浸光感 are only on the Huawei portal.

name: WeChat Mini Program Design Guidelines
best_for: Official mini-program rules: navigation and the capsule button, feedback, touch targets, typography and colour
how_to_use: Read it before drawing any mini-program screen: the capsule button area is reserved, the navigation bar and tab bar rules are strict, and design drafts use a 375 px or 390 px base width; the large-screen adaptation guide covers PC and tablet.
zh: 微信小程序官方设计规范：导航与胶囊按钮、反馈、触控热区、字体与色彩；动手画界面前必读。
zh_how: 画任何小程序界面前先读：右上角胶囊区域必须留出，导航栏与标签栏规则严格，设计稿以 375px 或 390px 为基准宽度；大屏适配指南覆盖 PC 与平板。

name: Apple Design Resources
best_for: Official UI kits, device bezels, SF Symbols app, Icon Composer and fonts
how_to_use: Download the UI kit matching the OS version you target (Figma or Sketch), Icon Composer for layered app icons and the SF Symbols app to look up symbol names; fonts are a separate download.
zh: Apple 官方 UI 套件、设备边框、SF Symbols 与字体下载；按目标系统版本选包，授权限做 Apple 平台设计。
license: Apple licence: for designing apps for Apple platforms

name: Android design guidance
best_for: Platform specifics Material does not cover: system bars, edge-to-edge, large screens and foldables, widgets, Wear, TV, XR
how_to_use: Use for what Material leaves to the platform: system bars and edge-to-edge, predictive back, large screens and foldables, widgets, Wear OS, TV and XR; pick the form factor first.
zh: Android 官方设计指南，补 Material 没覆盖的部分：系统栏、边到边、大屏折叠屏、Wear、TV 等。
caveats: A plain fetch is redirected to Google sign-in (302 to accounts.google.com on 2026-09-27); use a real browser.

name: Fluent 2
best_for: Microsoft's cross-platform design system: tokens, components, motion, accessibility
how_to_use: Start at Get started > Design for tokens, type and colour, then open Components for your platform (web/react, windows, ios, android); use it for Microsoft 365 add-ins and Windows apps.
zh: 微软跨平台设计系统，含 token、组件、动效和无障碍规范；做微软生态产品时照它对齐。

name: Windows app design
best_for: Desktop conventions for Windows 11 apps: title bar, navigation view, materials, typography, input
how_to_use: Read before designing an Electron or Tauri app that should feel native on Windows
zh: Windows 11 桌面应用设计规范：标题栏、导航、材质、字体、输入；做 Electron 或 Tauri 应用要原生感时读。

name: GNOME HIG
best_for: Clear, compact desktop-application guidelines; good general desktop advice even off Linux
how_to_use: Read the Patterns (header bars, navigation, feedback, selection) and the writing-style guidance; the rules are short and transfer to any desktop app.
zh: GNOME 的桌面应用规范，写得清楚紧凑；就算不在 Linux 做设计，patterns 章的通用桌面建议也值得读。

name: Alipay Mini Program design
best_for: Alipay's mini-program design specification and component guidance
how_to_use: Use with the WeChat guideline when one mini-program ships to both hosts; check the navigation bar, capsule and component differences before sharing one design.
zh: 支付宝小程序的设计规范与组件指引；同时上微信和支付宝时配合微信规范一起用。
caveats: The documentation portal is JavaScript-rendered for agents.

name: Command Line Interface Guidelines
best_for: Human-first principles for CLI design: output, errors, help, flags, interactivity
how_to_use: Read Output, Errors and Help before designing a CLI or TUI: human-readable output by default with --json for machines, messages to stderr, errors that say how to fix the problem, and help with examples.
zh: 命令行界面设计准则，讲输出、报错、帮助和参数的以人为本原则；产品界面是终端时读。

name: Flutter UI design docs
best_for: How Material and Cupertino are expressed in Flutter, adaptive and responsive guidance
how_to_use: Pair with the platform guideline for the target OS
zh: Flutter 中 Material 与 Cupertino 的落地方式及自适应、响应式指引；配合目标平台的规范一起看。

name: DingTalk design resources (钉钉设计开放资源)
best_for: DingTalk's open-platform design guides: partner-app experience standards and review, cool-app (酷应用) design, app-icon specs and downloadable resources
how_to_use: Read the partner-app experience guide and the icon spec before submitting an app or mini-app to DingTalk; the review follows these rules.
zh: 钉钉开放平台的设计资源：合作方应用上钉体验指南与审核、酷应用体验设计指南、应用图标规范与资源下载。
zh_how: 应用或小程序上架钉钉前，先读合作方应用体验指南和应用图标规范，审核按这些规则执行。
caveats: JavaScript-rendered; open it in a browser.

name: Feishu design specifications (飞书设计规范)
name_zh: 飞书开放平台设计规范
best_for: Feishu/Lark open-platform design specs, strongest on message cards for bots and notifications, plus web-app and icon guidance
how_to_use: Start with the message-card spec for any bot or notification UI, then prototype in the card builder; cards render in chat at narrow widths, so design the mobile layout first.
zh: 飞书开放平台设计规范，消息卡片（机器人与通知）部分最有用，另有网页应用与图标指引。
zh_how: 做机器人或通知界面先读消息卡片规范，再用卡片搭建工具出原型；卡片在聊天里宽度很窄，先设计移动端布局。
caveats: JavaScript-rendered documentation portal.

name: Douyin Mini App design guidelines (抖音小程序设计规范)
best_for: Design principles and industry-specific specifications for Douyin mini apps
how_to_use: Read it with the WeChat and Alipay guidelines when one mini-program ships on several hosts; check the host navigation bar and capsule differences first.
zh: 抖音小程序的设计原则与分行业规范；同一小程序要上多个宿主时，与微信、支付宝规范一起读。
zh_how: 同一个小程序要上多个宿主时，与微信、支付宝规范对照阅读，先核对各宿主导航栏和胶囊按钮的差异。

name: Carbon Design System
best_for: IBM's system: the best public reference for dense enterprise UI, data tables, data visualisation and AI labelling
how_to_use: Read Patterns (data tables, forms, empty states), Data visualization and Carbon for AI; agents should start from /llms.txt, which indexes every section.
zh: IBM 的设计系统，高密度企业界面、数据表格与数据可视化的最佳公开参考；Apache-2.0 协议。

name: GOV.UK Design System
best_for: Research-backed patterns for forms, errors and step-by-step services; the gold standard for clarity and accessibility
how_to_use: Read Patterns (ask users for dates, addresses, names; check answers; question pages) and the error-message guidance; every pattern cites its research.
zh: 英国政府设计系统，表单、报错与分步流程的模式都有研究背书；清晰与无障碍的标杆，MIT。

name: Ant Design
best_for: The de facto standard for Chinese enterprise admin products: design values, layout, data entry, data display, feedback, plus the component library
how_to_use: Read 设计规范 (/docs/spec/introduce-cn) for values, layout, data entry and display, then theme through ConfigProvider tokens. Agents: /llms.txt links the full docs (EN and CN) and a DESIGN.md of the design language. Ant Design Pro and ProComponents are the usual admin layout layer.
zh: 中文企业级后台的事实标准：设计价值观、布局、数据录入与展示、反馈加组件库；MIT 协议。
zh_how: 先读设计规范（/docs/spec/introduce-cn）里的价值观、布局、数据录入与展示，再用 ConfigProvider 的 token 定主题。agent 从 /llms.txt 进入，里面链接了中英文完整文档和一份设计语言的 DESIGN.md。后台布局通常叠加 Ant Design Pro 与 ProComponents。

name: Atlassian Design System
best_for: Well-documented tokens, components and content guidance for complex product suites
how_to_use: Read Foundations (tokens, spacing, elevation) and Content (voice, writing for UI); agents can start from /llms.txt, which links per-package token and component docs.
zh: 复杂产品套件的设计系统，token、组件与内容文案指引都写得扎实；重点看基础与内容两章。

name: Shopify Polaris and app design guidelines
best_for: Shopify's app design guidelines (Built for Shopify requirements, mobile-first admin UI, consistency with the admin) and Polaris, now a web-component framework across App Home, Admin, Checkout and POS
how_to_use: Read the app design guidelines before designing merchant-admin UI, then the Polaris web component references for the surface you target.
zh: Shopify 应用设计指南（Built for Shopify 要求、移动优先、与后台一致）与改为 Web Components 的 Polaris；做商家后台类界面时读。
caveats: The legacy React site polaris-react.shopify.com now redirects to the API references (checked 2026-09-27); most of the old pattern and content guidance is gone.

name: GitHub Primer
best_for: Developer-tool UI: navigation, lists, code-adjacent components, accessibility notes per component
how_to_use: Read a component page's accessibility and content sections, and the product UI patterns (navigation, empty states, loading, saving); use it for developer tools.
zh: GitHub 的设计系统，导航、列表、代码类组件齐全且逐个附无障碍说明；做开发者工具产品时参考；MIT。

name: Adobe Spectrum
best_for: System for professional creative tools; strong on density, colour and international typography
how_to_use: Use Spectrum 2 (s2.spectrum.adobe.com) for current tokens and components; the original site keeps the deeper writing on density, colour and international typography.
zh: Adobe 面向专业创意工具的设计系统，密度、色彩与多语言排版讲得深；新版是 Spectrum 2。

name: Vercel Geist
best_for: Vercel's minimal system: colours, typography, grid, icons, components
how_to_use: Read Colors (the 10-step scales and their roles), Typography and Grid before borrowing its restrained developer-tool look; it is also the default look many AI generators imitate.
zh: Vercel 的极简设计系统，颜色、字体、栅格、图标、组件俱全；做开发者工具界面时的克制范本。

name: AWS Cloudscape
best_for: Patterns for complex cloud consoles: resource tables, create flows, dashboards, generative-AI patterns
how_to_use: Read Patterns for table views, create flows, dashboards and generative-AI features; agents can start from /llms.txt (package, install and component index).
zh: AWS 的控制台设计系统，讲资源表格、创建流程、仪表盘与生成式 AI 模式；Apache-2.0。

name: GitLab Pajamas
best_for: Fully open design system with unusually candid usage guidance, including AI-human interaction
how_to_use: Read the Usability and Patterns sections and the AI-human interaction guidance; the usage notes are unusually frank about when not to use a component.
zh: GitLab 完全开放的设计系统，用法指引异常坦诚，还含 AI 与人交互的模式；MIT。

name: U.S. Web Design System
best_for: Accessible public-sector components, tokens and patterns
how_to_use: Use the patterns (create a user profile, complete a complex form, select a language) and the accessibility notes for trust-first, regulated services; compare with GOV.UK for form wording.
zh: 美国联邦政府网站设计系统，组件和模式以无障碍为底线；政务、受监管场景的信任感参考。

name: Wise Design
best_for: A modern consumer-fintech system with strong brand expression and content guidelines
how_to_use: Reference for expressive yet usable consumer product UI
zh: Wise 的消费金融设计系统，品牌表达与内容规范都出彩；做有性格又好用的 C 端产品时参考。

name: Arco Design
best_for: ByteDance's enterprise system with design guidelines and a style-customisation platform
how_to_use: Use as a lighter-toned alternative to Ant Design; the style-customisation platform exports a theme package, which is the part worth copying.
zh: 字节跳动的企业级设计系统，含设计规范与风格定制平台；比 Ant Design 视觉更轻，MIT。

name: Semi Design
best_for: Douyin's design system with design-to-code tooling and theme store
how_to_use: Reference for content-platform back offices; its design-to-code tooling and theme store show how a Chinese system ships themes, and VisActor provides matching chart themes.
zh: 抖音团队的设计系统，带设计转代码工具与主题商店；做内容平台后台可参考，MIT 协议。

name: TDesign
best_for: Tencent's system spanning web, mobile, mini-program and Flutter with shared design values
how_to_use: Pick when one product must ship across web, mobile, mini-program and Flutter; agents can read /llms.txt (design-guide index) and connect the official MCP server (npx -y tdesign-mcp-server@latest: component list, docs, DOM structure, changelog, icon search).
zh: 腾讯的设计体系，一套价值观横跨 Web、移动端、小程序和 Flutter；多端同发时选它；MIT。
zh_how: 一个产品要同时上 Web、移动端、小程序和 Flutter 时选它；agent 可读 /llms.txt（设计指南索引），并接入官方 MCP（npx -y tdesign-mcp-server@latest，提供组件列表、文档、DOM 结构、更新日志与图标搜索）。

entry_points.label: Components per stack (Vue 3, React, mini-program, mobile, Flutter)

name: Astro UX Design System
best_for: Design system for space-operations consoles: status semantics, dark control-room UI, monitoring patterns
how_to_use: Reference for operations centres, monitoring walls and digital-twin consoles
zh: 面向航天运控台的设计系统：状态语义、暗色控制室界面、监控模式；做监控大屏可参考。

name: Siemens Industrial Experience
best_for: Open industrial design system for plant and device software
how_to_use: Reference for industrial and IoT applications
zh: 西门子开源的工业设计系统，面向工厂和设备软件界面；做工业、IoT 产品时参考。MIT。

name: Design Systems Repo
best_for: Directory of public design systems with links to their docs, code and tools
how_to_use: Filter by company or industry to find two systems from a comparable domain, then read their pattern and content pages, not just components.
zh: 公开设计系统的目录，附文档、代码与工具链接；找同行业可比系统时从这里入手。

name: Digital Agency Design System (デジタル庁デザインシステム)
best_for: Japan's government design system (v2.18, beta): design language, components, guidelines and accessibility, with Figma data, HTML and React examples; the whole site is also offered as Markdown
how_to_use: The best CJK public-service reference: read the accessibility and form guidance for Japanese UI, and give an agent the Markdown version of the site.
zh: 日本数字厅的政府设计系统（v2.18 测试版）：设计语言、组件、指南与无障碍，附 Figma、HTML 与 React 示例，全站也提供 Markdown 版。

name: SmartHR Design System
best_for: Japanese B2B SaaS system notable for its Japanese writing rules and accessibility guidance
how_to_use: Read the writing (ライティング) and basic-design sections when designing dense Japanese business UI; its rules on notation and wording transfer to Chinese copy decisions.
zh: 日本 B2B SaaS 的设计系统，日文写作规范与无障碍指南尤其扎实；做高密度日文业务界面时读。

name: KRDS (Korea Design System)
best_for: Korea's government design system: principles, components, service patterns, code and Figma
how_to_use: Use the service patterns for Korean public or form-heavy services and compare them with GOV.UK's; needs a browser.
zh: 韩国政府设计系统：原则、组件、服务模式、代码与 Figma；韩文公共服务或表单密集场景参考，可与 GOV.UK 对照。
caveats: The root answers with a meta refresh to /html/site/index.html; content is script-assembled.

name: LINE Design System
best_for: LINE's system for a messaging super-app used across Japan, Taiwan and Thailand
how_to_use: Reference for chat-centred mobile products in East Asia; compare its message and list patterns with WeChat's conventions.
zh: LINE 超级 App 的设计系统，覆盖日本、台湾、泰国市场；以聊天为中心的东亚移动产品参考。
caveats: JavaScript-rendered; needs a real browser.

name: Game UI Database
best_for: Tens of thousands of game screens filterable by screen type, controls, style, colour and layout; superb for HUDs, overlays and information-dense full-screen UI
how_to_use: Filter by screen type (HUD, map, inventory, skill tree) for data-wall and immersive ideas
zh: 数万张游戏界面截图库，可按画面类型、控件、配色筛选；做 HUD、浮层或高密度满屏界面时翻。
caveats: Cloudflare-walled for agents (403 to curl on 2026-09-27; a plain fetch gets 'Database Unavailable'); it works in a real browser.

name: Interface In Game
best_for: Game interface screenshots and videos by title and element
how_to_use: Search by game or by element (health bar, minimap, inventory, dialogue) and use the videos for HUD motion and state changes.
zh: 按游戏和界面元素归档的游戏 UI 截图与视频库，做 HUD 或游戏化界面时看动效表现。
caveats: A SiteGround 'One moment, please...' wall answers plain fetches (2026-09-27).

name: HUDS+GUIS
best_for: Fantasy UI from film, TV and games
how_to_use: Reference for cinematic control-room aesthetics, with a usability pinch of salt
zh: 影视与游戏里的幻想 UI 合集；做控制室式科幻视觉时参考，可用性别当真。

name: Sci-fi Interfaces
best_for: Critical analysis of fictional interfaces: what would and would not work
how_to_use: Read before borrowing an idea from a film UI
zh: 对科幻电影界面做严肃批判分析的博客；想从电影 UI 借点子之前先读它。

name: Design Spells
best_for: Small delightful details and easter eggs from shipped products, as short videos
how_to_use: Use when a product needs one memorable moment
zh: 收录已上线产品里讨巧的小细节和彩蛋，短视频呈现；产品缺一个记忆点时来翻。
caveats: Vercel Security Checkpoint answers plain fetches (429 on 2026-09-27).

name: Little Big Details
best_for: Archive of thoughtful small UI details
how_to_use: Skim for ideas that cost little to build
zh: 收集产品中贴心小细节的档案馆；想给界面加点便宜又讨喜的东西时翻一翻。
caveats: Archived: no new posts; some linked products have changed since.

name: FT Visual Vocabulary
best_for: Chart chooser organised by the relationship in the data (deviation, correlation, ranking, distribution, change over time, part-to-whole, spatial, flow)
how_to_use: Name the relationship first (deviation, correlation, ranking, distribution, change over time, magnitude, part-to-whole, spatial, flow), then pick from that column. The web version is a JavaScript app; agents should read the PDF poster, which also exists in simplified and traditional Chinese and Japanese.
zh: FT 的图表选择器，按数据里的关系（偏差、相关、排名、分布、随时间变化等）分类；先定关系再选图。
zh_how: 先确定数据关系（偏差、相关、排名、分布、随时间变化、量级、占比、空间、流向），再在对应一栏里选图。网页版是 JS 应用，agent 请读 PDF 海报；海报有简体中文、繁体中文和日文版。
caveats: The interactive site shows agents an empty shell (19 characters of text on 2026-09-27); the posters were last revised years ago, but chart choice by relationship has not changed.

name: From Data to Viz
best_for: Decision tree from data type to chart, with a caveats section on common mistakes
how_to_use: Start from the data shape (one or several numeric variables, categoric, numeric plus categoric, map, network, time series), follow the tree to two or three candidate charts, then read the Caveats page (ordering bars, spaghetti lines, dual axes, pie charts) before finalising.
zh: 从数据类型到图表的决策树，附常见错误清单；定稿任何图表前先读它的 Caveats 页。
zh_how: 从数据形态出发（单个或多个数值变量、分类、数值加分类、地图、网络、时间序列），顺着决策树找到两三个候选图表，定稿前再读 Caveats 页（柱子排序、意大利面线图、双轴、饼图等）。

name: Urban Institute Data Visualization Style Guide
best_for: The most complete public chart style guide: palette with hex values, type hierarchy, annotation, and rules per chart type, all on one static page
how_to_use: Copy its structure when writing the chart chapter of a design system: palette and its order, type sizes, titles and source lines, then one section per chart type; replace Urban's own brand values (Lato, #1696d2) with the product's.
zh: 最完整的公开图表风格指南：带色值的配色、字体层级、标注与逐类图表规则，全部在一个静态页面上。
zh_how: 给设计系统写图表章节时照它的结构来：配色与顺序、字号、标题与来源行，再按图表类型分节；把 Urban 自己的品牌值（Lato、#1696d2）换成产品的。

name: Data Viz Project
best_for: Large catalogue of chart types filterable by function, input and shape
how_to_use: Filter by Family, Input, Function or Shape to find a less obvious form, then check the chosen chart against FT Visual Vocabulary before committing.
zh: 图表类型大目录，可按功能、输入和形状筛选；想找不那么俗套的图表形式时用它。

name: Carbon data visualization
best_for: Practical rules for enterprise charts: colour palettes, axes, legends, dashboards, accessibility
how_to_use: Read Color palettes (categorical order, sequential, alert), then Axes and labels, Legends and the Dashboards page; the categorical palettes come in a fixed order meant to be used as-is.
zh: IBM Carbon 的企业图表规范：配色板、坐标轴、图例、仪表盘与无障碍规则，做后台图表照它执行。

name: Material 2 data visualization
best_for: Still one of the clearest overviews of chart selection, style, behaviour and dashboard layout
how_to_use: Read once as a primer on chart selection, style (colour, type, gridlines, labels), behaviour and dashboard layout, then apply one current style guide such as Urban's or Carbon's.
zh: Material 2 的数据可视化指南，图表选型、样式、行为与仪表盘布局讲得最清楚的入门之一。
caveats: Frozen Material 2 documentation; the page is a JavaScript app, so agents see an empty shell.

name: Chartability
best_for: Audit heuristics for accessible data visualisation
how_to_use: Test a chart against the POUR-CAF principles (perceivable, operable, understandable, robust, compromising, assistive, flexible), starting with the critical tests: contrast, colour-only encoding, keyboard access, text alternatives and a data table.
zh: 数据可视化的无障碍审计启发式清单；任何承载关键信息的图表都该过一遍。
zh_how: 按 POUR-CAF 原则（可感知、可操作、可理解、健壮、可妥协、辅助、灵活）检查图表，先做关键项：对比度、只靠颜色编码、键盘可达、文本替代和数据表。

name: Datawrapper blog and Academy
best_for: Working knowledge from the Datawrapper team on chart design, strongest on colour for data, plus the Academy's per-chart-type how-tos and a free chart, map and table tool
how_to_use: Start with 'Which color scale to use when visualizing data' and the rest of the colour series; use the Academy for chart-type conventions (bars, lines, maps, tables) and the tool itself to test a chart fast.
zh: Datawrapper 团队的博客与 Academy：图表设计实操，数据配色系列最值得读，Academy 按图表类型讲惯例，也可直接用它的免费工具快速试图。

name: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
best_for: Tufte on data-ink, chartjunk and graphical integrity
how_to_use: Read the chapters on graphical integrity and data-ink before a dashboard critique; cite the lie factor and chartjunk by name.
zh: Tufte 的量化信息视觉呈现，讲数据墨水比、chartjunk 与图形诚信；做任何图表仪表盘的原理书。
caveats: Paid printed book; there is no online text for an agent to consult.

name: Storytelling with Data
best_for: Practical business chart design and narrative
how_to_use: For decks and dashboards aimed at managers: remove clutter first, then focus attention with one accent colour and an action title that states the takeaway.
zh: 讲商业图表设计与数据叙事的实用书；给管理层做汇报和仪表盘时读，付费。
caveats: Paid books; the site's blog and community challenges are the free part.

name: ONS data visualisation guidance
best_for: UK Office for National Statistics guidance on charts, tables and colour: chart choice, accessible colour, titles, annotation and the specifications behind its published charts
how_to_use: Use for public-facing statistics where clarity and accessibility beat novelty; read the colour guidance and the chart-type pages before styling.
zh: 英国国家统计局的图表、表格与配色指南：选图、无障碍配色、标题与标注；面向公众的统计数据，清晰和可访问优先于新奇。

name: The Data Visualisation Catalogue
best_for: Chart-type catalogue searchable by function (comparison, distribution, part-to-whole, relationships) with anatomy, when-to-use notes and tool lists per chart
how_to_use: Use Search by Function when a less common chart might fit, and read the anatomy notes to name the parts in a spec.
zh: 按功能（比较、分布、占比、关系）检索的图表类型目录，每种图附结构说明、适用场景与工具；与 FT Visual Vocabulary 搭配找不常见的图表。

name: Fundamentals of Data Visualization
best_for: Claus Wilke's complete book, free online: choosing visualisations, colour use and pitfalls, proportional ink, overlapping points, and figure design
how_to_use: Read the colour chapters (colour scales, common pitfalls of colour use) and 'The principle of proportional ink' before designing charts; the whole text is static HTML an agent can read.
zh: Claus Wilke 的完整在线免费书：选图、配色与常见陷阱、比例墨水原则、点重叠与图形设计；设计图表前先读配色与陷阱章节。

name: Apache ECharts
best_for: Full-featured charting library that most Chinese dashboards and big-screen projects are built on, with a runnable examples gallery, a complete option reference and a theme builder
how_to_use: Open the closest example and edit its option live, then look up each key in the option reference; define colours, fonts and axis styles once in a theme (the theme builder exports JSON) instead of per chart.
zh: 功能全的图表库，中文仪表盘与大屏项目的事实主力；定义一次主题对象，别逐图改样式；Apache-2.0。
zh_how: 先打开最接近的示例在线改 option，再到配置项手册逐项查；颜色、字体、坐标轴样式在主题里统一定义一次（主题编辑器可导出 JSON），不要逐图改样式。
caveats: The official ECharts Gallery and Make A Pie community sites are closed; community examples now live on isqqw (see isqqw-echarts).

name: Vega-Lite
best_for: Declarative JSON grammar for interactive charts with a published JSON Schema, so an agent can emit a chart as data and validate it before rendering
how_to_use: Have the agent write a Vega-Lite spec (data, mark, encoding) instead of bespoke chart code, validate it against the schema, render with vega-embed, and set colours and fonts once in a config object; Altair produces the same specs from Python.
zh: 声明式 JSON 交互图表语法，附公开的 JSON Schema；agent 可以把图表当数据输出并在渲染前校验。
zh_how: 让 agent 输出 Vega-Lite 规格（data、mark、encoding）而不是手写图表代码，用 schema 校验后交给 vega-embed 渲染；颜色和字体在 config 里统一设置。Python 侧可用 Altair 生成同样的规格。

name: AntV
best_for: Ant Group's visualisation stack (statistical charts, graphs, maps) with design principles for data graphics
how_to_use: Read the design spec (设计价值观, 色板, 标题与注释, 标签) before picking G2 (statistical charts), G6 (graphs) or L7 (maps). Agents: /llms.txt links Markdown versions of every spec page.
zh: 蚂蚁集团的可视化技术栈与数据图形设计原则；先读设计原则，再翻 G2、G6、L7 的图表示例，MIT。
zh_how: 先读设计规范（设计价值观、色板、标题与注释、标签），再按需选 G2（统计图表）、G6（关系图）或 L7（地图）。agent 从 /llms.txt 进入，每个规范页都有 Markdown 版本。

name: Tremor
best_for: React and Tailwind components for charts and dashboards; the team joined Vercel in 2025
how_to_use: Use for a quick analytical UI in a React and Tailwind stack, then restyle the defaults to the product's tokens.
zh: 面向仪表盘与图表的 React 组件库，搭分析类界面很快；默认样式记得重塑，Apache-2.0。
caveats: The site says 'Tremor is joining Vercel' (checked 2026-09-27) and the open-source repo was last pushed 2025-10; check activity before adopting.

name: D3
best_for: Low-level toolkit for bespoke data visualisation
how_to_use: Use Observable Plot for standard charts and D3 only for bespoke forms (custom layouts, force, geo projections); pick the needed d3-* modules rather than the whole bundle.
zh: 定制数据可视化的底层工具箱；标准图表交给 Observable Plot，非标定制才上 D3；ISC。

name: Observable Plot
best_for: Concise grammar-of-graphics chart library from the D3 team: marks, scales and facets with good defaults for exploratory and editorial charts
how_to_use: Reach for it before D3 for standard charts: one Plot.plot({marks: [...]}) call per chart; restyle through the style option and CSS, and drop to D3 only for custom layouts.
zh: D3 团队出品的图形语法图表库（mark、scale、facet），默认值出色；探索性和编辑型图表首选，D3 太底层时用它。
caveats: observablehq.com answers plain fetches with a Vercel security checkpoint (429 on 2026-09-27); the GitHub README is the agent path.

name: visx
best_for: Airbnb's low-level React visualisation primitives on D3 (scales, shapes, axes, tooltips) for charts that must match a design system exactly
how_to_use: Use when a React product needs fully custom charts; compose only the primitives you need and style them with the product's tokens.
zh: Airbnb 基于 D3 的底层 React 可视化原语（比例尺、图形、坐标轴、提示框）；需要与设计系统完全一致的定制 React 图表时用。
caveats: The docs site is a JavaScript app (airbnb.io/visx redirects to visx.airbnb.tech); read the GitHub README instead.

name: VisActor
best_for: ByteDance's visualisation suite: VChart (narrative charts), VTable (very large interactive tables), VMind (AI chart generation), with themes matching Semi and Arco
how_to_use: Choose it when a Chinese product already uses Semi or Arco, or needs tables with hundreds of thousands of rows; agents can read /llms.txt, which indexes the VChart and VTable docs.
zh: 字节跳动可视化方案：VChart（叙事图表）、VTable（超大表格）、VMind（AI 生成图表），带 Semi、Arco 主题；已用 Semi/Arco 的项目首选。
zh_how: 国内产品已用 Semi 或 Arco，或需要几十万行的交互表格时选它；agent 可读 /llms.txt，里面索引了 VChart 与 VTable 文档。

name: Chart.js
best_for: Simple, framework-agnostic canvas charts (eight core types) with good defaults and a large plugin ecosystem
how_to_use: Use for a handful of standard charts in any stack; set Chart.defaults (font, colour, grid) once to the product's tokens, and pick SVG-based libraries when charts need per-element accessibility.
zh: 简单、与框架无关的 Canvas 图表库（八种基础图表），默认值好、插件多；任何技术栈里做少量标准图表时用。
caveats: Canvas output: add a text summary or data table for screen-reader users.

name: Recharts
best_for: Composable React chart components on SVG; the engine behind shadcn/ui charts and therefore most AI-generated dashboards
how_to_use: Compose charts from <XAxis>, <Tooltip>, <Line> and similar components; when the project uses shadcn/ui, start from its chart blocks and retheme through the chart config and CSS variables. Version 3 changed the API; check the installed major.
zh: 基于 SVG 的可组合 React 图表组件，也是 shadcn/ui 图表的底层，因此是大多数 AI 生成仪表盘的默认；注意 v3 有破坏性变更。
caveats: recharts.org now shows 'Recharts has moved' (checked 2026-09-27); use recharts.github.io.

name: Highcharts
best_for: Mature commercial chart library with the strongest built-in accessibility module (keyboard, sonification, screen-reader descriptions), plus stock, map and Gantt products
how_to_use: Consider it for regulated or accessibility-critical products, and confirm the licence before any commercial use.
zh: 成熟的商业图表库，内置无障碍模块最完善（键盘、声音化、读屏描述），另有股票、地图、甘特图产品；商用必须购买授权。
license: Commercial (Highsoft Standard License); non-commercial use under separate terms
caveats: Licence trap: the source is on GitHub, but commercial use needs a paid licence (shop.highcharts.com/license, checked 2026-09-27).

name: Dashboard Design Patterns
best_for: Research-based taxonomy of dashboard structures, page layouts, interactions and genres
how_to_use: Before drawing, pick the dashboard genre (the site lists them) and walk the patterns for data information, meta information, visual representation, page layout, screen space and interaction; the design trade-offs page helps argue density decisions.
zh: 基于研究的仪表盘模式分类学，梳理页面布局、交互和类型；动手画之前先选定仪表盘类型。

name: Grafana dashboards
best_for: Thousands of real operations dashboards; shows what on-call engineers actually use
how_to_use: Sort by downloads for a data source (Prometheus, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL) to see which panels on-call engineers actually keep; open play.grafana.org in a browser for live behaviour.
zh: 数千个真实运维监控面板仓库，看值班工程师实际在用什么数据墙；配 play.grafana.org 看实时行为。

name: Alibaba Cloud DataV
best_for: The reference product for Chinese big-screen (data wall) dashboards; templates show prevailing conventions
how_to_use: Study the templates for layout conventions of Chinese data walls (a central map or hero metric, flanking panels, a top title bar), then drop the neon-glow cliché; GeoAtlas (see datav-geoatlas) provides the map boundaries.
zh: 国内大屏数据可视化的参照系产品，模板体现主流惯例；学布局可以，霓虹光效那套要避开。
caveats: The portal is a JavaScript app (21 characters of text to a plain fetch on 2026-09-27).

name: EasyV
best_for: Big-screen and digital-twin case library
how_to_use: Second source for data-wall layouts
zh: 国产大屏与数字孪生案例库；做数据墙排版布局时的第二参照来源。

name: The Big Book of Dashboards
best_for: Real business dashboards grouped by scenario, each with expert critique of what works and why
how_to_use: Find the scenario closest to the brief (executive summary, operations, sales, health care) and borrow its layout logic; the site hosts the dashboards shown in the book.
zh: 真实业务仪表盘按场景归类，逐个附专家点评讲清什么有效、为什么；从相近场景选仪表盘类型与布局。

name: DataV.GeoAtlas
best_for: GeoJSON for China's administrative areas down to district level, the usual source for Chinese map charts in ECharts, AntV and big-screen tools
how_to_use: Pick the region in the selector or fetch it directly by adcode (100000 is the whole country, _full includes the child areas).
zh: 阿里云 DataV 的中国行政区划 GeoJSON（可到区县），国内地图图表的常用数据源。
zh_how: 在选择器里选区域，或按行政区划代码直接取数据（100000 为全国，带 _full 的文件包含下级区域）。公开发布的地图须遵守审图规定、使用官方边界。
caveats: Maps published in China must pass map review (审图) and use official boundaries; do not hand-edit borders.

name: GoView
best_for: Open-source drag-and-drop big-screen builder (Vue 3, ECharts and VChart) from the Dromara community
how_to_use: Use it to block out a data-wall layout quickly, then design the real hierarchy and typography by hand.
zh: Dromara 社区开源的拖拽式大屏搭建工具（Vue3 + ECharts + VChart）；用来快速搭大屏布局原型，真正的信息层级仍要手工设计。

name: ECharts community gallery (isqqw)
best_for: Community ECharts examples that replaced the closed ECharts Gallery and Make A Pie; searchable, with live option editing
how_to_use: Find a close example, copy its option, then rewrite colours and fonts with the project theme.
zh: ECharts Gallery 与 Make A Pie 关停后的社区示例站，可搜索、在线改配置；找相近示例再换成项目配色。
caveats: Many examples are neon big-screen clichés; take the mechanics, not the look.
JavaScript-only for agents.

name: DataEase
best_for: Open-source BI tool from FIT2CLOUD for dashboards and data screens; shows the conventions Chinese enterprise BI users expect
how_to_use: Use the demo and templates to see how domestic BI dashboards are structured (filters, drill-down, screen mode) before designing one.
zh: 飞致云开源 BI 工具，可做仪表盘与数据大屏；设计前看它的模板与演示，了解国内企业 BI 用户习惯的结构（筛选、下钻、大屏模式）。
license: FIT2CLOUD Open Source License (GPLv3 with extra restrictions)
caveats: Not plain GPL: derivative works may not replace the DataEase logo or copyright notices.

name: Dataviz Inspiration
best_for: Curated real-world data visualisations filterable by chart type
how_to_use: Filter by chart type, then study how each piece labels directly, annotates the key point and orders its data; it is a gallery, not a guide.
zh: 真实数据可视化作品的策展画廊，可按图表类型筛；重点看专业人士怎么做标注与标签。
caveats: JavaScript-rendered (48 characters of text to a plain fetch on 2026-09-27).

name: Information is Beautiful Awards
best_for: Award showcase for ambitious visualisation and infographics
how_to_use: Browse past winners and shortlists by category for editorial-grade data storytelling.
zh: 数据可视化与信息图的奖项画廊；做编辑级数据叙事时来这里找野心参考。
caveats: The newest announcement on the site is the 2024 winners (checked 2026-09-27).

name: Our World in Data
best_for: Thousands of consistently designed, annotated interactive charts with sources and downloadable data
how_to_use: Study how titles, subtitles, notes and source lines make a chart self-explanatory; append .csv to any grapher URL to get the data behind it.
zh: 数千张风格统一、有标注的交互图表，附来源与数据下载；学标题、副标题、注释和来源行如何让图表自解释。
zh_how: 重点看标题、副标题、注释和来源行怎样让图表不需要额外解释；在任意 grapher 图表网址后加 .csv 即可下载背后的数据。

name: The Pudding
best_for: Visual essays that explain ideas with data: the reference for scrollytelling and editorial interaction
how_to_use: Use for narrative data pages; note how each scroll step changes one thing and how annotation carries the argument.
zh: 用数据讲道理的视觉长文，滚动叙事与编辑型交互的标杆；注意每一步滚动只改变一件事。

name: The Paper: Meishuke (澎湃新闻·美数课)
best_for: One of the most consistent Chinese data-journalism desks: explainers, infographics and data stories on current news
how_to_use: Study how Chinese headlines, annotation and vertical mobile-first layouts carry a data story; most pieces are designed for phone reading.
zh: 国内最稳定的数据新闻栏目之一：围绕新闻做解释性图表、信息图和数据故事；学中文标题、标注与竖屏手机阅读的版式。

name: ColorBrewer
best_for: Research-based sequential, diverging and qualitative schemes for maps and charts
how_to_use: Choose the nature of the data (sequential, diverging, qualitative) and the number of classes, tick 'colorblind safe' and 'print friendly', then export HEX, RGB or a JS array.
zh: 研究背书的地图与图表配色工具，分顺序、发散、定性三类；记得勾选色盲安全，Apache-2.0。

name: Viz Palette
best_for: Tests a data palette in real chart types under colour-vision deficiencies
how_to_use: Paste the categorical palette, then read the colour report: pairs that collide under each colour-vision deficiency and at small sizes are listed; adjust until none remain.
zh: 把数据配色放进真实图表、并在色盲模拟下检验的工具；发图表前查分类色板。
caveats: JavaScript app; a plain fetch returns an empty shell with an unrelated page title.

name: How to pick the least wrong colors
best_for: Algorithmic approach to categorical palettes that stay distinct
how_to_use: For charts with many series: follow its method of maximising perceptual distance (CIELAB delta E) between categories while simulating colour-blindness (Brettel, Vienot and Mollon) and keeping WCAG contrast against the background, then check the result in Viz Palette.
zh: 讲用算法生成保持区分的分类配色的文章；图表系列很多时照它做。

name: Data Color Picker (Learn UI Design)
best_for: Generates evenly spaced palettes, single-hue scales and divergent scales for charts and dashboards
how_to_use: Start chart palettes here, then test the result in Viz Palette for colour-vision collisions.
zh: 生成间隔均匀的图表配色、单色或发散色阶；图表配色从这里起步，再用 Viz Palette 查色觉问题。

name: chroma.js palette helper
best_for: Builds multi-hue sequential and diverging scales with lightness correction and a colour-blindness check
how_to_use: Use for sequential scales that must stay perceptually even (maps, heatmaps); turn on 'correct lightness' and check the colour-blind preview before exporting.
zh: 生成带明度校正与色盲检查的顺序和发散配色；多色相顺序色阶要保持感知均匀时用。
caveats: JavaScript app; the repository (gka/palettes) was last pushed in 2024.

name: Coloring for Colorblindness
best_for: Simulates colour-vision deficiencies on a palette and offers known safe categorical palettes (Okabe-Ito, Wong, IBM)
how_to_use: Check a categorical palette here before shipping, or start from one of its safe palettes when the brand allows.
zh: 模拟色觉缺陷下的配色效果，并提供经过验证的安全分类配色（Okabe-Ito、Wong、IBM）；分类配色上线前在这里检查。
caveats: JavaScript app (29 characters of text to a plain fetch).

name: iWantHue
best_for: Generates and refines sets of optimally distinct categorical colours inside a chosen hue, chroma and lightness range, with a colour-blind option
how_to_use: Constrain the colour space to the brand's range, generate the number of categories you need with 'improve for the colorblind' on, then sort by difference.
zh: 在限定的色相、彩度、明度范围内生成并优化“彼此最可区分”的分类色，可开启色盲优化；类别多的图表用。

name: Scientific colour maps (Fabio Crameri)
best_for: Perceptually uniform, colour-blind-friendly scientific colour maps (batlow and family) that replace rainbow and jet scales
how_to_use: Use for heatmaps, maps and continuous scales; download the map for your tool (CSS, Python, R, ParaView and more) and cite the version.
zh: 感知均匀、色盲友好的科学色阶（batlow 等），用来替代彩虹色和 jet；热力图、地图与连续色阶时用。

name: Shape of AI
best_for: Pattern library for AI product UX: wayfinders, inputs, tuners, governors, trust indicators, identifiers, with real examples
how_to_use: Pick the family for the job (Wayfinders to get a first prompt, Inputs, Tuners, Governors for user control, Trust builders, Identifiers), then read the pattern's shipped examples and when-to-use notes before drawing the AI surface.
zh: AI 产品交互模式库：导航、输入、调节、约束、信任标识等，附真实案例与适用场景说明。
zh_how: 按任务选模式族（Wayfinders 引导第一次输入、Inputs 输入、Tuners 调节、Governors 用户控制、Trust builders 建立信任、Identifiers 标识），读该模式的真实产品案例和适用说明，再画 AI 界面。

name: Aiverse
best_for: Library of AI interaction examples from shipped products, organised by pattern
how_to_use: Search by interaction type (onboarding, prompt input, streaming, citations, agent handoff) to see how shipped products solve it; the case studies explain the trade-offs.
zh: AI 交互案例库，取自已上线产品并按模式归类；做 AI 功能时按交互类型查当下惯例。
caveats: Sign-up and a paid plan unlock most of the 300+ references.

name: Ant Design X
best_for: AI-interface component system with a published design paradigm for roles, intention, conversation and hybrid UI
how_to_use: Read the RICH design paradigm first (Role, Intention, Conversation, Hybrid UI: wake-up, AI badge, input, generation progress, feedback), then compose the chat surface from the components.
zh: 蚂蚁的 AI 界面组件体系，附带角色、意图、对话与混合界面的设计范式；搭聊天 UI 前读。MIT。
zh_how: 先读 RICH 设计范式（角色 Role、意图 Intention、会话 Conversation、混合界面 Hybrid UI：唤醒、AI 标识、输入、生成过程、反馈），再用组件拼出对话界面。

name: Vercel AI Elements
best_for: Components for AI interfaces: conversation, message, reasoning, sources, tool calls, prompt input
how_to_use: Install components into the repo with npx ai-elements@latest add <component> (conversation, message, reasoning, tool, sources, prompt-input), then restyle them with the project's shadcn tokens rather than shipping the defaults.
zh: Vercel 的 AI 界面组件：对话、消息、推理、来源、工具调用、输入框；做聊天 UI 从它开始而非从零。

name: prompt-kit
best_for: Accessible, customisable React building blocks for AI chat (prompt input, message, markdown, code block, reasoning, loaders) in the shadcn copy-in style
how_to_use: Compare its prompt input and message components with AI Elements and assistant-ui, and take the one whose API matches the stack.
zh: shadcn 风格的 AI 应用积木组件库，聊天界面件齐全；AI Elements 之外的另一个替代选择；MIT。

name: assistant-ui
best_for: React primitives for AI chat and agent interfaces: threads, streaming, tool-call UI, attachments, branching and human approval
how_to_use: Use instead of hand-rolling chat state; compare with AI Elements (copy-in components) and pick assistant-ui when you need runtime state such as branching and tool approval handled for you.
zh: AI 聊天与 agent 界面的 React 基础组件：会话、流式输出、工具调用 UI、附件、分支与人工确认；别手搓聊天状态，可与 AI Elements 对比。

name: json-render
best_for: Vercel Labs framework where the model emits JSON constrained to your own component catalogue, which is validated and streamed as UI
how_to_use: Use when an agent must compose UI from approved components only: define the catalogue (component, props schema), let the model fill it, render the stream.
zh: Vercel Labs 的生成式 UI 框架：模型只能输出受你的组件目录约束的 JSON，校验后流式渲染为界面；agent 只允许用批准组件拼 UI 时用。
caveats: Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: MateChat
best_for: Huawei DevUI's generative-AI experience language and Vue chat components, tuned for developer tools and IDE assistants
how_to_use: Read its guide for how an assistant should sit inside an existing tool (side panel, inline prompts, consistent with the host UI), and use the components in Vue projects; Ant Design X is the React counterpart.
zh: 华为 DevUI 团队的生成式 AI 体验设计系统与 Vue 对话组件，面向研发工具与 IDE 助手；React 项目对应的是 Ant Design X。

name: Designing for agentic AI (Smashing Magazine, 2026)
best_for: Practical patterns for control, consent and accountability when an agent acts on the user's behalf rather than only answering
how_to_use: Use as a review checklist for any feature where the AI takes actions: preview before acting, scoped permissions, interruptibility, an activity log and undo.
zh: Smashing 2026 年文章：agent 代用户行动时的控制、授权与问责模式；AI 会“做事”而不只是“回答”的功能都拿它做评审清单。

name: People + AI Guidebook
best_for: Google PAIR's research-based guidance: mental models, explainability and trust, feedback and control, errors and graceful failure
how_to_use: Work through the chapters during the brief (User needs and defining success, Data collection and evaluation, Mental models, Explainability and trust, Feedback and control, Errors and graceful failure) and use their worksheets with the team.
zh: Google PAIR 的 AI 产品设计指南，讲心智模型、可解释性、信任与容错；立项期用章节练习。
caveats: JavaScript app: a plain fetch gets only the title, so agents need a browser.

name: Microsoft HAX Toolkit
best_for: Eighteen guidelines for human-AI interaction with a design library of examples and a planning workbook
how_to_use: Use the 18 guidelines as a review checklist for AI features (initially, during interaction, when wrong, over time) and look up each one's examples in the HAX Design Library.
zh: 微软的人机 AI 交互十八条指南，附案例库与规划工作簿；评审 AI 功能时当检查清单用。

name: Carbon for AI
best_for: How an enterprise system marks AI-generated content and exposes explainability
how_to_use: Use the AI label component for every AI-generated or AI-assisted element and its explainability popover to say what the model did; the label's usage page covers placement and variants.
zh: IBM 的 AI 界面规范：如何标注 AI 生成内容、如何呈现可解释性；做 AI 标签和说明弹层时参考。

name: Cloudscape generative AI patterns
best_for: Concrete patterns for generative-AI chat, loading states, output labelling and user-authorised actions
how_to_use: Use when adding an assistant to an enterprise console: the set covers chat, output labels, loading states, progressive steps, follow-up questions, user-authorised actions, response regeneration and artifact previews.
zh: Cloudscape 的生成式 AI 模式：对话、加载态、输出标注与用户授权操作；给企业控制台加助手时照它做。

name: Apple HIG: Generative AI
best_for: Apple's guidance on designing generative-AI features responsibly
how_to_use: Read with the platform's writing and privacy pages. The page is a JavaScript app; agents should fetch the JSON version (developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/design/human-interface-guidelines/generative-ai.json).
zh: Apple 关于负责任地设计生成式 AI 功能的官方指引；配合写作与隐私章节一起读。

name: OpenAI UI guidelines for ChatGPT apps (Plugins)
best_for: Rules for UI inside ChatGPT: display modes (inline card, inline carousel, fullscreen, picture-in-picture), when to use each, card layout and actions, plus the @openai/apps-sdk-ui component library
how_to_use: Read before designing any widget for a chat host: every app starts inline, cards carry one action or decision, and fullscreen is for multi-step work with the composer still overlaid. Pair with MCP Apps for the open equivalent.
zh: 在 ChatGPT 里做应用界面的规范：展示模式（内联卡片、内联轮播、全屏、画中画）各自何时用、卡片布局与操作，并附 @openai/apps-sdk-ui 组件库；时效性强。
caveats: Moved in 2026 from /apps-sdk/concepts/design-guidelines to the Plugins section (redirect checked 2026-09-27).
Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: MCP Apps
best_for: The official MCP extension for tools that return interactive UI (ui:// resources rendered in a sandboxed iframe inside chat hosts); it superseded the MCP-UI experiments
how_to_use: Design embedded tool UI to the host's constraints (sandboxed iframe, host theming, small inline footprint, explicit actions back to the model); read with the OpenAI UI guidelines for display-mode conventions.
zh: MCP 官方扩展：工具可返回在聊天宿主内沙箱 iframe 中渲染的交互界面（ui:// 资源），取代了 MCP-UI 实验；设计内嵌工具界面前读。
caveats: Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: A2UI
best_for: Open protocol from Google for agents to send declarative UI (a catalogue of components, not code) that clients render natively on web, mobile and desktop
how_to_use: Read when an agent must return forms, cards or lists rather than text; design the component catalogue the agent may use, and check which spec version your renderer supports (v0.9.1 current, v1.0 candidate on 2026-09-27).
zh: Google 发起的开放协议：agent 以声明式组件目录（而非代码）下发界面，由客户端在 Web、移动与桌面原生渲染；规范迭代快，注意版本。
caveats: Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: China: Measures for Labelling AI-Generated Synthetic Content (人工智能生成合成内容标识办法)
name_zh: 人工智能生成合成内容标识办法
best_for: The CAC rules in force since 2025-09-01 requiring explicit labels (visible text, sound or graphics in the content or the interaction interface) and implicit labels (metadata) on AI-generated text, images, audio, video and virtual scenes
how_to_use: For any product serving users in mainland China, design the visible AI label into the surface itself: at the start or end of generated text, on images, and in the chat or generation UI; the mandatory national standard GB 45438-2025 gives the exact label methods.
zh: 国家网信办等四部门《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》，2025-09-01 起施行：生成的文本、图片、音频、视频、虚拟场景须加显式标识（内容或交互界面中用户可感知的文字、声音、图形）与隐式标识（元数据）。
zh_how: 面向中国大陆用户的产品，把显式 AI 标识直接设计进界面：生成文本的开头或结尾、图片上、对话或生成界面中；具体标识方法见强制性国家标准 GB 45438-2025。
caveats: Orientation, not legal advice; check the CAC notice and GB 45438-2025 for the exact placement rules.

name: EU AI Act Article 50: transparency obligations
best_for: The EU rule that people must be told when they interact with an AI system and that synthetic content must be marked in a machine-readable, detectable way; applies from 2026-08-02
how_to_use: Design the disclosure into the first interaction (an assistant must say it is AI unless obvious), label deepfakes and AI-written public-interest text visibly, and make sure generated media carry machine-readable marks.
zh: 欧盟《人工智能法》第 50 条透明义务：与 AI 系统交互时须告知用户，合成内容须以机器可读、可检测的方式标记；2026-08-02 起适用。
caveats: Unofficial but faithful reading site; the binding text is on EUR-Lex. Orientation, not legal advice.

name: v0 by Vercel
best_for: Prompt-to-app generator that builds and deploys full-stack web apps, with a visual design mode, reusable design systems and a large community template gallery (apps, landing pages, components, dashboards)
how_to_use: Use for fast throwaway variants, then apply this suite's brief, direction and critique discipline to the output; browse /templates to see what current AI-generated UI looks like, which is also the look to diverge from
zh: Vercel 的提示词生成应用工具，带可视化设计模式和海量社区模板；快速出可弃方案，再按自己的流程改。
caveats: Its templates show the current default AI look; use them to see what to diverge from.
Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: Superdesign
best_for: Open-source design agent that lives in the IDE and generates UI variants side by side
how_to_use: Reference for the parallel-variants workflow
zh: 开源设计 agent，住在 IDE 里并排生成多个 UI 变体；参考它并行出稿的工作流。

name: Google Stitch
best_for: Google Labs' AI UI designer: generates screens and variants from prompts, reads and writes DESIGN.md, and exposes projects to agents through an MCP server
how_to_use: Use for fast visual variants from a DESIGN.md, then take the chosen direction into code and critique it like any other draft; connect the MCP server to generate or edit screens from the agent.
zh: Google Labs 的 AI 界面设计工具：按提示生成界面与变体、读写 DESIGN.md，并通过 MCP 把项目开放给 agent；快速出变体后再落到代码并评审。
caveats: The app and docs are JavaScript-only for plain fetches.
Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: Figma Make
best_for: Figma's prompt-to-app tool that turns prompts and existing frames into working React prototypes
how_to_use: Use when the team lives in Figma and needs a clickable prototype from existing frames; bring the result back through this suite's critique before treating it as a design.
zh: Figma 的提示词生成应用工具，可把提示与现有画板变成可运行的 React 原型；团队常驻 Figma 时用来出可点击原型。
caveats: Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: Relume
best_for: AI sitemap and wireframe builder for marketing sites, backed by a large component library for Figma, Webflow and React
how_to_use: Use to settle information architecture and section order before visual design, then throw away its default look.
zh: AI 生成营销站的站点地图与线框，背后是面向 Figma、Webflow、React 的大型组件库；做视觉前先用它定信息架构和区块顺序。

name: Lovart
best_for: AI design agent on an infinite canvas that produces logos, brand kits, posters, social graphics and video
how_to_use: Use for exploratory brand and campaign assets; every output still needs an art-direction pass and a licence check before use.
zh: 无限画布上的 AI 设计 agent，产出 Logo、品牌套件、海报、社媒图与视频；适合探索品牌和活动物料，仍需人工艺术指导。
caveats: Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: Jimeng AI (即梦)
best_for: ByteDance's image and video generator with a smart canvas, strong at understanding Chinese prompts and rendering Chinese text in images
how_to_use: Use for mood images, key-visual drafts and short motion studies; check the commercial-use terms and label AI output as Chinese rules require before shipping.
zh: 字节跳动的图片与视频生成工具（含智能画布），中文提示理解与图中中文文字表现较好；用于情绪图、主视觉草稿与短动效。
zh_how: 用来做情绪图、主视觉草稿和短动效研究；上线前核对商用条款，并按国内规定给 AI 内容加标识。
caveats: Outputs must carry AI labels in China (see cn-ai-content-labelling).
Fast-moving: check the page date and the installed version before relying on details recorded here (2026-09-27).

name: LiblibAI (哩布哩布)
best_for: Large Chinese community of image-generation models and style LoRAs with online generation
how_to_use: Use to find a style model for a consistent illustration set; check each model's licence and commercial terms individually.
zh: 国内大型图像生成模型与风格 LoRA 社区，可在线生成；找统一插画风格的模型，逐个核对模型授权。
caveats: JavaScript-only for agents (34 characters of text on 2026-09-27).

name: Anthropic frontend-design skill
best_for: Anthropic's own short skill for distinctive front-end aesthetics: commit to a bold direction, avoid generic AI looks, mind typography, colour, motion, composition
how_to_use: Read it as the minimal baseline any design skill must beat; the companion post (2025-11-12) explains the mechanism, distributional convergence, and ships a ~400-token aesthetics prompt
zh: Anthropic 官方前端审美 skill：选定大胆方向、避开 AI 套路脸、盯字体色彩动效构图；当底线基准读。

name: Impeccable
best_for: One design skill with 24 commands (shape, critique, audit, polish, distill, bolder, quieter, harden, animate...), a PRODUCT.md that records durable product truth, live in-browser variant iteration, and a catalogue of AI-design tells with deterministic detectors that need no LLM
how_to_use: Read /slop for the rule catalogue (each rule tagged CLI, browser, LLM-only or optional) and borrow the PRODUCT.md idea; npx impeccable detect src/ runs the deterministic rules without an LLM. The Chinese edition at impeccable.cn may lag the English site.
zh: 单个设计技能含二十四条命令与一份 AI 味规则目录，规则可无 LLM 确定性检测；Apache-2.0。
