zh_how: 读 /slop 规则目录（每条标注 CLI、浏览器、仅 LLM 或可选），借鉴 PRODUCT.md 的做法；npx impeccable detect src/ 可不用 LLM 跑确定性规则。中文站 impeccable.cn 可能比英文站滞后。

name: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
best_for: Concise, opinionated rules for interactions, animation, layout, content, forms, performance and design, shipped with an agent-readable file
how_to_use: Give the agent the raw AGENTS.md (MUST, SHOULD and NEVER rules for keyboard, focus, forms, animation, layout, content and performance) as a review checklist for web UI.
zh: Vercel 的网页界面规则集，覆盖交互、动效、表单与性能；仓库里的 AGENTS.md 可当评审清单，MIT。

name: taste-skill
best_for: Popular anti-slop front-end skill: brief inference, three dials (variance, motion, density), real design systems, pre-flight check
how_to_use: Borrow the design-read and dial ideas; scope is landing pages and portfolios only
zh: 流行的反模板化前端技能：读简报、三个拨杆（变化、动效、密度）、真实设计系统加交付前检查；MIT。

name: UI UX Pro Max
best_for: Searchable CSV knowledge base of styles, palettes, font pairings and UX rules with a design-system generator
how_to_use: Useful as a lookup table; its recommendations are generic without a real brief
zh: 可检索的风格、配色、字体搭配与 UX 规则知识库，附设计系统生成器；当查询表用，缺真实 brief 时建议偏泛；MIT。

name: UI Skills
best_for: Opinionated constraint lists for agents building interfaces
how_to_use: Compare its constraints with your own rules
zh: 给构建界面的 agent 用的强硬约束清单，拿它和自己的规则对照查漏补缺；MIT。

name: interface-design
best_for: Skill focused on keeping design decisions consistent across sessions for dashboards and apps
how_to_use: Idea worth borrowing: persist decisions in a system file
zh: 专注让跨会话设计决策保持一致的 skill，面向仪表盘和应用；可借鉴的思路：把决策存进系统文件；MIT。

name: Stitch skills
best_for: Agent skills for Google Stitch: prompt enhancement, DESIGN.md synthesis, screen generation through MCP
how_to_use: Use when a Stitch MCP server is available for fast visual variants
zh: Google Stitch 的 agent 技能集：提示词增强、综合生成 DESIGN.md、经 MCP 出高保真界面稿；做快速视觉变体时用；Apache-2.0。

name: awesome-agent-skills
best_for: Directory of agent skills across vendors, including design skills
how_to_use: Track new design skills to analyse
zh: 各家 agent skill 的汇总目录，其中包含设计类条目；想跟踪新出现的设计 skill 时定期翻它；MIT。

name: Emil Kowalski's skills
best_for: Design-engineering skills from the author of Sonner and Vaul, including review-animations, a motion critique an agent can run on UI code
how_to_use: Borrow review-animations as the motion critique rubric; install with npx skills add emilkowalski/skills. His writing is in emil-kowalski (motion).
zh: Sonner、Vaul 作者的设计工程 skill 集，含可在 UI 代码上运行的动效评审 review-animations；动效评审可直接借用。

name: Motion AI Kit
best_for: Motion's official skill and MCP server: current Motion docs for the agent, plus CSS spring generation, a transition editor and MotionScore performance audits
how_to_use: Install it so the agent queries current Motion APIs instead of stale training data; with Motion+ ask it to audit animations for render cost before shipping.
zh: Motion 官方 skill 与 MCP：让 agent 查最新 Motion 文档，另有 CSS 弹簧生成、过渡编辑器与 MotionScore 性能审计（后几项需 Motion+）。
caveats: Documentation search is free; CSS spring generation, MotionScore audits and example source need a paid Motion+ licence.

name: Rams
best_for: Commercial design-review engine that scores UI changes 0-100 against 348 published rules in nine categories (including one for AI anti-patterns), via a skill, an MCP server or a GitHub app
how_to_use: Read the public rule categories as a benchmark for your own critique rubric; the free skill gives a taste, scoring needs a plan.
zh: 商业化设计评审引擎：按 348 条公开规则（九类，含一类 AI 套路）给 UI 改动打 0-100 分，可作 skill、MCP 或 GitHub App；拿它的规则分类对标自己的评审量表。

name: skills.sh
best_for: Vercel's open agent-skills directory with install counts, plus the npx skills installer
how_to_use: Check install counts to see which design skills are actually used, and install with npx skills add owner/repo.
zh: Vercel 运营的开放 agent skill 目录，带安装量排行与 npx skills 安装器；看安装量判断哪些设计 skill 真有人用。

name: DESIGN.md specification
best_for: Google Labs' open format for describing a visual identity to coding agents in one Markdown file (YAML tokens plus prose), with a CLI that lints contrast and structure and diffs two versions
how_to_use: Write system/DESIGN.md in this shape, then run npx @google/design.md lint DESIGN.md (structured JSON findings, including WCAG contrast) and diff against the previous version; Stitch reads and writes the same file.
zh: Google Labs 的开放格式，用一个 Markdown 文件向 AI 代理描述设计系统；按此产出 DESIGN.md 供 Stitch 等消费；Apache-2.0。
zh_how: 按此格式写 system/DESIGN.md，然后运行 npx @google/design.md lint DESIGN.md（输出结构化 JSON，含 WCAG 对比度检查），并与上一版做 diff；Stitch 读写的是同一种文件。
caveats: The token schema version is still 'alpha' (npm @google/design.md 0.4.0 on 2026-09-27); pin the version you validate against.

name: awesome-design-md
best_for: Collection of DESIGN.md files describing the visual systems of well-known products
how_to_use: Use as style-DNA study material, never as a licence to clone a brand
zh: 收集知名产品视觉体系的 DESIGN.md 合集，可当风格基因研究材料；学方法可以，照抄品牌不行。
license: MIT (github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md); brands belong to their owners
caveats: The files describe other companies' brands: study the structure, never ship a clone.

name: Refero Styles
best_for: Design systems extracted from 2,000+ real product sites (colours, type, spacing, components), each with a DESIGN.md
how_to_use: Use as style-DNA study material and to seed the structure of a DESIGN.md; never ship a clone of a brand.
zh: 从 2000+ 个真实产品网站提取的设计风格（颜色、字体、间距、组件），每套附 DESIGN.md；当风格基因研究材料，别用来克隆品牌。
caveats: Extracted from other companies' sites; study the structure, not the brand.

name: llms.txt
best_for: The convention of a /llms.txt Markdown index (and often llms-full.txt) that points agents at clean documentation; many design systems now ship one
how_to_use: Before scraping a design system's site, try <site>/llms.txt: Carbon, Ant Design, Atlassian, Cloudscape, TDesign and AntV serve one (checked 2026-09-27). Publish one for your own system's docs.
zh: 在站点根目录放 /llms.txt（Markdown 索引，常配 llms-full.txt）为 agent 指路的约定；不少设计系统已提供。
zh_how: 抓取设计系统网站前先试 <站点>/llms.txt：Carbon、Ant Design、Atlassian、Cloudscape、TDesign、AntV 都有（2026-09-27 核对）；自己的设计系统文档也发布一份。

name: AGENTS.md
best_for: The open Markdown convention for repository instructions to coding agents (a README for agents), now stewarded under the Linux Foundation
how_to_use: Put the project's design rules (tokens file, component library, forbidden patterns, how to run the visual checks) in AGENTS.md so any coding agent picks them up; Vercel's interface guidelines ship in this form.
zh: 给 coding agent 的仓库说明文件开放约定（写给 agent 的 README），现由 Linux 基金会下的 Agentic AI Foundation 管理。

name: Agent Skills specification
best_for: The open SKILL.md format this suite is written in: a folder with SKILL.md (name, description, instructions) plus optional scripts, references and templates
how_to_use: Check a skill's frontmatter and folder layout against the spec before publishing, so it installs in any compatible agent.
zh: 本套件所用的开放 SKILL.md 格式：一个文件夹包含 SKILL.md（名称、描述、指令）及可选的脚本、参考资料与模板；发布 skill 前对照检查。

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
best_for: Gives an agent a real Chrome: screenshots, DOM, computed styles, performance traces
how_to_use: Add it with npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest; use it as the eyes of the render-and-look loop: screenshots at several sizes, console errors, computed styles and a performance trace for the page you just built.
zh: 给 agent 一只真 Chrome：截图、DOM、计算样式和性能轨迹都能取；渲染-查看闭环的眼睛。Apache-2.0。

name: Figma MCP server
best_for: Figma's official MCP server: design context, variables, components and screenshots for code generation, and since 2026 use_figma, a general-purpose tool that creates and edits Figma Design, FigJam and Slides files
how_to_use: Connect the remote server (https://mcp.figma.com/mcp) when the source of truth is a Figma file; call get_design_context and get_screenshot for a frame before writing code, and use Code Connect so it returns the project's real components.
zh: Figma 官方 MCP：为生成代码提供设计上下文、变量、组件与截图；2026 年起新增 use_figma，可创建和编辑 Figma 设计稿、FigJam 与 Slides。
zh_how: 设计稿是事实来源时接入远程服务（https://mcp.figma.com/mcp）；写代码前先对画框调用 get_design_context 与 get_screenshot，并配置 Code Connect 让它返回项目里的真实组件。
caveats: The remote server is available on all seats and plans; the desktop server needs a Dev or Full seat on a paid plan (help centre, 2026-09-27).
use_figma writes to files: review agent edits like code.

name: Framelink Figma MCP
best_for: Community MCP server that gives agents simplified Figma layout data
how_to_use: Alternative when the official server is unavailable
zh: 社区版 Figma MCP 服务，给 AI agent 喂简化后的布局数据；官方 MCP 不可用时的替代方案，MIT 协议。

name: shadcn/ui registry and MCP
best_for: Lets agents browse and install components from shadcn-compatible registries
how_to_use: Run pnpm dlx shadcn@latest mcp init --client claude (or cursor, vscode, codex) in the project, then ask the agent to list and add components from the configured registries instead of writing them from memory.
zh: 通过 MCP 让 agent 浏览并安装 shadcn 兼容注册表里的真实组件，避免凭空编造不存在的组件；MIT。

name: 21st MCP and CLI (formerly Magic MCP)
best_for: 21st.dev's CLI and MCP server: search the community component catalogue, read the real code, install a component with its dependencies, or sketch variants with AI
how_to_use: Search the catalogue for a component (pricing table, command menu) and install the real code rather than generating it; treat everything as a draft to restyle with the project's tokens.
zh: 21st.dev 的 CLI 与 MCP：检索社区组件库、读真实代码、连同依赖一起安装，或用 AI 草拟变体；装进来后按项目 token 重设样式。
caveats: Search is free with a daily install limit; AI sketching uses paid credits (2026-09-27).

name: Playwright MCP
best_for: Browser automation for agents through Playwright
how_to_use: Add it with npx @playwright/mcp@latest; it drives the page through accessibility snapshots, so use it for multi-viewport walkthroughs and flows, and a screenshot tool for visual judgement.
zh: 让代理通过 Playwright 操控浏览器的 MCP；当另一双眼睛用，适合多视口截图；Apache-2.0。

name: Storybook MCP
best_for: Storybook's official MCP addon: exposes the component manifest, docs and stories so agents reuse the project's real components instead of inventing new ones
how_to_use: Run npx storybook add @storybook/addon-mcp, start Storybook and point the agent at http://localhost:6006/mcp; ask it to query components before writing any new one.
zh: Storybook 官方 MCP 插件：把组件清单、文档与 stories 开放给 agent，让它复用项目里的真实组件而不是新造。
zh_how: 运行 npx storybook add @storybook/addon-mcp，启动 Storybook 后让 agent 连接 http://localhost:6006/mcp；写任何新组件前先让它查询已有组件。
caveats: The component manifest (docs toolset) works only on supported frameworks such as React and Vue 3 with Vite; other setups get no manifest.

name: Mobbin MCP
best_for: Lets agents search Mobbin's 600,000+ real product screens and flows in natural language
how_to_use: Use in the research step to pull three shipped precedents for a screen before designing it.
zh: 让 agent 用自然语言检索 Mobbin 上 60 万+ 真实产品界面与流程；研究阶段先拉三个已上线的先例再动笔。
caveats: Available on Pro and Team plans only (2026-09-27).

name: MasterGo Magic MCP
best_for: MasterGo's official MCP server that turns design files into a structured DSL for coding agents
how_to_use: Use when a Chinese team designs in MasterGo: connect with a personal token, fetch the DSL for a frame and generate code against the project's components.
zh: MasterGo 官方 MCP：把设计稿转成结构化 DSL 交给 coding agent；国内团队用 MasterGo 时接入。
zh_how: 国内团队在 MasterGo 里做设计时接入：用个人令牌连接，取某个画框的 DSL，再对照项目组件生成代码。注意 CVE-2026-15749 影响 0.2.0 及以下版本，请使用当前版本（2026-09-27 为 0.2.9）。
license: ISC (npm @mastergo/magic-mcp; no LICENSE file in the repository)
caveats: CVE-2026-15749 (path traversal in the c2d tool) affects versions up to 0.2.0; use a current release (0.2.9 on 2026-09-27).

name: Official MCP Registry
best_for: The protocol project's official registry of MCP servers, with a public JSON API
how_to_use: Search here for a vendor's official server before trusting a third-party listing; agents can query the API directly (for example ?search=figma returns com.figma.mcp/mcp and its remote URL).
zh: MCP 协议项目官方的服务器注册表，带公开 JSON API；找厂商 MCP 时先查这里，再信第三方列表。

name: WCAG 2.2 Quick Reference
best_for: Filterable list of every WCAG 2.2 success criterion with techniques
how_to_use: Filter to Level A and AA and to the technologies in scope, then cite criterion numbers (for example 1.4.3 contrast, 2.4.11 focus not obscured, 2.5.8 target size) in critiques. www.w3.org challenges bots: agents should read the w3c.github.io mirrors.
zh: 可按等级筛选的 WCAG 2.2 全部成功准则与技法速查；做无障碍评审时引用准则编号说话。
zh_how: 筛选 A 与 AA 级和相关技术后，在评审中直接引用准则编号（如 1.4.3 对比度、2.4.11 焦点不被遮挡、2.5.8 目标尺寸）。www.w3.org 会拦截机器访问，agent 请读 w3c.github.io 镜像。
caveats: www.w3.org answers plain fetches with a Cloudflare challenge (403 on 2026-09-27); the mirrors return 200.
WCAG 3 is a working draft: its contrast method is not decided and APCA is not part of it; keep WCAG 2.2 as the requirement.

name: GB/T 37668-2019 Internet content accessibility (信息技术 互联网内容无障碍可访问性技术要求与测试方法)
name_zh: GB/T 37668-2019 互联网内容无障碍可访问性技术要求与测试方法
best_for: China's national web and app accessibility standard (current since 2020-03-01): perceivable, operable, understandable and compatible requirements with test methods, closely aligned with WCAG 2.0
how_to_use: Cite it for products in mainland China; read the full text through the official 在线预览, and use the MIIT 适老化 specifications for the age-friendly additions.
zh: 中国互联网网页与移动应用无障碍的国家标准（2020-03-01 实施，现行）：可感知、可操作、可理解、兼容四类要求加测试方法，与 WCAG 2.0 基本对应。
zh_how: 面向中国大陆的产品引用它；全文在官方平台“在线预览”阅读，适老化的附加要求看工信部的适老化设计规范。
caveats: The official full-text preview needs a modern browser; plain fetches get only the metadata page.

name: China Internet age-friendly and accessibility platform (适老化及无障碍公共服务平台)
name_zh: 中国互联网应用适老化及无障碍公共服务平台
best_for: Home of MIIT's age-friendly (适老化) design specifications for websites and apps, the related standards (GB/T 37668, T/ISC 0007-2021) and the certification scheme
how_to_use: Open the APP spec before shipping a consumer app in China: in elder mode main text >= 18 dp/pt and main targets >= 60x60 dp, other targets >= 44x44 dp, contrast 4.5:1 (3:1 above 18 dp), line spacing 1.3, no ads or random pop-ups, a findable 长辈版 entry, close buttons only top-left, top-right or bottom-centre.
zh: 工信部适老化通用设计规范（网站与 APP）、相关标准（GB/T 37668、T/ISC 0007-2021）与认证的官方平台；面向国内用户的产品上线前必查。
zh_how: 国内消费级 App 上线前读 APP 适老化规范：长辈版主要文字不小于 18dp/pt、主要控件点击区不小于 60×60dp，其他页面不小于 44×44dp；对比度 4.5:1（大于 18dp 时 3:1）；行距 1.3 倍；长辈版不得出现广告和随机弹窗；“长辈版”入口可搜索可达；弹窗关闭按钮只能在左上、右上或底部居中。

entry_points.label: APP 适老化通用设计规范
互联网网站适老化通用设计规范

caveats: HTTP only: the https endpoint did not answer on 2026-09-27.

name: European Accessibility Act and EN 301 549
best_for: The EU law in force since 2025-06-28 for e-commerce, banking, e-books, transport ticketing and more, and EN 301 549, the harmonised standard whose web clauses follow WCAG 2.1 AA
how_to_use: Check whether the product falls in an EAA service category, then design to EN 301 549 (in practice WCAG 2.1 AA plus the non-web clauses for apps, documents and hardware).
zh: 欧盟《无障碍法案》（2025-06-28 起适用于电商、银行、电子书、交通票务等）与其协调标准 EN 301 549（网页部分对应 WCAG 2.1 AA）。
caveats: Member-state enforcement and exemptions (for example micro-enterprises) differ; this is orientation, not legal advice.

name: Section508.gov
best_for: US federal ICT accessibility: the Revised 508 Standards (WCAG 2.0 AA by reference), test methods and procurement guidance
how_to_use: Use when selling to US federal agencies: design to WCAG 2.x AA and read the test and conformance-report (ACR/VPAT) guidance that buyers ask for.
zh: 美国联邦 ICT 无障碍官方站：修订版 508 标准（引用 WCAG 2.0 AA）、测试方法与采购指引；面向美国联邦客户时读。

name: ADA Title II web and mobile rule (US DOJ)
best_for: The US Department of Justice rule requiring WCAG 2.1 AA for state and local government web content and mobile apps, with compliance dates
how_to_use: Check which deadline applies to the client; the technical bar is WCAG 2.1 AA, so design and test against that version.
zh: 美国司法部 ADA 第二章规则：州与地方政府的网站和移动应用须达到 WCAG 2.1 AA，含合规期限。
caveats: An interim final rule of 2026-04-20 moved the deadlines to 2027-04-26 (50,000+ population) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities); check the page for later changes.

name: axe-core and axe DevTools
best_for: The most widely embedded accessibility rules engine (behind axe DevTools, Lighthouse and many CI tools); runs in any browser page or test
how_to_use: In a render loop, inject axe with @axe-core/playwright (or run npx @axe-core/cli <url>) and fail on serious and critical violations; each result links a rule page with the fix. Then do the manual keyboard and screen-reader pass it cannot do.
zh: 嵌入最广的无障碍规则引擎（axe DevTools、Lighthouse 与大量 CI 工具都基于它），可在任意页面或测试中运行。
zh_how: 在渲染循环里用 @axe-core/playwright 注入（或运行 npx @axe-core/cli <url>），出现 serious 与 critical 就判失败；每条结果都链接到带修复方法的规则页。之后仍要人工做键盘与读屏检查。
caveats: Automated rules catch only part of WCAG; a clean run is not proof of access.
The extension's guided tests and the axe MCP server are paid.

name: WAVE
best_for: WebAIM's evaluator that overlays errors, contrast failures and structure (headings, landmarks, ARIA) directly on the page
how_to_use: Deep-link a report with wave.webaim.org/report#/<url> or use the extension for pages behind login; pair it with axe, since each catches different issues. The WAVE API is paid per credit.
zh: WebAIM 的可视化检测工具，把错误、对比度问题和结构（标题、地标、ARIA）直接标在页面上。
zh_how: 用 wave.webaim.org/report#/<网址> 直接打开报告，需登录的页面用浏览器扩展；与 axe 搭配使用，两者能发现的问题不同。WAVE API 按次付费。

name: Accessibility Insights
best_for: Microsoft's free tools for web, Windows and Android, with a guided Assessment that walks through the manual checks automation misses
how_to_use: Run FastPass on every build, and the Assessment (tab stops, focus, landmarks, headings) before a release; export the report as evidence.
zh: 微软免费的无障碍工具（Web、Windows、Android），Assessment 模式会引导完成自动化测不到的人工检查。

name: Colour Contrast Analyser (CCA)
best_for: Free desktop contrast checker whose eyedropper samples any pixel on screen: text over photos, gradients, screenshots and design files
how_to_use: Use when the colours are not in code; sample the lightest background pixel behind the text and read the WCAG AA and AAA results.
zh: 免费桌面对比度检测器，吸管可取屏幕任意像素（照片上的文字、渐变、截图、设计稿）；颜色不在代码里时用。

name: Pa11y
best_for: Open-source command-line accessibility tester (HTML_CodeSniffer or axe runners) with a CI variant for lists of URLs
how_to_use: Run npx pa11y <url> for a quick check, or pa11y-ci over a sitemap in CI; set --runner axe to match axe results elsewhere.
zh: 开源命令行无障碍检测工具（可选 HTML_CodeSniffer 或 axe 引擎），pa11y-ci 可批量检查 URL 列表。

name: Stark
best_for: Accessibility suite for design tools and code: contrast, vision simulation, focus order and alt-text annotations
how_to_use: Use inside Figma to annotate focus order, headings and alt text before hand-off, so the implementer does not have to guess.
zh: 设计工具与代码中的无障碍套件：对比度、色觉模拟、焦点顺序与替代文本标注；交付前在 Figma 里标好焦点顺序。
caveats: Most annotation and audit features are paid.

name: NVDA screen reader
best_for: The free, open-source Windows screen reader most used for manual testing, alongside VoiceOver on Apple devices
how_to_use: Do one manual pass per key flow: navigate by headings (H), landmarks (D) and form fields (F), and listen for unlabelled controls and announcements that never come.
zh: 免费开源的 Windows 读屏软件，手动测试最常用（苹果设备用系统自带的 VoiceOver）。
zh_how: 每条关键流程人工走一遍：按标题（H）、地标（D）、表单控件（F）跳转，留意没有名称的控件和应该播报却没播报的变化。
caveats: Windows only.

name: ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
best_for: Canonical keyboard interaction and ARIA roles for each widget pattern (combobox, menu, tabs, dialog)
how_to_use: Read the pattern page (combobox, menu button, tabs, dialog, grid) for keyboard interaction and ARIA roles before specifying any custom interactive component, and prefer the native element when one exists. Agents: the pattern sources are on GitHub.
zh: W3C 官方交互模式指南，给出每种组件的键盘行为与 ARIA 角色；写自定义交互组件规格前必读。
caveats: www.w3.org challenges bots (403 on 2026-09-27); the old w3c.github.io/aria-practices mirror now shows only 'Content Moved'.

name: Inclusive Components
best_for: Accessible component patterns explained in depth (toggles, menus, tabs, cards, notifications)
how_to_use: Read the matching article before building the component
zh: 深入讲解无障碍组件模式：开关、菜单、标签页、卡片、通知；动手做组件前先读对应文章。
caveats: No new articles for years; the patterns remain sound but check current browser and screen-reader support.

name: A11Y Project checklist
best_for: Plain-language checklist in which every item links the WCAG criterion it maps to, grouped by content, code, keyboard, images, headings, forms, media, appearance and animation
how_to_use: Walk the checklist by section (content, global code, keyboard, images, headings, forms, media, appearance, animation) before hand-off; each item links the WCAG criterion it maps to.
zh: 大白话写成的 WCAG 无障碍检查清单；设计正式交付前先逐项过一遍。

name: Sara Soueidan and Practical Accessibility
best_for: Deep articles on accessible front-end (accessible names, custom controls, SVG, CSS-generated content) and the Practical Accessibility video course for designers and developers
how_to_use: Read the matching article before building a custom control or an SVG icon system; the course is the structured route for a team that designs and builds its own components.
zh: Sara Soueidan 关于无障碍前端（可访问名称、自定义控件、SVG、CSS 生成内容）的深度文章，以及面向设计与开发的 Practical Accessibility 课程。

name: MDN Accessibility and ARIA reference
best_for: Plain, agent-readable reference for accessible HTML and every ARIA role, state and property, with browser-support notes
how_to_use: Look up the role or attribute before using it (for example aria-expanded, role=switch); the first rule on every ARIA page is to use the native element when one exists.
zh: 面向 agent 也易读的无障碍 HTML 与 ARIA 角色、状态、属性参考，附浏览器支持说明。

name: Adrian Roselli
best_for: Rigorous accessibility testing of real patterns (tables, disclosures, toggles, dialogs) with screen-reader results across browsers
how_to_use: Search his site for the component before inventing an ARIA pattern; the posts show what actually gets announced, which the specs cannot.
zh: 对真实组件模式（表格、折叠、开关、对话框）做严格无障碍测试，并给出各浏览器与读屏软件的实际结果；自创 ARIA 模式前先搜。

name: freee Accessibility Guidelines
best_for: Practical, versioned accessibility guidelines and checks from a Japanese SaaS company, each mapped to WCAG
how_to_use: Use as a concrete checklist when WCAG prose is too abstract, especially for CJK interfaces.
zh: 日本 freee 公司按版本发布的无障碍指南与检查项，逐条对应 WCAG；WCAG 条文太抽象时用它落地。

name: The WebAIM Million
best_for: Annual automated scan of the top million home pages: which failures are most common, so a review knows where to look first
how_to_use: Check the six failure types that account for about 96% of detected errors in the 2026 report (low-contrast text on 83.9% of pages, missing alt text, missing form labels, empty links, empty buttons, missing document language) before anything else.
zh: WebAIM 每年对百万个网站首页的自动检测报告：哪些错误最常见，评审时先查哪里。
zh_how: 先查 2026 年报告里占已检出错误约 96% 的六类问题：低对比度文字（83.9% 的页面）、图片缺替代文本、表单缺标签、空链接、空按钮、缺文档语言。

name: Microsoft Inclusive Design
best_for: Toolkit framing disability as permanent, temporary and situational
how_to_use: Download the toolkit (manual and activity cards) and use the Persona Spectrum (permanent, temporary, situational) when writing a brief, so one constraint (one arm, a baby in arm, an arm injury) improves the design for all three.
zh: 微软包容性设计工具包，把残障分为永久、临时与情境三种；写 brief 时用它的 persona spectrum。

name: UK Home Office accessibility posters
best_for: Do and don't posters for designing for users on the autistic spectrum, with low vision, dyslexia, anxiety, motor or hearing needs, and screen-reader users
how_to_use: Put the relevant poster next to the design in a critique; translations exist in many languages.
zh: 英国内政部无障碍设计海报：针对自闭症、低视力、读写障碍、焦虑、行动与听力障碍及读屏用户的宜与忌；评审时对照。

name: Inclusive Design Principles
best_for: Seven short principles (comparable experience, consider situation, be consistent, give control, offer choice, prioritise content, add value) with examples
how_to_use: Use the seven headings as critique prompts for any interface, beyond pass-or-fail criteria.
zh: 七条包容性设计原则（体验可比、考虑情境、保持一致、给予控制、提供选择、内容优先、增加价值），可当评审提问清单。

name: Inclusive Design Toolkit (University of Cambridge)
best_for: Research-based toolkit for measuring how many people a design excludes, with capability data, an exclusion calculator and impairment simulators, strong on ageing users
how_to_use: Estimate exclusion for the key task (vision, hearing, thinking, reach and dexterity) to argue for a change with numbers rather than opinion.
zh: 剑桥大学的包容性设计工具包：用能力数据、排除计算器和障碍模拟估算一个设计会排除多少人，适老化论证尤其有用。

name: Making Content Usable for People with Cognitive and Learning Disabilities (W3C)
best_for: W3C guidance and design patterns for cognitive and learning disabilities: clear purpose, findable help, preventing mistakes, memory load, plain language
how_to_use: Read the design patterns section before designing forms, error recovery or multi-step tasks; it covers needs WCAG's criteria mostly miss.
zh: W3C 关于认知与学习障碍的指南和设计模式：目的清晰、帮助可找、防错、减轻记忆负担、简明语言；设计表单与多步骤任务前读。
caveats: The canonical copy at www.w3.org/TR/coga-usable/ is bot-walled; this is the editor's draft mirror.

name: 60fps.design
best_for: Screen recordings of UI animation in shipped apps (mostly iOS), filterable by interaction pattern and app category; the best single source for mobile motion
how_to_use: Deep-link /shots/filter/<pattern> (loading, onboarding, navigation...) or /apps/category/<category>; play at 0.25-0.5x and write down duration, easing, origin and what stays still before specifying a transition
zh: 头部 App 界面动效的录屏库，按应用与交互类型筛选；移动端动效参考首选，放慢速度逐帧看。
zh_how: 深链 /shots/filter/<交互类型>（loading、onboarding、navigation 等）或 /apps/category/<类目>；0.25–0.5 倍速播放，记下时长、缓动、起点和哪些元素没动，再写动效规格。

name: Spotted in Prod
best_for: Short recordings of standout interaction details in shipped iOS apps, browsable by app and by style tag (minimal, skeuomorphic, playful, dense...)
how_to_use: Browse Apps or a style tag, open a clip and note trigger, duration and easing; it is iOS only, so translate the idiom before using it on Android or the web
zh: 只收 iOS：上线 App 里出色交互细节的短录屏，可按应用和风格标签浏览；移植到安卓或网页前先转换平台习惯。

name: Ripplix
best_for: 7,000+ recorded UI animations from 1,000+ real apps and sites (mobile, web, watch, AR/VR), filterable by element (onboarding, success, dropdown, chart...) and industry
how_to_use: Start from All elements, pick the element you are designing and compare five products at reduced speed; note timing and what does not move
zh: 7000+ 条真实 App 与网站的界面动效录屏，覆盖移动、网页、手表与 AR/VR，可按元素（引导、成功、下拉、图表等）和行业筛选。
zh_how: 从 All elements 进入，选正在设计的元素，慢放对比五个产品，记下节奏和哪些东西不动。
caveats: Pro plan unlocks the full library; some clips are marketing sites rather than product UI

name: Apple Design Awards
best_for: Winners and finalists each year with video of the shipped app; the Interaction and Delight and Fun categories are a curated reel of platform-native motion
how_to_use: Watch the Interaction category videos frame by frame for gesture-driven, interruptible transitions; compare with Apple's HIG before copying an idiom
zh: 苹果设计大奖历年获奖与入围作品，每个都有上线 App 的视频；「交互」与「趣味」类别就是原生动效的精选合集。

name: Detail
best_for: Curated short recordings of the small decisions that make shipped software feel considered, tagged Design, Interactivity, Motion, Copywriting, Accessibility and Easter Egg
how_to_use: Filter to Motion or Interactivity and study one detail at a time: what triggers it, how long it runs and why it earns its place; a Chinese edition lives at /zh
zh: 收录让产品显得用心的细小设计决策，每条配短录屏，分设计、交互、动效、文案、无障碍、彩蛋六类；有中文版。
zh_how: 中文版在 detail.design/zh；按「动效」「交互」筛选，一条条看触发方式、时长，以及它为什么值得存在。
caveats: Some in-depth pages are for members only

name: Codrops
best_for: Experimental web motion with source and tutorials: scroll effects, page transitions, WebGL, typography animation
how_to_use: Start from the Creative Hub and filter by technique (page transition, scroll, WebGL, text); every demo links its article and source; retime and restyle before reuse
zh: 实验性网页动效博客，附源码与教程：滚动、页面过渡、WebGL、字体动画；演示授权逐个确认。
zh_how: 从 Creative Hub 按技巧（页面转场、滚动、WebGL、文字）筛选；每个演示都附文章与源码；复用前按自己的动效 token 重调时长与样式。

entry_points.label: Creative Hub (tutorials and 1,000+ demos; replaces the Collective)

caveats: Demo licences vary; read each demo's licence before shipping its code or assets
Expressive, often heavy effects: check performance and prefers-reduced-motion before using them in product UI

name: Made With GSAP
best_for: Paid, growing collection of GSAP web effects (118 in September 2026, one added weekly) with explained, copyable code, plus a showcase page
how_to_use: Browse the effect previews for scroll, cursor and drag ideas; subscribe only if the team will reuse the code, and retime every effect to your motion tokens
zh: 付费的 GSAP 网页动效合集（2026 年 9 月共 118 个，每周新增），附讲解与可复制代码，另有站点展示页；找滚动、鼠标、拖拽类效果的灵感。
caveats: Full code needs a subscription (20-25 EUR per month in September 2026)
Expressive effects: check performance and prefers-reduced-motion before using them in product UI

name: LottieFiles
best_for: Huge library of Lottie animations plus tooling
how_to_use: Search, filter to free, open the file and read its licence; prefer dotLottie (.lottie) for smaller files, and retime to your motion tokens before shipping
zh: 最大的 Lottie 动画库加配套工具；筛选免费素材，每个动画上线前单独核对许可。
license: Lottie Simple License for free files; check each
caveats: Cloudflare wall and sign-in: agents cannot fetch it, send the link
Free files use the Lottie Simple License; check each file before shipping

name: Olivier Larose blog
best_for: Tutorials that rebuild award-site animations step by step
how_to_use: Pick an effect from the sidebar (scroll, mouse, page transitions, 3D, shaders) and follow the step-by-step React and Next.js build; retime it to your motion tokens before reuse
zh: 逐步复刻获奖网站动效的教程博客；找到想要的效果，照着搭建过程做。
zh_how: 从侧栏按类别（滚动、鼠标、页面转场、3D、shader）选效果，跟着 React/Next.js 分步实现；复用前按自己的动效 token 重调时长。

name: nan.fyi
best_for: Interactive essays on SVG paths, layout animation and how motion works under the hood
how_to_use: Read 'A Deep Dive Into SVG Path Commands' before hand-writing icon or morph paths, and the Framer Motion posts (keys, Magic Motion) before building layout animation
zh: 交互式技术随笔，把 SVG 路径、布局动画的底层原理讲到能动手；手写 path 或 FLIP 前读。

name: CodePen
best_for: The largest collection of front-end demos: almost every interaction, CSS and SVG animation technique has a working pen to fork
how_to_use: Search the technique, fork the pen and read the code; judge the timing yourself, most pens are experiments rather than production patterns
zh: 最大的前端演示集合，几乎每种交互、CSS 与 SVG 动画技巧都有可运行的示例可 fork；站点拦截爬虫，把链接发给用户。
caveats: Cloudflare wall blocks scripted fetches: send the link
Public pens are MIT-licensed under CodePen's terms, but images, fonts and libraries they load keep their own licences

name: Easing Wizard
best_for: Generate and preview bezier, spring, bounce and wiggle easings, exported as CSS including linear()
how_to_use: Tune by eye with the preview, then copy the CSS
zh: 缓动曲线生成器，可视调 bezier、弹簧、回弹等效果并实时预览，直接导出含 linear() 的 CSS；调动画手感时用。

name: Easing Functions Cheat Sheet
best_for: Visual reference of the named easing functions with CSS and maths
how_to_use: Look up a named curve to copy its cubic-bezier; for product UI stay in the ease-out family (quart, quint, expo) and keep elastic and bounce for rare playful moments
zh: 具名缓动函数的图解速查，附曲线形状与 cubic-bezier 值；挑好曲线直接抄参数。
caveats: A catalogue of Penner curves: most elastic, back and bounce curves are wrong for product UI; springs suit gestures better

name: Linear easing generator
best_for: Converts a JS easing or SVG path into a CSS linear() function (springs and bounces in pure CSS)
how_to_use: Paste a spring function, copy the linear() output
zh: 把 JS 缓动函数或 SVG 路径转成 CSS linear() 的小工具；想用纯 CSS 做弹簧与回弹动画时直接抄结果。

name: cubic-bezier.com
best_for: Classic bezier editor with side-by-side comparison
how_to_use: Drag the handles, then press Go to race your curve against a library curve at the duration you plan to ship; copy the cubic-bezier() value into a motion token
zh: 经典缓动曲线编辑器，支持并排对比；调自定义曲线时和预设对照手感。
zh_how: 拖动控制柄，点 Go! 让自定义曲线和库里的曲线在计划的时长下并排跑一遍，再把 cubic-bezier() 值写进动效 token。

name: CSS Spring Easing Generator
best_for: Turns a spring given as perceptual duration and bounce into a CSS linear() easing plus the matching real duration (--spring-easing and --spring-duration)
how_to_use: Enter the duration and bounce from the motion spec (the model SwiftUI and Motion use), copy both custom properties and always apply them together
zh: 把以感知时长与回弹度描述的弹簧（SwiftUI、Motion 用的同一模型）转成 CSS linear() 缓动和对应的实际时长两个变量；在网页上还原原生弹簧手感时用。
zh_how: 填入动效规格里的时长与 bounce，复制 --spring-easing 与 --spring-duration 两个变量并一起使用。

name: Scroll-driven Animations
best_for: Demos and visual tools for CSS scroll-driven animations (timeline ranges, view progress)
how_to_use: Use the range visualiser to pick animation-range values (entry, exit, cover, contain) and copy the CSS; test with prefers-reduced-motion on
zh: CSS 滚动驱动动画的演示与可视化工具；写 animation-range 时用它的区间可视化器校准。
caveats: Check current browser support (Baseline) before relying on scroll-driven animations; ship a static fallback

name: View Transitions demos
best_for: Reference demos for same-document and cross-document view transitions
how_to_use: Copy the pattern closest to the navigation being designed
zh: View Transitions 官方演示集，同文档与跨文档都有；照抄最接近你要做的导航过渡的模式。

name: Jitter
best_for: Browser-based motion design tool with Lottie, video and GIF export
how_to_use: Import frames from Figma, animate on the timeline and export 4K video, GIF or Lottie; suited to marketing and brand motion rather than in-product UI
zh: 浏览器里的动效设计工具，可导出 Lottie、视频与 GIF；适合做营销动画，不主攻产品内界面。
zh_how: 从 Figma 导入画面，在时间轴上做动画，导出 4K 视频、GIF 或 Lottie；适合营销与品牌动效，不适合产品内交互。

name: Rive
best_for: Editor and runtimes for interactive vector animation driven by state machines
how_to_use: Use when an animation must react to input across platforms; open marketplace files to study their state machines before building your own
zh: 状态机驱动的交互式矢量动画编辑器加多端运行时；动画需要响应用户输入、跨平台复用时选它。

name: Lottie format docs
best_for: Readable reference of the Lottie JSON format (layers, shapes, keyframes, easing); the formal spec is now published by the Lottie Animation Community
how_to_use: Keep it open when generating or editing Lottie by code; check structure against the official spec linked here
zh: Lottie JSON 格式的人读版参考（图层、形状、关键帧、缓动），正式规范由 Lottie Animation Community 发布；用代码生成或修改 Lottie 时必备。

name: Animista
best_for: Library of CSS keyframe presets with generated code
how_to_use: Starting point only; retime and re-ease everything
zh: CSS 关键帧预设库，直接生成代码；只当起点，时长与缓动都要自己重调。

name: ProtoPie
best_for: High-fidelity interaction prototyping without code: variables, conditions, device sensors and multi-screen links, playable on real devices
how_to_use: Prototype the one interaction whose feel is contested (a gesture, a sheet, a car HMI screen), test it on the device, then hand the timings to engineering
zh: 无需写代码的高保真交互原型工具：变量、条件、手机传感器与多屏联动，可在真机上运行；国内外车机与硬件团队常用。
zh_how: 只为「手感有争议」的那个交互做原型（手势、抽屉、车机屏），真机测试后把时长与曲线交给开发。

name: Chrome DevTools: Animations panel
best_for: Inspect, slow down (25% or 10%), scrub and edit the timing of CSS and Web Animations on any live page; the fastest way to measure a reference site's motion
how_to_use: Open a reference site, record in the Animations panel, replay at 10% and read durations, delays and easing; agents can do the same over CDP (Animation.setPlaybackRate) while capturing frames
zh: 在任何线上页面检查、慢放（25% 或 10%）、拖动并修改 CSS 与 Web Animations 的时间参数；量参考网站动效最快的办法。
zh_how: 打开参考站点，在 Animations 面板录制后以 10% 速度回放，读出时长、延迟和缓动；智能体可通过 CDP 的 Animation.setPlaybackRate 同样慢放并截帧。

name: Lottielab
best_for: Browser editor for Lottie animations: import from Figma or SVG, animate on a timeline, export Lottie, GIF or MP4 without After Effects
how_to_use: Import the static frames from Figma, animate, keep file size small, then export dotLottie for product use
zh: 浏览器里的 Lottie 动画编辑器：从 Figma 或 SVG 导入、时间轴编排，导出 Lottie、GIF、MP4，不必用 After Effects。
caveats: Lottie export needs the Pro plan; the free plan exports GIF and MP4

name: WWDC18: Designing Fluid Interfaces
best_for: The foundational talk on gesture-driven, interruptible, redirectable interfaces
how_to_use: Watch before designing any drag, sheet or swipe interaction
zh: WWDC18 经典演讲，讲手势驱动、可中断、可改向的界面；做拖拽、抽屉、滑动交互前先看。

name: WWDC23: Animate with springs
best_for: Explains springs through duration and bounce instead of mass, stiffness and damping
how_to_use: Specify every spring as duration plus bounce; convert to mass, stiffness and damping only at implementation time, per platform
zh: Apple 用 duration 和 bounce 讲弹簧动画，取代质量刚度阻尼那套；写任何平台的动效标注都可借用它的词汇。
zh_how: 动效规格一律写成 duration + bounce；到实现阶段再按平台换算成质量、刚度、阻尼。

name: Material 3 motion
best_for: Motion system with easing and duration tokens, transition patterns and the expressive spring-based motion scheme
how_to_use: Read How it works for the standard and expressive spring schemes, then the tokens page for easing and duration values; record the numbers as tokens
zh: Material 3 的动效体系，缓动与时长 token、转场模式和弹簧动效方案；定动效规范时读。
zh_how: 先读 How it works 了解 standard 与 expressive 两套弹簧方案，再到 tokens 页抄缓动与时长数值；站点由 JS 渲染，智能体需要浏览器。
caveats: JS-rendered site: agents need a browser
M3 Expressive specifies motion as springs; the easing and duration tokens remain for transitions that are not spring-driven

name: Material 2: Speed
best_for: Still the clearest public explanation of how duration and easing should vary with size, distance and platform
how_to_use: Read once; the reasoning outlives the version
zh: Material 2 讲时长与缓动如何随尺寸、距离、平台变化，至今最清楚；道理比版本长寿。
caveats: Material 2 is archived: Material 3 replaced these easing and duration values and adds spring-based motion

name: Apple HIG: Motion
best_for: Apple's principles: purposeful, brief, optional motion; respecting Reduce Motion
how_to_use: Agents: fetch the page as JSON (…/human-interface-guidelines/motion.json) instead of the JS page; pair with the WWDC springs and fluid-interfaces talks
zh: Apple 的动效准则：有目的、简短、可关闭，尊重减弱动态效果设置；给动效定原则时先读。
zh_how: 智能体请取 JSON 版：https://developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/design/human-interface-guidelines/motion.json；配合 WWDC 的弹簧与流畅界面两个演讲看。

name: Carbon motion
best_for: IBM's two-mode motion system: productive (efficient, out of the way) versus expressive (for occasional important moments), with published cubic-bezier curves and six duration tokens from 70 ms to 700 ms
how_to_use: Copy the duration tokens (70, 110, 150, 240, 400, 700 ms) and the standard, entrance and exit curves of each mode as the skeleton of your own motion tokens
zh: IBM Carbon 的双模式动效：效率型（克制、不打扰）与表现型（只留给少数重要时刻），公开 cubic-bezier 曲线与 70–700ms 六档时长 token；搭自家动效 token 的范本。

name: Fluent 2 motion

zh: 微软 Fluent 2 的动效原则与时间指引，讲动画在界面里的职责；要做出 Windows 原生手感时参考。
zh_how: 先读 Duration and easing，再读 Choreography：元素越大、位移越远给的时间越长；列表错时入场时间隔逐渐缩短；容器变换保持连续。

name: NN/g: Animation duration
best_for: Evidence-based guidance on how long UI animations should last
how_to_use: Cite when pushing back on slow animation

name: NN/g: Animation purpose
best_for: When motion helps: feedback, state change, navigation metaphors, signifiers
how_to_use: Use as the justification test for each animation
zh: NN/g 文章，讲清动效何时有用：反馈、状态变化、导航隐喻、指示线索；给每个动画找理由时用。

name: WCAG: Animation from Interactions
best_for: The normative basis for letting users disable interaction-triggered motion
how_to_use: Read with 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide

name: web.dev: prefers-reduced-motion

name: Designing Safer Web Animation For Motion Sensitivity
best_for: Which kinds of motion trigger vestibular symptoms and how to design around them

name: Ant Motion
best_for: Ant Design's motion language and React motion components
how_to_use: Read the three principles (natural, efficient, restrained) in the maintained Ant Design spec page; treat the Ant Motion React components as legacy

zh_how: 读 Ant Design 设计规范里的动效页（自然、高效、克制三原则，有 Markdown 版）；Ant Motion 的 React 动效组件当遗留方案看。
caveats: motion.ant.design is barely maintained; the current principles live in the Ant Design spec

name: HarmonyOS motion design principles
best_for: Huawei's motion principles for HarmonyOS apps with concrete duration caps: long moves within 350 ms, short within 250 ms, small within 150 ms

zh_how: 做鸿蒙应用时以这六条原则和时长上限为基线；页面是 JS 渲染，智能体可 POST 文档中心接口 getDocumentById 取正文。
caveats: JS-rendered doc centre: the body is also served as JSON by the site's undocumented getDocumentById endpoint (POST objectId, catalogName design-guides, language cn, with an Origin header of https://developer.huawei.com)

name: Emil Kowalski

zh: 网页动效工艺最实用的博客，讲缓动、时长、可打断与何时不动；写动效前读他的几篇代表作。

name: animations.dev

best_for: 8,000+ icons from 480 Design in six styles (linear, line duotone, bold, bold duotone, broken, outline) with a soft, rounded character
how_to_use: Design in the Figma file; in code fetch from Iconify (prefix solar, e.g. home-2-linear) and keep one style per product
zh: 480 Design 出品的 8000+ 图标，六种风格（线性、线性双色、粗体、粗体双色、断线、轮廓），气质圆润；设计用 Figma 文件，代码走 Iconify 的 solar 前缀。
caveats: CC BY 4.0: attribution required

name: Central Icon System
best_for: Paid system of 2,000+ symbols, each in about 30 variants (stroke weights, corner radii, line or solid), for tuning icons to a brand's radius and weight
how_to_use: Use when the icon corner radius and stroke must match the UI radius and weight tokens exactly
zh: 付费图标系统，2000+ 图形、每个约 30 种变体（粗细、圆角、线面）；图标圆角与粗细必须匹配界面 token 时用。

name: Fluent Emoji
best_for: Microsoft's open emoji set in four styles (3D, Color, Flat, High Contrast) as SVG and PNG; usable as friendly spot illustrations
how_to_use: Pick one style; fetch files by path from jsDelivr (assets/<Name>/<Style>/...) and keep them at emoji or spot-illustration sizes
zh: 微软开源的 emoji 集，四种风格（3D、彩色、扁平、高对比），SVG 与 PNG 都有；也能当亲切的点缀插画用；MIT。

name: Noto Emoji
best_for: Google's open emoji font and images, plus animated versions (Lottie, WebP, GIF) served per codepoint from fonts.gstatic.com
how_to_use: Static: use the font or the PNG and SVG images; animated: fetch fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/latest/<codepoint>/lottie.json (or 512.webp)
zh: Google 开源的 emoji 字体与图片，另有按码位提供的动画版（Lottie、WebP、GIF）；需要会动的 emoji 时直接按码位取 lottie.json。
license: Font SIL OFL 1.1; tools and most images Apache-2.0
caveats: The animated set has its own terms: read the note on the animation page before shipping

name: Ant Design Icons
best_for: The icon set of Ant Design in outlined, filled and two-tone themes, the default in Chinese admin and enterprise products
how_to_use: Raw SVG: cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ant-design/icons-svg@latest/inline-svg/<theme>/<name>.svg (theme: outlined, filled or twotone); in React use @ant-design/icons; keep one theme per surface
zh: Ant Design 官方图标集，线框、实底、双色三种主题，国内中后台与企业产品最常见的图标；MIT。
zh_how: 取 SVG：cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ant-design/icons-svg@latest/inline-svg/<主题>/<名称>.svg（主题：outlined、filled、twotone）；React 项目用 @ant-design/icons；同一界面只用一种主题。

name: Iconify
best_for: One API and tooling layer over 150+ open icon sets
how_to_use: SVG: https://api.iconify.design/<prefix>/<name>.svg; search: https://api.iconify.design/search?query=<q>; browse sets at icon-sets.iconify.design
zh: 聚合 150 多个开源图标集的统一 API 和工具层；按需取 SVG，各图标集许可各自标注。
zh_how: 取 SVG：https://api.iconify.design/<前缀>/<图标名>.svg；搜索：/search?query=<词>；在 icon-sets.iconify.design 按图标集看授权，搜到后只用同一套。
license: Each set keeps its own licence (shown per set)

name: Icones
best_for: Fast browser for all Iconify sets with copy-as (SVG, JSX, Vue, data URL)
how_to_use: Search across sets, then stick to one family
zh: 快速浏览全部 Iconify 图标集的前端，可复制为 SVG、JSX、Vue 等格式；跨集搜索后选定一族用。

name: SVG Repo
best_for: 500k+ SVG vectors and icon collections
how_to_use: Filter by licence; prefer whole collections over single icons
zh: 五十多万个 SVG 与图标合集；各合集许可不同需逐个确认，优先整套取用保证风格统一。
license: Licence varies per collection; read each
caveats: Vercel bot checkpoint blocks scripted fetches: send the link
Licence varies per collection; single icons from mixed collections will not match

name: The Noun Project
best_for: The widest range of pictograms for unusual concepts
how_to_use: Use for concept exploration; styles vary too much to mix in one UI
zh: 概念覆盖最广的象形图标库，冷僻概念也能找到；风格杂不宜混用，免费版需署名，付费免署名。
license: Free with attribution (CC BY); paid removes it

name: iconfont
best_for: China's largest icon platform: millions of uploaded icons, official brand and product sets, team projects and export as SVG, icon font or Symbol JS
how_to_use: Build one project per product from a single family (prefer the official sets), then export SVG or a symbol sprite; never mix uploads from different authors in one UI
zh: 国内最大的图标平台：海量上传图标、官方品牌与产品图标库、团队项目，可导出 SVG、字体图标或 Symbol 引用；国内团队的默认图标来源。
zh_how: 每个产品建一个项目，只从同一套（优先官方）图标里挑，再导出 SVG 或 symbol；不同作者的图标别混在一个界面里。
caveats: Licence is per upload and often unstated: prefer official sets for commercial work
Blocks scripted fetches and needs sign-in to download

name: Yesicon
best_for: Iconify-based search with Chinese (and eight other languages) keywords across 320,000+ open-source icons in 230+ sets, with per-framework code snippets
how_to_use: Search in Chinese, open the set page (yesicon.app/<prefix>) and stay within that set; the licence is shown per set
zh: 支持中文等多语言关键词的 Iconify 图标搜索，覆盖 230+ 开源图标集、32 万+ 图标，并生成各框架代码；搜到后坚持用同一套。
license: Each set keeps its own licence

name: Flaticon
best_for: Huge stock-icon marketplace (Freepik) that ranks first in many searches; listed mainly so its licence terms are known
how_to_use: If a stakeholder supplies Flaticon icons, check the account type: free downloads require visible attribution; prefer an open family from this section instead
zh: Freepik 旗下的海量图标素材站，搜索排名靠前；收录主要为了说清授权：免费下载必须署名，优先用本栏的开源图标家族。
license: Free with attribution; Premium removes it
caveats: Free use requires attribution; icons from many authors rarely match each other
Security filter blocks scripted fetches (HTTP 403)

name: Simple Icons
best_for: 3000+ single-colour brand icons with official hex colours
how_to_use: CDN: https://cdn.simpleicons.org/<slug>/<hex>; respect each brand's guidelines
zh: 三千多个单色品牌图标，附官方色值，可走 CDN；SVG 为 CC0，商标权仍在各品牌方。
zh_how: CDN：https://cdn.simpleicons.org/<slug>/<hex>，省略 hex 时使用品牌官方色；SVG 为 CC0，但商标仍归品牌方，遵守其使用规范。
license: CC0 for the SVGs; trademarks still apply
caveats: The SVGs are CC0 but the marks are trademarks: follow each brand's usage rules

name: Lobe Icons
best_for: SVG and React logos of AI models and providers
how_to_use: The quick route to correct AI vendor marks
zh: AI 模型与厂商的 SVG 和 React logo 库；要正确的 AI 厂商标志走这条捷径，代码 MIT、商标归原主。
license: MIT for the code; marks belong to their owners

name: SVGL
best_for: Full-colour brand SVG logos with light and dark variants and an API
how_to_use: API: https://api.svgl.app?search=<name> returns the SVG route (light and dark variants where they exist) and a link to the brand's guidelines
zh: 全彩品牌 logo 的 SVG 库，含明暗两套变体和查询 API；做品牌墙时取用。项目 MIT，商标归原厂。
zh_how: 接口：https://api.svgl.app?search=<名称>，返回 SVG 地址（有明暗变体时分别给出）和品牌规范链接。
license: MIT for the project; marks belong to their owners

name: Devicon
best_for: Logos of programming languages and developer tools in original, plain and line variants, as SVG and an icon font
how_to_use: Raw SVG: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devicons/devicon@latest/icons/<name>/<name>-original.svg; use one variant across a tech-stack section
zh: 编程语言与开发工具的 Logo 集，含原色、单色与线稿变体，SVG 与字体都有；技术栈展示区统一用一种变体，商标归原所有者；MIT。
license: MIT for the code; marks belong to their owners

name: Logo.dev
best_for: Company-logo API by domain (img.logo.dev/<domain>?token=...), the common replacement for the retired Clearbit Logo API
how_to_use: Use for customer logos in dashboards and CRMs; get a free publishable token and show the attribution the free tier requires
zh: 按域名获取公司 Logo 的 API，是已停用的 Clearbit Logo API 的常用替代；仪表盘里的客户 Logo 用它，需免费 token，免费档要署名。
caveats: Every request needs a token (unauthenticated calls return 401)
Vercel bot checkpoint on the website and docs

name: Lucide icon design guide
best_for: Concrete, numeric rules for a 24 px stroke icon family: canvas, padding, stroke, radii, spacing, optical balance
how_to_use: The best template for writing the rules of a custom set
zh: 24px 描边图标族的数字化设计规则：画布、留白、描边、圆角、视觉平衡；自建图标规范的模板。

name: Material: designing icons
best_for: Keyline shapes, grid, stroke and corner rules, optical sizes and the variable axes
how_to_use: Use the keyline shapes to equalise visual weight
zh: Material 的图标绘制规范：关键形状、网格、描边、视觉尺寸；用 keyline 统一整套图标的视觉重量。
caveats: JS-rendered site: agents need a browser

name: Apple HIG: SF Symbols
best_for: Rendering modes, variable colour, weights and scales, custom symbol guidance
how_to_use: Read before drawing a custom symbol for Apple platforms
zh: Apple 官方讲 SF Symbols 的渲染模式、可变色彩、字重与缩放；为 Apple 平台画自定义符号前必读。

name: Fluent 2: Iconography
best_for: Microsoft's rules for system, product and file-type icons: fixed sizes instead of scaling, simplification below 48 px, and literal naming (shield, not security)
how_to_use: Borrow its size ladder and naming rule when writing the icon section of a design system
zh: 微软 Fluent 2 的图标规范：系统、产品与文件类型图标，按固定尺寸出图不缩放、48px 以下简化细节、按形状而非功能命名（盾牌而非安全）。

name: Ant Design icon design spec
best_for: Ant Design's icon rules in Chinese: 1024 artboard with a 64 px bleed, layer structure, keyline templates, and four principles (accurate, simple, rhythmic, pleasant)
how_to_use: Use as the Chinese-language template for an icon spec; agents can read the Markdown twin
zh: Ant Design 图标设计规范：1024 画板、64px 出血位、分层、轮廓线模板，以及准确、简单、节奏、愉悦四原则（偶数原则、去小数点）；写中文图标规范的模板。

name: How to Favicon in 2026
best_for: The minimal modern favicon set, re-checked January 2026: favicon.ico, icon.svg and apple-touch-icon.png in HTML, plus a web manifest with 192, 512 and maskable icons for PWAs
how_to_use: Copy its two snippets instead of generating dozens of legacy files; agents can read the Markdown version
zh: 现代 favicon 最小方案（2026 年 1 月复核）：HTML 里只放 favicon.ico、icon.svg、apple-touch-icon.png，PWA 再加含 192、512 与 maskable 图标的 manifest。

name: Apple HIG: App icons
best_for: Current rules for layered app icons, appearances (default, dark, clear, tinted) and platform shapes
how_to_use: Agents: fetch …/human-interface-guidelines/app-icons.json; check the layer structure, appearances (default, dark, clear, tinted) and sizes before exporting from Icon Composer
zh: Apple 官方应用图标规范：分层结构、深色/透明/染色外观与各平台形状；导出前对照，规则随系统更新。
caveats: Perishable: re-read after every OS release

name: iOS Icon Gallery
best_for: Curated app icons for iOS, macOS and watchOS
how_to_use: Study silhouettes and palettes in the target category
zh: 精选的 iOS、macOS、watchOS 应用图标画廊；按目标类目研究成熟作品的剪影与配色套路。

name: macOSicons
best_for: Huge community gallery of macOS-style app icons
how_to_use: Reference for the macOS icon idiom
zh: macOS 风格应用图标的社区画廊，体量很大；揣摩 macOS 图标语言时参考，仅限个人使用。
caveats: Community-made icons for personal use: study the idiom, do not ship them

name: Apple Icon Composer
best_for: Apple's tool for building layered, material-aware app icons from SVG or PNG layers
how_to_use: Supply flat layers; let the system render the material
zh: Apple 官方的分层图标制作工具，用 SVG/PNG 图层生成带材质的 App 图标；出苹果平台图标时用。

name: Icon Kitchen
best_for: Generates adaptive Android icons and iOS, web and macOS icon sets from one artwork
how_to_use: Preview mask shapes and the monochrome layer before export
zh: 一份图稿生成 Android 自适应图标与 iOS、web、macOS 全套尺寸；出应用图标时省事，导出前先预览蒙版与单色层。

name: Maskable.app
best_for: Preview and edit PWA maskable icons against every mask shape
how_to_use: Check the safe zone before shipping the manifest
zh: 预览和编辑 PWA maskable 图标的工具，对照各种遮罩形状检查安全区，发 manifest 前用它过一遍。

name: RealFaviconGenerator
best_for: Generates and checks a complete, current favicon package
how_to_use: Run the checker on the deployed site
zh: 生成并校验一整套符合现行标准的 favicon 的工具；站点部署上线后跑一遍它的 checker。

name: HarmonyOS app icon guidelines
best_for: Huawei's rules for HarmonyOS app icons: foreground and background layers, grid for visual weight, top-down lighting, nine recommended colour directions and multi-device adaptation
how_to_use: Check the grid, layer split and gradient direction before exporting HarmonyOS icons; keep the main content centred so system masks do not clip it
zh: 华为 HarmonyOS 应用图标规范：前后景分层、体量网格、自上而下光源、9 种推荐色彩方向与多设备适配；导出鸿蒙图标前逐项核对。
caveats: JS-rendered doc centre: the body is also served as JSON by the site's undocumented getDocumentById endpoint (POST objectId, catalogName design-guides, language cn, with an Origin header of https://developer.huawei.com)
Perishable: re-check after each HarmonyOS release

name: SVGOMG
best_for: Visual front end for SVGO with a live diff
how_to_use: Keep viewBox; lower precision until the shape changes, then step back
zh: SVGO 的可视化前端，压缩 SVG 时实时对照前后差异；保留 viewBox，精度降到变形前回退。
zh_how: 保留 viewBox；逐步降低精度直到图形开始变形，再退回一档。

name: SVGO
best_for: The SVG optimiser behind most pipelines
how_to_use: Configure to keep viewBox and to avoid merging stroked paths
zh: 多数流水线背后的 SVG 优化器；配置时保留 viewBox、别把描边路径合并掉；MIT。

name: SVG Path Editor
best_for: Edit path commands numerically with a live preview: round, scale, translate, convert to relative
how_to_use: Use to snap hand-written paths to the grid
zh: 在线按数值编辑 SVG path 指令，实时预览取整、缩放、平移；把手写路径对齐到网格时用。

name: SVG Viewer
best_for: View, optimise and convert SVG to JSX, React Native, data URI and PNG
how_to_use: Paste code-written SVG to check that it renders, then optimise it and copy it as JSX, React Native or a data URI
zh: 在线查看、优化并转换 SVG 的小工具，可导出 JSX、React Native、data URI 与 PNG；手写 SVG 代码后用它快速校验。

name: VTracer
best_for: Raster-to-vector tracer that handles colour images
how_to_use: Trace a sketch, then redraw cleanly; never ship the raw trace
zh: 支持彩色图像的位图转矢量工具；描完草图要重绘干净，别直接交原始描摹；MIT。

name: Boxy SVG
best_for: Browser-based SVG editor that writes clean markup
how_to_use: For manual touch-ups of generated SVG
zh: 浏览器里的 SVG 编辑器，输出的标记干净；适合手工修整生成的 SVG 文件。

name: unDraw
best_for: Open-source flat illustrations recolourable to a brand hue
how_to_use: Set the brand colour on the site before downloading; restyle (line weight, palette, crop) so the set does not read as unDraw
zh: 开源扁平插画库，可按品牌色一键换色后下载；用的人太多，需改造型再用。商用免费。
license: unDraw licence: free commercial use without attribution; no redistribution as packs, no AI training, no integrations
caveats: Instantly recognisable from overuse: restyle or use sparingly
The licence forbids redistribution in packs, AI training and building integrations on it

name: Open Peeps
best_for: Mix-and-match hand-drawn people library
how_to_use: Compose characters from parts
zh: 手绘人物插画库，头、身、姿势等部件可自由拼组；需要快速拼出人物配图时用；CC0。

name: Open Doodles
best_for: Loose sketchy illustration set with a colour generator
how_to_use: For informal, friendly tone
zh: 松散手绘风插画集，带配色生成器；想要随意亲切调性的页面时用，CC0 可商用。

name: Blush
best_for: Customisable illustration collections from many artists
how_to_use: Keep to one collection for consistency
zh: 多位艺术家的可定制插画合集，配色和元素可调；同一项目只用一个合集保一致，SVG 和完整库付费。
license: Free tier with limits; paid for SVG and full access
caveats: Free tier is limited; SVG export and full collections need a paid plan

name: Storyset
best_for: Customisable and animatable illustration concepts
how_to_use: Attribution is mandatory on the free tier
zh: 可自定义配色、可设动画的插画概念库；免费档使用必须署名，介意就付费。
caveats: Free use requires attribution; a paid plan removes it

name: Absurd Design
best_for: Surreal ink illustrations that stand out from flat-vector sameness
how_to_use: Use for brands that want an odd, human voice
zh: 超现实手绘墨水插画，跳出扁平矢量的同质化；适合想要怪一点人味儿的品牌；署名免费，会员更多。
license: Free set with attribution; membership for more
caveats: Free set requires attribution

name: Recraft
best_for: AI generator that outputs editable vector (SVG) illustrations and icons in a saved brand style, with an API
how_to_use: Define one style, generate the missing pieces of an illustration or icon set, then clean paths and snap to the grid in an editor before shipping
zh: 能输出可编辑矢量（SVG）插画与图标、并保存品牌风格的 AI 生成工具，带 API；补齐同风格素材后，在编辑器里清理路径再交付。
license: Paid plans: full ownership and commercial rights; free plan: owned by Recraft, public, not for commercial use
caveats: Free-plan images are owned by Recraft, shown publicly and not licensed for commercial use
Generated vectors need path clean-up; disclose AI generation where required

name: Poly Haven
best_for: Public-domain HDRIs, PBR textures and models of high quality
how_to_use: API available; the default for lighting and materials
zh: 公共领域的 HDRI、PBR 贴图与模型库，质量高且带 API；做 3D 场景打光与材质时当默认来源用，CC0 可商用。
zh_how: 按类型列资产：https://api.polyhaven.com/assets?t=hdris（或 textures、models）；再用资产 id 取文件，全部 CC0。

name: 3dicons
best_for: Open-source 3D icons rendered in several angles and colours
how_to_use: Download the PNG render in the angle and colour you need, or open the Blender source to re-render in your palette; CC0, no credit needed
zh: 开源 3D 图标库，每个图标有多个角度和配色的渲染成品；提供 PNG 与 Blender 源文件。CC0。

name: ambientCG
best_for: Public-domain PBR materials
how_to_use: Second source for PBR textures after Poly Haven; query the JSON API by type and keyword
zh: 公共领域（CC0）的 PBR 材质库，覆盖常见表面；做 3D 渲染找贴图时的常备第二来源。

name: Spline
best_for: Browser 3D design tool with states, events and web export, plus a community of remixable scenes
how_to_use: Remix a community scene or build a simple one; check scene weight and loading on a mid-range phone before embedding it in a hero, and export a still for reduced motion
zh: 浏览器里的 3D 设计工具，支持状态、事件与网页导出，社区有大量可二次创作的场景；嵌入首屏前在中端手机上测体积与加载。
caveats: Runtime and scene files are heavy; lazy-load and pause off-screen

name: D.Design
best_for: Alibaba Design's platform: original 3D avatars, scenes and elements marked free for commercial use, with online rendering and AI design tools
how_to_use: Use the 3D library for icons, avatars and scenes in one style; confirm the licence note on each asset before shipping
zh: 阿里巴巴设计的堆友平台：原创 3D 头像、场景与元素，标注免费可商用，带在线渲染与 AI 设计工具；同一产品只用一种 3D 风格。
caveats: Downloads spend daily credits (堆豆) after sign-in
The home page now leads with the 堆友 Agent; the 3D library sits behind it

name: Kenney
best_for: Thousands of stylistically consistent CC0 game assets: 2D sprites, 3D models, UI packs and audio
how_to_use: Use for playful prototypes, game UI and placeholder 3D with zero licence risk; one pack per product keeps the style coherent
zh: 数千个风格统一的 CC0 游戏素材：2D、3D、UI 套件与音效；趣味原型与游戏界面零授权风险。

name: Sketchfab
best_for: The largest 3D model platform, with an embeddable viewer, a Downloadable filter and many Creative Commons models
how_to_use: Filter Downloadable, then by licence; check polygon count and texture size before web use; record the attribution string for CC BY models
zh: 最大的 3D 模型平台，带可嵌入查看器、「可下载」筛选与大量 CC 授权模型；网页使用前查面数与贴图大小，CC BY 模型记下署名。
license: Per model (CC variants or store licence)
caveats: The site separates 'Human Created' and 'AI Generated' models; check which you are using

name: Unsplash
best_for: High-quality free photography with strong editorial, lifestyle and texture depth; the usual first search for free photos
how_to_use: Skip the first page of results (the most reused images) and keep one colour grade across a product; agents need the official API with a free access key
zh: 高质量免费摄影库；避开被用滥的图，照片处理风格要统一；可商用但不得转售原图，Unsplash+ 付费。
zh_how: 跳过搜索结果第一页（被用滥的图），整个产品统一调色；智能体须用官方 API 和免费 access key。
license: Unsplash licence: free commercial use, no resale of unaltered photos; Unsplash+ is paid
caveats: Anubis bot wall ('Making sure you're not a bot!') blocks scripted fetches of the site
No resale of unaltered photos; Unsplash+ images are paid

name: Pexels
best_for: Free photos and stock video with an API
how_to_use: Good for short background video
zh: 免费照片与素材视频库，带 API；拿来做短背景视频很顺手；可商用。
caveats: Cloudflare wall blocks scripted fetches; the API needs a free key

name: Coverr
best_for: Stock video made for website backgrounds
how_to_use: Compress and provide a poster frame
zh: 为网页背景而生的素材视频库；多数片段免费许可，使用时记得压缩并备好 poster 帧。

name: Mixkit
best_for: Free video clips, music and UI sound effects
how_to_use: Source for subtle interface sounds
zh: 免费视频、音乐与音效素材站；给界面配克制的音效时来这找；按素材类型各有许可。

name: Lummi
best_for: AI-generated stock imagery with consistent styles
how_to_use: Disclose synthetic imagery where it matters; check for artefacts
zh: AI 生成的配图库，风格一致性较好，免费用；正式场合注意披露合成来源，并检查生成痕迹。
caveats: AI-generated: disclose synthetic imagery where your market requires it (EU AI Act Art. 50, China's labelling measures)

name: Visual China Group
best_for: Mainland China's dominant paid stock library
how_to_use: Never use unlicensed images found online in China-facing work; enforcement is active
zh: 国内最大的付费图库，版权管理严格、维权积极；做面向国内的项目别用网上随手找的图。
caveats: Rights-managed and actively enforced: never use images found online in China-facing work without a licence

name: Openverse
best_for: WordPress's search engine for openly licensed images and audio, with licence filters and an anonymous JSON API
how_to_use: Filter by commercial use and modification; agents query api.openverse.org/v1/images/?q=<q>&license_type=commercial and keep the returned attribution string
zh: WordPress 基金会的开放授权图片与音频搜索引擎，可按授权筛选，另有免登录的 JSON API；筛「可商用、可修改」并保存返回的署名字符串。
zh_how: 智能体用 api.openverse.org/v1/images/?q=<词>&license_type=commercial 查询，结果自带授权与署名字段，照抄进致谢。
license: Per item (CC licences and public domain)
caveats: The website is behind a Cloudflare wall; use the API
Quality varies widely; aggregated from many sources

name: The Met Open Access and Collection API
best_for: Keyless JSON API over the Metropolitan Museum's collection; objects flagged isPublicDomain come with high-resolution CC0 images
how_to_use: Search /search?hasImages=true&q=<q>, fetch /objects/<id>, use primaryImage only when isPublicDomain is true; stay under 80 requests per second
zh: 大都会艺术博物馆的免密钥 JSON API，isPublicDomain 为真的藏品附高清 CC0 图片；做编辑、历史与纹理类配图零授权风险。
zh_how: 先 /search?hasImages=true&q=<词> 得到 id，再取 /objects/<id>；只在 isPublicDomain 为 true 时用 primaryImage；每秒不超过 80 次请求。

name: Smithsonian Open Access
best_for: Millions of CC0 images and records from Smithsonian museums, archives and zoos, searchable on the site and through an API
how_to_use: Use for editorial, historical and natural-history imagery; agents call api.si.edu/openaccess/api/v1.0/search with an api.data.gov key (DEMO_KEY for tests)
zh: 史密森尼学会数百万条 CC0 图像与档案（博物馆、档案馆、动物园），网站与 API 都能搜；编辑和历史类配图零授权风险。
zh_how: 智能体调用 api.si.edu/openaccess/api/v1.0/search，需要免费的 api.data.gov 密钥（测试可用 DEMO_KEY，有限速）。
caveats: The website shows a verification page to scripts; the API needs a free api.data.gov key (DEMO_KEY is rate-limited)

name: Wikimedia Commons
best_for: The largest free media repository: photos, maps, diagrams and historical images, each with its licence and author on the file page
how_to_use: Search, open the file page and copy the licence and attribution block; agents use the MediaWiki API (list=search, srnamespace=6 for files)
zh: 最大的自由媒体库：照片、地图、示意图与历史图像，每个文件页写明授权与作者；照抄文件页的授权与署名。
zh_how: 搜到后打开文件页，照抄授权与署名信息；智能体用 MediaWiki API（list=search，srnamespace=6 只搜文件）。
license: Per file (CC BY, CC BY-SA, public domain...)

entry_points.label: Reusing content outside Wikimedia (how to attribute)

caveats: Many files are CC BY-SA (share-alike) and need attribution; check each file

name: Tuchong Creative
best_for: Licensed commercial stock images, video and audio for China; Adobe Stock's exclusive partner in mainland China
how_to_use: Use for commercial imagery in China-facing work and keep the licence record per asset; enforcement against unlicensed use is active
zh: 图虫创意：面向国内的正版商用图片、视频、音频素材库，Adobe Stock 中国区官方独家合作伙伴；国内维权积极，逐张保留授权记录。

name: Hellorf
best_for: ZCOOL's licensed marketplace for images, video, fonts and music in China
how_to_use: Second licensed source in China after Tuchong or VCG; keep the licence record per asset
zh: 站酷海洛：站酷旗下的正版图片、视频、字体与音乐交易平台；国内第二个正版来源，逐张保留授权记录。

name: Shots
best_for: Fast browser tool for device and browser mock-ups with good defaults
how_to_use: Drop a screenshot, pick a frame, export
zh: 浏览器里的设备与浏览器样机工具，默认就好看；丢截图、选边框、导出，三步完事。

name: Pika
best_for: Screenshot beautifier and social-image templates
how_to_use: Quick product shots for marketing pages
zh: 截图美化与社交分享图模板工具；营销页需要快速出产品展示图时用。

name: Mockuuups Studio
best_for: Thousands of photographic device scenes
how_to_use: Use sparingly; clean frames usually present UI better
zh: 数千个实拍设备场景样机，快速把界面放进手机电脑照片里；克制使用，干净画框更显设计。
caveats: Staged photo scenes date quickly and distract from the UI; clean device frames usually present it better

name: LS Graphics
best_for: High-end device and print mock-ups
how_to_use: For brand presentations
zh: 高端设备与印刷样机库；做品牌提案展示用；按产品付费，部分免费。

name: Rotato
best_for: 3D device mock-up animator for product videos
how_to_use: For launch videos and store previews
zh: 3D 设备样机动画工具，把界面截图放进会动的手机电脑模型里；做发布视频与应用商店预览时用。

name: MockUPhone
best_for: Free flat device frames
how_to_use: Plain frames without scenery
zh: 免费的扁平设备边框图，没有场景装饰，快速给截图套壳展示时用。

name: Screen Studio
best_for: macOS screen recorder that adds automatic zoom, smoothed cursor movement and framing, for polished product demos
how_to_use: Record the built UI at a fixed window size, let it auto-zoom, then trim; use for launch clips and store previews
zh: macOS 录屏工具，自动缩放、平滑光标与构图，快速做出精致的产品演示视频；录已完成的界面用于发布与商店预览。
caveats: macOS only; subscription

name: Haikei
best_for: Generators for blobs, waves, layered peaks, blurry gradients, exported as SVG or PNG
how_to_use: Export SVG and tune the path in code
zh: 色块、波浪、层叠山峰、模糊渐变等背景生成器，导出 SVG 或 PNG；生成素材可免费使用。
zh_how: 从 generators 页选生成器，导出 SVG 后在代码里微调路径与颜色。
license: Generated assets are free to use

name: fffuel
best_for: Collection of SVG generators: noise, grain, organic shapes, patterns, gradients
how_to_use: nnnoise and gggrain for texture, ooorganize for grids; export SVG and keep the parameters in a comment so the texture can be regenerated
zh: SVG 生成器合集：噪点、颗粒、有机形状、图案和渐变；做纹理背景时按需挑选。
zh_how: 纹理用 nnnoise 和 gggrain，网格用 ooorganize；导出 SVG 时把参数写进注释，方便以后重新生成。

name: Paper Shaders
best_for: Zero-dependency shader components (mesh gradient, grain, dithering, warp) for React and vanilla JS
how_to_use: The cleanest way to ship a live shader background
zh: 零依赖 shader 组件库，含网格渐变、颗粒、抖动、形变；给网页加实时 shader 背景最干净的选择，Apache-2.0。
zh_how: React 项目安装 @paper-design/shaders-react（原生 JS 用 @paper-design/shaders），在 mesh-gradient 等页面调好参数后复制代码。

name: Grainient
best_for: Grainy gradient backgrounds, animated gradients and shader tools
how_to_use: Use as art direction reference, then recreate in code for control
zh: 颗粒渐变背景、动态渐变与 shader 工具；当美术方向参考，再用代码复刻以掌控细节；有免费和付费包。

name: Hero Patterns
best_for: Repeatable SVG background patterns with colour controls
how_to_use: Keep opacity low; credit as required
zh: 可调色的可平铺 SVG 背景图案库；给区块加纹理时压低不透明度用，需署名；CC BY 4.0。
caveats: CC BY 4.0: attribution required
No longer updated

name: Pattern Monster
best_for: Customisable SVG pattern generator
how_to_use: Export as CSS background or SVG
zh: 可调参数的 SVG 图案生成器，导出为 CSS 背景或 SVG 文件；给页面做纹理底纹时直接用。

name: ShaderGradient
best_for: Moving 3D gradient customiser with React, Figma and Framer outputs
how_to_use: Export a still as the reduced-motion fallback
zh: 动态 3D 渐变定制器，可导出 React、Figma 和 Framer 三种形态；记得导一张静帧给 reduced-motion 场景兜底；MIT。

name: Unicorn Studio
best_for: No-code WebGL scene builder for hero effects
how_to_use: Check the runtime weight and pause off-screen
zh: 无代码 WebGL 场景搭建工具，做首屏特效；注意运行时体积，离屏时记得暂停。
caveats: The WebGL runtime adds weight: lazy-load it, pause off-screen and ship a static fallback for reduced motion

name: Shadertoy
best_for: Community of GLSL shaders; unmatched for learning techniques
how_to_use: Learn from it; do not copy a shader into commercial work without checking its licence
zh: GLSL shader 社区，学着色器技法的最佳现场，网页背景动效的灵感源；默认 CC BY-NC-SA，商用前逐条查许可。
license: Default licence is CC BY-NC-SA unless the author states otherwise
caveats: Default licence is CC BY-NC-SA: not for commercial use unless the author says otherwise
Heavy fragment shaders drain battery: profile on a mid-range phone before shipping a port

name: Grainy Gradients (CSS-Tricks)
best_for: The SVG-noise-plus-gradient technique for grain in pure CSS, explained step by step
how_to_use: Copy the feTurbulence filter; tune baseFrequency and contrast
zh: CSS-Tricks 的教程，用 SVG 噪点滤镜加渐变在纯 CSS 里做出颗粒感；抄 feTurbulence 滤镜再调参数。
caveats: css-tricks.com sits behind a SiteGround 'One moment, please...' wall for scripts: send the link

name: gradient.style
best_for: Modern CSS gradient builder with colour-space interpolation and wide gamut
how_to_use: Interpolate in oklch or oklab to avoid grey dead zones
zh: 现代 CSS 渐变生成器，支持广色域与色彩空间插值；用 oklch 或 oklab 插值可避免中间发灰。
zh_how: 在 oklch 或 oklab 中插值，避免中段发灰；复制生成的 CSS，需要兼容旧浏览器时附一个 sRGB 回退。

name: Josh Comeau gradient generator
best_for: Generates lush multi-stop gradients via perceptual colour modes
how_to_use: For browsers without in-oklch interpolation
zh: 按感知色彩模式生成多段渐变的工具，色层丰润；浏览器不支持 oklch 插值时的替代方案。

name: uiGradients
best_for: Named two- and three-stop gradients
how_to_use: Dated aesthetic; use as a quick starting point only
zh: 带名字的两色、三色 CSS 渐变库；审美已经偏旧，只当快速起步的起点；MIT。
caveats: Dated two-stop sRGB gradients: interpolate in oklch (see Gradient.style) for smoother blends

name: Logobook
best_for: Archive of the world's classic logos, browsable by letter, shape, object and designer; images can be saved directly
how_to_use: Browse /letter/<a>/ for the client's initial, /shape/<circle|arrows…>/ or /business/<industry>/ to see how a form has already been solved
zh: 世界经典标志档案馆，可按字母、形状、物体、设计师浏览；看某个形态前人是怎么解的。

name: Logo Archive
best_for: 5,500+ historical, mostly modernist marks, each documented with designer and year
how_to_use: Reference for reductive, geometric construction
zh: 5500+ 历史标志档案（以现代主义为主），每件注明设计师与年份；做几何化、减法造型时的参照系。

name: Logosystem
best_for: Contemporary logos indexed by symbol, letter and designer
how_to_use: Filter by type (/logos/wordmark, /logos/symbol, /animated), colour, shape and industry; each /logo/<slug> page names the designer; /app-icons for app marks
zh: 当代标志库（1300+），可按类型、颜色、形状、行业筛，每件注明设计师；另有动态 logo 与 App 图标专区。

name: Logopedia
best_for: Logo evolution timelines for thousands of brands
how_to_use: Use for rebrand equity audits: what stayed constant across redesigns
zh: 数千个品牌的 Logo 演变时间线档案馆；改版前盘点品牌资产时，看历次更迭留住了什么。
caveats: Fan-maintained wiki: verify dates against the brand; Cloudflare challenge for scripts

name: Logo Design Love
best_for: David Airey's long-running blog on logo craft, process and case studies
how_to_use: Read the process posts before presenting logo options
zh: David Airey 写了多年的 logo 博客，讲工艺、流程与案例；给客户提方案前先读它的过程文章。

name: Emblemetric
best_for: Quantitative analysis of logo trends from trademark data
how_to_use: Evidence on how common a colour or form is in a category
zh: 用商标数据量化分析 logo 趋势；想知道某种颜色或造型在某行业多常见时查它。

name: LogoLounge
best_for: Large member-submitted logo database; the annual trend report is free
how_to_use: Read the trend report to know which cliches to avoid
zh: 会员投稿的大型标志数据库；每年的免费趋势报告值得读，能知道哪些套路该避开。

name: BP&O
best_for: In-depth reviews of identity and packaging projects with a critical eye
how_to_use: Read the reviews for the vocabulary of identity critique; /logos/ collects mark-only posts
zh: 深度评测品牌识别与包装项目的博客，眼光挑剔；学识别设计批评的词汇。

name: Logo News (标志情报局)
best_for: The leading Chinese-language chronicle of logo changes and new identities worldwide and in China
how_to_use: Search a brand name for its identity history; /archives/old-and-new pairs old and new marks for rebrand comparisons
zh: 中文标志资讯站，收录中外品牌换标与新形象；查某个品牌的标识演变史时直接搜名字。
zh_how: 直接搜品牌名看换标史；/archives/old-and-new 把新旧标志成对归档，做改版对比时很好用。

name: Brand New
best_for: The definitive chronicle and critique of identity work and rebrands; low-cost subscription
how_to_use: Search the archive by industry before starting a rebrand
zh: 品牌重塑案例的编年史与评论媒体；做 rebranding 前按行业搜档案，低价订阅制。
caveats: Full reviews need a paid subscription

name: The Brand Identity
best_for: Contemporary identity projects and type releases, well photographed
how_to_use: Search projects (/search?filter=category:Project) or open /project/<slug> case studies; /features for interviews
zh: 当代品牌识别项目与新字体发布的在线刊物，摄影讲究；按项目搜索或看 /project 案例了解当下识别设计审美。

name: Identity Designed
best_for: Identity case studies written by the studios themselves
how_to_use: See how studios explain and sequence their own work
zh: 由设计工作室亲自撰写的品牌识别案例库，看同行如何讲解和编排自己的作品。

name: Mindsparkle Mag
best_for: Daily curation across branding, web and motion
how_to_use: Filter /tag/<brand-identity|packaging-design|monogram> or /categories/<sector> to scan current identity work
zh: 每日更新的品牌、网页与动效策展杂志；横向扫一遍当下 identity 作品用它。

name: Rebrand Gallery
best_for: Library of brand refreshes and rebrands with their reveal videos
how_to_use: Filter by feel (/feels/<vibe>) or industry; watch how the reveal is staged
zh: 品牌焕新案例库，附发布视频；按气质或行业筛，看揭幕短片是怎么编排的。

name: 古田路9号
best_for: Chinese brand-design community and portfolio platform
how_to_use: Reference for domestic brand-design taste and pricing of visual language
zh: 国内品牌设计社区与作品集平台；校准本土品牌视觉品味与价位时看。

name: D&AD Awards archive
best_for: Pencil-winning and shortlisted work across branding, graphic design, digital and advertising, with a searchable awards archive
how_to_use: Open the awards archive and filter by discipline (branding, design, digital) and year to see what juries rewarded
zh: D&AD 铅笔奖作品库，覆盖品牌、平面、数字与广告；在奖项档案里按类别和年份看评审奖励了什么。

name: Brand Guidelines
best_for: Collection of official brand guideline documents (Twitch, Instacart, Asana and more)
how_to_use: Open three from a similar industry and compare their table of contents
zh: 官方品牌规范文档合集，收 Twitch、Asana 等；写自家规范前挑三个同行对比目录结构。

name: Branding Style Guides
best_for: Large archive of brand manuals and style guides, many as PDFs
how_to_use: Browse /directory/<letter>/ or filter by /label/<industry>/, /publication-year/<year>/ and /publication-country/; many entries link the original PDF
zh: 品牌手册与视觉规范的大型档案馆，很多是 PDF 原文；按行业分类翻，写规范前先找参照。

name: Standards
best_for: Platform for web-native brand guidelines with public examples
how_to_use: Study /examples/ (Mailchimp, Cash App, McLaren) for how a living guideline site is structured
zh: 网页版品牌指南平台，附公开范例；研究一份"活的"品牌手册该怎么搭结构。

name: Standards Manual
best_for: Reissues of landmark graphics standards manuals (NASA, NYCTA, EPA)
how_to_use: Previews show how rigorous systems were specified
zh: 复刻出版 NASA、纽约地铁等经典图形标准手册；预览页能看出严谨系统当年怎么写规范。

name: Brandfetch
best_for: Logos, colours and fonts of 50M+ companies by domain, via search, a free Logo API and an MCP server
how_to_use: Collect a competitor line-up by domain; agents use the MCP or Logo API instead of scraping logos
zh: 按域名取 5000 万+ 公司的 logo、品牌色与字体，有免费 Logo API 与 MCP；凑竞品品牌墙或让智能体取 logo 时用。
caveats: Logos are trademarks: fine for competitor boards and integrations, not as material for a new mark

name: Pentagram
best_for: Case studies from the most influential identity partnership
how_to_use: Filter /work by discipline (brand identity) and sector; /archive holds older projects
zh: 最有影响力的设计合伙事务所的案例库；按门类与行业筛选品牌识别案例看。

name: COLLINS
best_for: Strategy-led identity case studies with strong narrative
how_to_use: Read how each case frames the problem before showing the work
zh: 策略先行的品牌识别案例集，叙事性强；学它如何给每个案子定义问题，而不只看最终呈现。

name: Koto
best_for: Optimistic tech and start-up identities
how_to_use: Read /projects/<client> cases (Lyft, Amazon, Instagram) for digital-first systems
zh: 以乐观气质的科技与初创品牌识别见长的工作室，做数字优先的品牌系统时看它家的作品。

name: Wolff Olins
best_for: Large corporate and public-sector rebrands that show how one idea scales across a big organisation
how_to_use: Read a /work case end to end; note how the system, not the logo, is presented
zh: 大型公司品牌重塑案例集；看一套识别系统如何在庞大组织里铺开。

name: Ragged Edge
best_for: Challenger-brand identities with bold voice
how_to_use: Reference for tone of voice paired with visuals
zh: 挑战者品牌的识别设计，语气大胆；参考文案调性与视觉怎么配合。

name: Porto Rocha
best_for: Culture- and motion-forward identity systems
how_to_use: Reference for identities designed to move
zh: 以文化和动效见长的品牌识别工作室；做为动而生的识别系统时对标它的案例。

name: Studio Dumbar/DEPT
best_for: Pioneers of motion-first visual identity
how_to_use: Read /work cases (OpenAI, Google Sans Flex) for generative and kinetic identity systems
zh: 动态优先视觉识别的先行者；做生成式、动态识别系统时的参考。

name: WIPO Global Brand Database
best_for: Worldwide trademark search including image similarity
how_to_use: Run an image search on a candidate mark; a lawyer's clearance is still required
zh: WIPO 全球商标库，支持以图搜图查相似标；给候选 Logo 做初筛用，正式清权仍需律师。
caveats: Single-page app: plain fetches get an empty shell
A knock-out search, not a clearance

name: TMview
best_for: Trademark search across many national and regional offices
how_to_use: Search a candidate name across EU and national offices, then filter by Nice class, office and status
zh: 跨多国与地区商标局的检索工具，按类别交叉核对名称与图形；定名前先做排查。
caveats: JavaScript app: plain fetches get an empty shell

name: 中国商标网
best_for: Official portal of China's trademark office; its online search (商标网上查询) is the authoritative check for mainland names and marks
how_to_use: Open 商标网上查询 from the portal and search the name, its pinyin and the figurative-element codes in the relevant Nice classes
zh: 国家知识产权局商标局官方门户；“商标网上查询”是大陆名称与标志查重的权威来源，面向大陆市场定名前必查。
zh_how: 从门户进入“商标网上查询”，按类别检索中文名、拼音和图形要素编码；结果以官方为准。
caveats: The search system blocks scripts (403) and is slow from outside mainland China

name: Onym
best_for: Curated guide to naming: process, tools, references
how_to_use: Follow its process when the brief includes a name
zh: 命名方法与工具的精选指南；需求里包含起名时按它的流程走。

name: Igor Naming Guide (PDF)
best_for: Taxonomy of name types (functional, invented, experiential, evocative) with evaluation criteria
how_to_use: Classify candidate names before judging them
zh: 命名方法论长文，把名字分成功能、生造、体验、唤起四类并给出评估标准；评审候选名前用它归类。
caveats: SiteGround bot check blocks scripts and headless browsers; open in a normal browser
The old HTML page (/process/igor-naming-guide.php) now returns 404

name: USPTO Trademark Search
best_for: Official US trademark search (replaced TESS in 2023)
how_to_use: Run a knock-out search on names and marks for US filings, filtering by class and live status; not a legal clearance
zh: 美国商标局官方检索（2023 年取代 TESS）；面向美国市场的名称与标志做初筛，不等于法律意见。
caveats: JavaScript app: plain fetches get an empty shell

name: Tmkoo (标库网)
best_for: Third-party Chinese trademark search mirroring CNIPA data, with free similar-name, status and gazette lookups
how_to_use: Use for a quick similar-name check before the official CNIPA search; ignore the filing-service upsell
zh: 标库网：同步商标局数据的第三方商标检索，免费查近似、状态与公告；官方查询前先用它快速初筛。
caveats: A commercial filing agency's mirror: confirm every hit on the official CNIPA search

name: Instant Domain Search
best_for: Checks domain availability across TLDs as you type, with generated alternatives
how_to_use: Run the name shortlist through it before presenting; an available domain changes which names survive
zh: 边输入边查各后缀域名是否可注册，并给替代建议；提案前把候选名过一遍，域名能否拿到会影响名字去留。
caveats: Registrar affiliate links; availability is indicative until you buy

name: Typographic Posters
best_for: Thousands of contemporary typographic posters by designer, studio and country
how_to_use: Scroll the poster stream and open a designer from any poster to read a coherent body of work; note grid and scale contrast
zh: 数千张当代字体海报，按设计师、工作室、国家索引；按设计师通读，留意网格与尺度对比。
caveats: JavaScript-rendered: plain fetches get little beyond the title

name: Trend List
best_for: Graphic-design trends named and tagged across posters and print
how_to_use: Look up a trend to know how dated it is before using it
zh: 给平面与海报设计潮流命名并打标签的档案站；用某个潮流元素前先查它流行多久了。

name: Museum fuer Gestaltung eMuseum
best_for: Online collection of the Zurich design museum, including the Swiss poster tradition
how_to_use: Search by designer (Mueller-Brockmann, Hofmann) for canonical grid work
zh: 苏黎世设计博物馆线上馆藏，含瑞士海报传统；按设计师搜 Mueller-Brockmann、Hofmann 看网格原作。
caveats: Anubis bot check ("Making sure you're not a bot!") blocks scripts

name: Poster House
best_for: Museum dedicated to posters, with exhibition archives
how_to_use: Read the /exhibition/ pages and /blog/ essays for poster history and genres
zh: 纽约海报博物馆，带历届展览档案；补海报史与流派背景知识的地方。

name: Tokyo TDC (Tokyo Type Directors Club)
