best_for: Annual Tokyo TDC awards for letter and word expression; the best archive of CJK typographic posters, books and identities
how_to_use: Browse /en/award/ year by year for how kanji, kana and Latin are combined at display scale
zh: 东京字体指导俱乐部年度奖，中日文字体海报、书籍与识别设计最好的档案；看汉字、假名与拉丁字在展示尺度下如何搭配。

name: Type Directors Club (TDC)
best_for: New York's Type Directors Club: the annual TDC competition for communication design and typeface design, and its winners
how_to_use: Read /news/ for each year's winners and finalists (e.g. TDC72) and the categories at /competitions/
zh: 纽约字体指导俱乐部年度竞赛（传达设计与字体设计）及获奖作品；找有野心的字体设计参考。

name: 100 Beste Plakate
best_for: Annual competition for the 100 best posters from Germany, Austria and Switzerland; the strongest yearly record of typographic poster design
how_to_use: Browse each year's 100 winners for grid, scale and type-only solutions
zh: 德奥瑞三国“年度 100 张最佳海报”竞赛，最能代表当年字体海报水准的年鉴；看网格、尺度与纯文字方案。

name: GDC Award (Graphic Design in China)
best_for: China's leading graphic design award, run by the Shenzhen Graphic Design Association since 1992: juried posters, books, identities and packaging from mainland China, Hong Kong and abroad
how_to_use: Browse the Award Archive and GDC Show pages for current Chinese typographic and identity work
zh: GDC 设计奖（平面设计在中国）：深圳市平面设计协会 1992 年创办的国内最具影响力平面设计奖，海报、书籍、识别、包装都有；看当下中文字体与品牌设计水准。

name: Letterform Archive Online
best_for: High-resolution archive of lettering, type specimens and graphic design; free registration
how_to_use: Search by decade, technique or country for authentic period references
zh: 高分辨率字体、字样与平面设计档案馆，免费注册；按年代、工艺、国家找真实的时代参考。

name: People's Graphic Design Archive
best_for: Crowd-sourced archive including everyday and under-documented graphic design
how_to_use: Find vernacular references outside the canon
zh: 众包平面设计档案库，收日常与少被记录的民间设计；找经典正史之外的野生参考时来挖。

name: AIGA Design Archives
best_for: Decades of juried American graphic design
how_to_use: Search by format (book, poster, identity)
zh: AIGA 数十年评审入选的美国平面设计档案；按书籍、海报、识别等形制检索。
caveats: Cloudflare challenge for scripts (403, 2026-09-27)

name: Cooper Hewitt collection
best_for: Smithsonian design museum collection, now browsed through the Smithsonian collections site
how_to_use: Search by period, designer or object type
zh: Smithsonian 设计博物馆馆藏，可按年代、设计师、物件类型检索；不少图片 CC0，逐件确认。
license: Many images are CC0; check each object
caveats: Smithsonian bot verification (403) blocks scripts; open in a browser

name: Paul Rand
best_for: Comprehensive archive of Paul Rand's work and writing
how_to_use: Read /writing/articles/ (essays on logo presentation and design value) before presenting a mark
zh: Paul Rand 作品与著述的完整档案站，他谈 logo 提案与呈现的随笔，给客户汇报前值得重读。

name: Design Reviewed
best_for: Free graphic design history archive: 10,000+ scanned artefacts and 500+ designer profiles across 150 years
how_to_use: Browse /design-movement/<art-deco|swiss-style…>/ and /magazines/ for authentic period references instead of pastiche
zh: 免费的平面设计史档案：1 万+ 扫描原件、500+ 设计师档案，跨越 150 年；按设计运动或杂志找真实时代参考，别做仿品。

name: Deck Gallery
best_for: Curated presentation decks: pitch decks, brand guidelines, reports, portfolios and talks, with per-slide pages
how_to_use: Use /category/pitch/, /category/guideline/ and /slides/ (slides by purpose) to compare title, statement, data and image slides; agents read the free JSON catalogue
zh: 精选演示文稿库：路演、品牌规范、报告、作品集与演讲，每页幻灯片单独成页；另有免费 JSON 目录供智能体读取。
zh_how: 按 /category/pitch/、/category/guideline/、/slides/（按用途分的单页）对照标题页、宣言页、数据页、图片页；智能体直接读 /api/catalog/decks.json。

name: Best Pitch Deck
best_for: 1,400+ decks from funded start-ups with round, amount and year, filterable by stage, industry and business model
how_to_use: Filter with ?stage=Seed (or Series A…) and industry pages such as /AI; learn the narrative order before styling anything
zh: 1400+ 份已融资创业公司的路演 PPT，附轮次、金额与年份，可按阶段、行业、商业模式筛；先学叙事顺序再谈美化。
caveats: Before 2026-09-27 this row pointed at bestpitchdecks.com (plural), which no longer loads

name: Pitch Deck Hunt
best_for: Collection of notable pitch decks
how_to_use: Filter /stage/<pre-seed|seed|series-a> and /pitch-deck-examples/<industry>; second source after Best Pitch Deck
zh: 知名融资路演 PPT 合集；搭路演结构时的第二参考源，看真实 deck 怎么排叙事。

name: Sequoia: Writing a Business Plan
best_for: The canonical pitch narrative outline
how_to_use: Use as the default story spine for an investor deck
zh: Sequoia 的商业计划书写法，路演叙事的经典大纲；做投资人 deck 时当默认故事骨架。

name: Pitch templates
best_for: Professionally designed presentation templates
how_to_use: Reference for slide-layout systems
zh: 专业设计的演示文稿模板库；搭建幻灯片版式体系时，参考它的栅格与信息层级。

name: Coverjunkie
best_for: Magazine covers chosen for their ideas
how_to_use: Reference for single-image, single-headline composition
zh: 以创意取胜的杂志封面合集，做单一图像加单一标题的构图时来这找参照。

name: Spine
best_for: Book-cover design process and interviews
how_to_use: Filter /articles by "The Designer's Process" to see how cover concepts are developed and rejected
zh: 专注书籍封面设计的杂志，讲过程与访谈；看封面方案如何被发展又被否决。

name: Dieline
best_for: Leading packaging-design publication
how_to_use: Browse /category/redesigns/ and search by product category for shelf conventions before breaking them
zh: 包装设计领域的头部媒体；按类目浏览，摸清货架上的品类惯例。

name: Packaging of the World
best_for: Large packaging gallery by category and country
how_to_use: Scan a product category quickly
zh: 大型包装设计画廊，按品类和国家分类；接到包装案时先扫一遍同品类摸清常见套路。
caveats: JavaScript redirect interstitial blocks plain fetches

name: magCulture
best_for: Jeremy Leslie's journal, podcast and shop on independent magazines; the best running record of editorial covers and spreads
how_to_use: Read /blogs/journal for issue-by-issue looks at covers and spreads
zh: Jeremy Leslie 的杂志设计期刊、播客与书店，持续记录独立杂志的封面与内页；编辑排版与封面字体参考。

name: Pentawards
best_for: The global packaging design competition; winners by category and an annual trends report
how_to_use: Browse the winners by category before a packaging brief to learn shelf conventions, then decide which to break
zh: 全球包装设计竞赛，按品类公布获奖作品并出年度趋势报告；接包装案前先看同品类获奖作品，摸清货架惯例再决定打破哪条。

name: The Casual Optimist
best_for: Dan Wagstaff's long-running blog on book covers, with monthly 'covers of note' round-ups and an annual best-of
how_to_use: Read the monthly round-ups for current cover typography and illustration
zh: 长期更新的书封设计博客，每月“值得一看的书封”与年度精选；看当下书封的字体与插画走向。

name: It's Nice That
best_for: The most consistent editorial voice on contemporary graphic design and illustration
how_to_use: Filter by /media/<book|3d|collage…> or /tags/branding; /features for long reads that build art-direction awareness
zh: 当代平面设计与插画领域最稳定的编辑声音；培养 UI 之外的 art direction 敏感度。

name: Creative Boom
best_for: Broad daily coverage of graphic design, branding and illustration
how_to_use: Scan /work/ and /news/ for current commercial identity and illustration work
zh: 每日更新的设计资讯站，覆盖平面、品牌与插画；扫一眼了解当下商业作品的水准与风向。

name: AIGA Eye on Design
best_for: AIGA's critical publication on design culture and history, discontinued in June 2024; the archive is still online
how_to_use: Read for perspective rather than references
zh: AIGA 旗下的设计评论媒体，2024 年 6 月停刊，旧文仍可读；读它换视角，别当素材库用。
caveats: AIGA said it would keep only the 100 most-read articles; the People's Graphic Design Archive keeps a copy

name: Abduzeedo
best_for: Long-running daily inspiration across branding, 3D and UI
how_to_use: Filter /tags/<branding|editorial-design|3d> for quick daily scanning; treat it as volume, not judgement
zh: 老牌每日更新的灵感博客，覆盖面横跨品牌、3D 和 UI；适合泛泛扫图找感觉。

name: 数英 DIGITALING
best_for: Chinese advertising, campaign and brand case library
how_to_use: Use /projects/all (filter by brand, industry and type) for domestic campaign cases
zh: 国内广告与营销活动的案例库；按品牌或类目找本土 campaign 的参考。

name: TOPYS
best_for: Chinese creative-culture publication covering design, advertising and art
how_to_use: Read for cultural context of Chinese visual trends
zh: 中文创意文化媒体，覆盖设计、广告和艺术；了解国内视觉趋势背后的文化语境时读。

name: Eye Magazine
best_for: Eye, the international review of graphic design (since 1990): critical features on typography, identity and design history
how_to_use: Search the archive by designer or topic; many older articles are free online, recent issues are print
zh: 国际平面设计评论杂志《Eye》（1990 年创刊），深度评论字体、识别与设计史；按设计师或主题搜旧文，不少可免费读。

name: Communication Arts
best_for: Communication Arts: juried annuals in design, advertising, illustration, photography, interactive and typography, plus Exhibit and Webpicks features
how_to_use: Use /exhibit for recent standout projects and /webpicks for curated websites; the annuals show what juries value
zh: 老牌设计刊物《Communication Arts》：设计、广告、插画、摄影、交互、字体年鉴，另有 Exhibit 与 Webpicks 精选；看评审眼光。

name: OG Image Gallery
best_for: Open Graph images from real sites
how_to_use: Filter /category/<app|creative|animated> and compare how brands set type and imagery at 1200×630
zh: 收集真实网站 Open Graph 图的画廊；设计社交分享卡片系统之前先看一遍。

name: Sprout Social: social image sizes
best_for: Continuously updated list of image sizes per platform
how_to_use: Verify sizes here, then confirm in the platform's own help pages
zh: 持续更新的各社交平台图片尺寸清单；先在这里查，再去平台官方帮助页复核，数字会过期。

name: Posts Design
best_for: Hand-curated gallery of real social posts and Open Graph images from companies, each linked to its source
how_to_use: Browse /brands/<handle>, /opengraph and /trends; agents query the public JSON search API
zh: 人工精选的真实社媒帖子与 OG 图画廊，每条链回原帖；做社媒图或分享卡片前看同行实际发了什么。

name: The Open Graph protocol
best_for: The specification behind link previews: og:title, og:image (with width, height and alt), og:type and friends
how_to_use: Use as the checklist when shipping social cards; pair it with each platform's own card docs for sizes and crops
zh: 链接预览背后的规范：og:title、og:image（含宽高与 alt）、og:type 等；做分享卡片时当检查清单，尺寸再以各平台文档为准。

name: Canva
best_for: The default tool non-designers use for social graphics, decks and print, with brand kits, size presets and AI
how_to_use: When the client's team will produce assets themselves, deliver the system as a Canva brand kit and templates, not only as files
zh: 非设计师做社媒图、演示与印刷品的默认工具，带品牌套件、尺寸预设与 AI；客户要自己出物料时，把品牌套件和模板交付到这里。
caveats: Bot-protected (403 for scripts)
Template output looks generic unless the brand kit and templates are built for the client

name: Gaoding (稿定设计)
best_for: Chinese Canva-class platform with templates and size presets for 小红书, 公众号, e-commerce images and posters
how_to_use: Check its 小红书 and 公众号 sections for current formats, and supply brand templates when Chinese teams produce assets here
zh: 稿定设计：国产 Canva 类平台，有小红书、公众号、电商图、海报的模板与尺寸预设；国内市场团队常在这里出图。
zh_how: 先看小红书、公众号分区里的当下尺寸与版式，再为客户团队做品牌模板；尺寸以平台官方说明为准。
caveats: Commercial-use rights differ per template: check each
Platform sizes change: confirm with the platform before export

name: Google Fonts
best_for: The largest open font library, with variable fonts, language filters and an API
how_to_use: Filter by language (for example Chinese Simplified) and tick Variable before browsing; agents can list every family with category, axes and subsets from the metadata JSON; self-host the files (Fontsource) rather than hot-linking the CSS API
zh: 最大的开源字体库，有可变字体、语言筛选和 API；建议通过 Fontsource 自托管而非热链，多为 SIL OFL。
zh_how: 先按语言（如简体中文）筛选并勾选可变字体再浏览；智能体可从 metadata JSON 拿到所有字体的分类、可变轴与子集；上线请自托管字体文件（Fontsource），别热链 CSS API。

entry_points.label: CSS2 API (URL syntax for families, axes and ranges)

caveats: The metadata endpoint is undocumented and may change; the CSS2 API is the documented interface
Hot-linking fonts.googleapis.com sends each visitor's IP address to Google; for EU audiences self-host or use Bunny Fonts

name: Fontsource
best_for: Self-hostable open fonts as npm packages with an API
how_to_use: npm i @fontsource-variable/<name> (or @fontsource/<name>) and import it; the API returns weights, subsets, variable flag and licence per family
zh: 把开源字体打包成 npm 包自托管，附 API；每个字体保留各自的开源协议。
zh_how: npm i @fontsource-variable/<字体名>（或 @fontsource/<字体名>）后在代码里 import；API（api.fontsource.org/v1/fonts/<id>）返回字重、子集、是否可变与授权。
license: Each font keeps its own open licence

name: Fontshare
best_for: Professional-grade free fonts from Indian Type Foundry (Satoshi, General Sans, Clash, Cabinet Grotesk)
how_to_use: Browse by category and try Satoshi, General Sans or Cabinet Grotesk as the way out of Inter; agents load fonts through the CSS API and list families as JSON
zh: Indian Type Foundry 的专业级免费字体（Satoshi、Clash 等）；跳出 Inter/Roboto 默认的最快路径，可商用、不可转售。
zh_how: 按分类浏览，试试 Satoshi、General Sans、Cabinet Grotesk 代替 Inter；智能体用 CSS API （api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=<slug>@<字重>）加载字体，用 api.fontshare.com/v2/fonts 取 JSON 字体列表。
license: ITF Free Font License: free for commercial use; no redistribution or resale
caveats: The ITF Free Font License allows commercial use but not redistribution: do not bundle the files into a template, kit or public repo

name: Uncut
best_for: Catalogue of contemporary free typefaces with character
how_to_use: Filter by style (sans, serif, mono, display), open the typeface page and follow its licence link before use; licences differ per font
zh: 当代免费字体目录，专收有个性的展示字体；按风格筛选，逐款核对许可，多为 OFL。

name: Velvetyne
best_for: Libre foundry of expressive, experimental display faces
how_to_use: Use for posters, covers and identities that need a voice; download from each font page, where the licence and designers are listed
zh: 自由字体铸造厂，专出表现力强的实验性展示字；海报与识别要个性时用；SIL OFL。

name: Open Foundry
best_for: Curated open-source typefaces presented well
how_to_use: Browse the short curated list when an open typeface must look commercial-grade; follow each font to its source and licence
zh: 精选开源字体站，展示做得讲究，重质不重量；逐款字体查看各自的开源许可。

name: Use & Modify
best_for: Personal selection of beautiful, classy, punk libre fonts
how_to_use: Browse for unusual libre display faces for editorial and cultural projects; each entry links the designer's download and licence
zh: 个人策展的自由字体选集，品味偏优雅与朋克；找不撞脸的开放字体来这，逐字体开源授权。

name: The League of Moveable Type
best_for: The original open-source type foundry (League Gothic, Raleway origins)
how_to_use: Use for dependable open display classics (League Gothic, League Spartan, Ostrich Sans); most are also on Google Fonts and Fontsource for self-hosting
zh: 开源字体界的鼻祖级字厂，League Gothic、Raleway 都出自这里；想要经典可靠的免费字体时用它，SIL OFL。

name: Collletttivo
best_for: Italian open-source type collective publishing distinctive display and text faces under the OFL
how_to_use: Browse for contemporary display and text faces; download from each font page and check glyph coverage for your languages
zh: 意大利的开源字体厂牌社区，展示字与正文字体都很有个性；SIL OFL。

name: Free Faces
best_for: Curated gallery of free typefaces from around the web
how_to_use: Check personal-only versus commercial use per font
zh: 免费字体策展画廊，从全网挑出品相好的；逐款确认个人使用还是可商用，许可各不同。
license: Licences vary per font; read each

name: Inter
best_for: The workhorse UI typeface; excellent, and the most over-used default
how_to_use: Use deliberately, with its OpenType features (tnum for tables, cv11 single-storey a, ss03 round quotes) and the optical-size axis in Inter 4
zh: UI 字体的劳模，极好也极滥；要有意识地用，发挥 tnum、cv11 等 OpenType 特性，别凭条件反射；SIL OFL。
caveats: The default typeface of countless AI-generated and SaaS interfaces; choose it for a reason, not by reflex

name: IBM Plex
best_for: Sans, serif, mono and condensed superfamily with wide language coverage including CJK
how_to_use: Use when one family must cover sans, serif, mono and CJK (Plex Sans SC, TC, JP, KR); Plex Mono pairs naturally for code and data
zh: IBM 的超级字族，无衬线、衬线、等宽、窄体齐全且覆盖中日韩；一套字体撑起整个产品，OFL。

name: Geist
best_for: Vercel's sans and mono for developer products
how_to_use: Install from the geist npm package or Google Fonts; pair Geist Sans with Geist Mono for code and numbers
zh: Vercel 出的无衬线与等宽字体，为开发者产品设计；工具类产品里快成默认选了，SIL OFL。
caveats: Now the default look of many AI-generated dashboards and dev-tool sites; it reads as generic unless the rest of the design carries identity

name: Monaspace
best_for: Five-voice monospace superfamily with texture healing
how_to_use: Mix its five voices (Neon neo-grotesque, Argon humanist, Xenon slab, Radon handwriting, Krypton mechanical) to separate code, comments and AI suggestions; texture healing works through calt
zh: GitHub 出的五声部等宽字体超族，带 texture healing 排印微调；代码密集型界面优先用它；SIL OFL。
zh_how: 混用五种声部（Neon 新怪诞、Argon 人文、Xenon 粗衬线、Radon 手写、Krypton 机械）区分代码、注释与 AI 建议；texture healing 通过 calt 特性生效。

name: Atkinson Hyperlegible
best_for: Braille Institute's family for low-vision legibility with unambiguous letterforms, now in three versions: the original, Next (2025: seven weights plus variable, 150+ languages) and Mono
how_to_use: Use Next for interfaces where legibility is the primary constraint, Mono for code; keep the 2019 original only for existing work
zh: 盲人学院为低视力读者设计的字体，字形互不混淆；现有三版：原版、Next（2025，七个字重加可变版，支持 150+ 语言）和 Mono。无障碍优先的界面用 Next。

name: Noto
best_for: Harmonised families for nearly every script
how_to_use: Use as the fallback layer in font stacks for scripts the brand face lacks; Noto Sans and Serif CJK are the same designs as Source Han
zh: Google 的 Noto 家族覆盖几乎所有文字系统且风格统一；多语言产品的兜底字体。SIL OFL。

name: google-webfonts-helper
best_for: Download Google Fonts files with ready @font-face CSS for self-hosting
how_to_use: Pick only the weights, styles and subsets you need, download the zip with generated @font-face CSS, and self-host it
zh: 下载 Google Fonts 字体文件并生成自托管 @font-face CSS 的工具；只挑需要的字重与子集。

name: Google Sans Flex
best_for: Google's brand sans, open-sourced in late 2025 with six axes: weight, width, optical size, slant, grade and roundness
how_to_use: Use for expressive UI where one family must flex (roundness and width for tone, grade for dark mode); it reads as Google, so avoid it for brands that must not
zh: Google 品牌无衬线字体，2025 年底以 OFL 开源，六个可变轴：字重、宽度、视觉尺寸、倾斜、字级（grade）与圆角；一套字体撑起多种语气，但 Google 辨识度高。
zh_how: 圆角轴与宽度轴调语气，grade 轴在深色模式下补偿笔画；品牌需要避开 Google 联想时别用。

name: Mona Sans and Hubot Sans
best_for: GitHub's open variable grotesques with a wide width axis, strong for display type and product UI
how_to_use: Use the width axis for headline contrast inside one family; Hubot Sans is the more technical companion
zh: GitHub 开源的可变无衬线（Mona Sans 与 Hubot Sans），宽度轴跨度大；用宽度轴在同一家族里拉开标题对比，Hubot Sans 更偏技术感。

name: Maple Mono
best_for: Open monospace with rounded forms, ligatures and Nerd Font icons; its CN build pairs Latin with Simplified, Traditional Chinese and Japanese at an exact 2:1 width
how_to_use: Use the CN build (Maple Mono NF CN) for code, terminals and Markdown tables that mix Chinese and Latin
zh: 圆润的开源等宽字体，带连字与 Nerd Font 图标；CN 版中英文严格 2:1 对齐，覆盖简繁中文与日文；代码、终端、Markdown 表格中英混排时用。
caveats: The CN build has no variable version and wider Chinese spacing than most Chinese UI fonts

name: Apple fonts (SF Pro, SF Compact, SF Mono, New York)
best_for: Official downloads of Apple's system typefaces (SF Pro with optical sizes and widths, SF Compact, SF Mono, New York) for designing Apple-platform interfaces
how_to_use: Install for iOS, iPadOS, macOS and watchOS mock-ups; on the web use the system-ui / -apple-system stack instead of shipping the files
zh: 苹果系统字体（SF Pro、SF Compact、SF Mono、New York）官方下载，做苹果平台界面稿时安装；网页请用 system-ui 字体栈，不要上传字体文件。
license: Apple licence: only for designing and developing software for Apple platforms
caveats: The licence forbids use outside Apple-platform design and development: not for Android, web embedding or brand work

name: Bunny Fonts
best_for: Privacy-first mirror of the Google Fonts catalogue with a drop-in compatible CSS API and no visitor logging
how_to_use: Swap fonts.googleapis.com for fonts.bunny.net in the stylesheet URL when self-hosting is not possible and EU privacy matters
zh: 注重隐私的 Google Fonts 镜像，CSS 接口与 Google 兼容、不记录访客；做欧盟项目又不便自托管时，把 fonts.googleapis.com 换成 fonts.bunny.net。
license: Fonts keep their own open licences

name: Font Squirrel
best_for: Hand-picked fonts that are free for commercial use, plus the long-standing Webfont Generator and a font identifier
how_to_use: Filter by licence scope; use the Webfont Generator to subset and convert a font you are licensed to embed
zh: 精选可免费商用的字体，附老牌 Webfont Generator（子集化与格式转换）和字体识别；只转换你有嵌入授权的字体。
license: Licence per font; each page shows the scope

name: Klim Type Foundry
best_for: Soehne, Tiempos, National: benchmark contemporary text and grotesque families
how_to_use: Read the design-information essay for each family, and use test fonts for mock-ups before licensing
zh: 新西兰字厂，Soehne、Tiempos 等当代正文与无衬线标杆；付费商用，试用字体只能出稿不能上线。
license: Commercial; free test fonts for mock-ups only
caveats: Test fonts are for mock-ups only and must not ship

name: Grilli Type
best_for: GT America, GT Walsheim and richly documented mini-sites per family
how_to_use: Study the specimen mini-sites for how a typeface is presented; use trial fonts for pitches and mock-ups only
zh: 瑞士字厂，GT America、GT Walsheim 出自其手，每款字体配独立标本小站；商用付费，有试用字体。

name: Commercial Type
best_for: Editorial heavyweights (Graphik, Canela, Publico)
how_to_use: Reference for editorial pairings (Canela or Publico display over Graphik text); license before launch
zh: 编辑设计圈的重炮字厂（Graphik、Canela、Publico）；做 editorial 排版时当字体搭配参照；商业授权。
caveats: The site renders client-side: agents fetch an empty page

name: ABC Dinamo
best_for: Contemporary variable families (Diatype, Favorit, Whyte) and tools
how_to_use: Use trial fonts for mock-ups and license before launch; test the variable axes in the specimens
zh: 当代可变字体厂牌，Diatype、Favorit 等定义潮流的那批；商用付费，可申请试用。
caveats: Diatype, Favorit and Whyte are everywhere in startup branding, so they date a design quickly

name: Pangram Pangram
best_for: Fashion-forward families that are free to try
how_to_use: Download to try in mock-ups, then buy the commercial licence before anything ships
zh: 风格前卫的字体厂牌，可免费试用；个人版文件不能商用，正式项目需购买商业许可。
license: Free for personal use; commercial licence required
caveats: Free-to-try files are licensed for personal use only

name: OH no Type Co.
best_for: Expressive display faces and an excellent type-design blog
how_to_use: Read the blog for drawing and spacing lessons
zh: 出表现力展示字体的铸造厂，附一流的字体设计博客；博客里的笔画与字距课值得读；字体付费。

name: Future Fonts
best_for: Marketplace for in-progress typefaces bought early at lower prices
how_to_use: Buy early versions at a lower price and receive updates; check glyph coverage first, because in-progress fonts may lack characters
zh: 未完成字体的早鸟市场，低价买入、随更新升值；想用小众新面孔时逛这里，付费。

name: Typotheque
best_for: Multi-script specialist with serious research articles
how_to_use: Read /articles for multilingual typography
zh: 多文种字体专家，研究文章质量高；做多语言排版先读它的 articles，商用授权。

name: Adobe Fonts
best_for: Large commercial library bundled with Creative Cloud
how_to_use: Activate for desktop mock-ups; on the web serve only through Adobe's embed project
zh: Creative Cloud 捆绑的大型商业字体库；网页只能走 Adobe 嵌入、不能自托管，客户项目需客户自己的订阅。
license: Included with Creative Cloud; no self-hosting; client projects need the client's own subscription
caveats: No self-hosting; a client project needs the client's own Creative Cloud subscription

name: Fontstand
best_for: Try commercial fonts free for an hour and rent them monthly
how_to_use: Test a commercial face in a real layout before buying
zh: 商用字体免费试一小时、按月租用；买之前先在真实版面里验货。

name: YouWorkForThem
best_for: Independent shop for fonts and graphic assets (display faces, vector shape packs, textures)
how_to_use: Useful for distinctive display type and Y2K-style vector packs
zh: 独立字体与图形素材商店，展示字体和 Y2K 风矢量包有特色；买断制许可，无需订阅。

name: Fonts In Use
best_for: Archive of typography in real use, indexed by typeface, format and industry
how_to_use: Search a typeface to see it set in context, or browse by format (packaging, web, book) and industry to learn a sector's conventions
zh: 真实使用中的字体档案，按字体、形制、行业索引；查一款字体的实际排印效果或某行业的用字惯例。
zh_how: 搜一款字体看它在真实作品里的样子，或按形制（包装、网页、书籍）与行业浏览，了解某个领域的用字惯例。

name: Typewolf
best_for: Type on real websites, plus trusted lists: best fonts by category and free alternatives to commercial faces
how_to_use: Use the curated lists (best Google Fonts, free alternatives to commercial faces) and /cheatsheet for quotes, dashes and other typographic characters
zh: 真实网站用字观察站，另有分类最佳字体与商用字体免费平替榜；预算不够时查平替清单。

name: Beautiful Web Type
best_for: Showcase of the best open-source typefaces set beautifully
how_to_use: Use its in-depth guide as a shortlist of open fonts, each shown set as a page with a download link
zh: 把最好的开源字体排出漂亮版式的展示站，等于一份值得用的开源字体短名单。

name: Variable Fonts
best_for: Catalogue of variable fonts with live axis sliders
how_to_use: Drag every axis with your own text before choosing; each entry links to the foundry
zh: 可变字体目录，带实时轴滑杆；选定字体前先把各轴拉一遍试试。

name: Fontjoy
best_for: Machine-learned font pairing generator
how_to_use: Idea generator only; judge pairings by eye
zh: 机器学习生成字体搭配的工具；只当点子发生器，好不好看靠自己眼睛判。

name: Fonts Ninja
best_for: Browser extension that names the fonts on any live page, plus a catalogue of fonts spotted on websites
how_to_use: Run the extension on a reference site to get the exact families and weights before looking for licensed or open equivalents
zh: 浏览器扩展，可识别任意网页上用的字体，附一份网站实际用字的字体目录；看到好的参考站先用它查出字体与字重，再找授权或开源替代。

name: Fontpair
best_for: Gallery of Google Fonts pairings shown as headline and body specimens
how_to_use: Scan for a starting pair, then test it with your real copy and sizes; the pairings are safe rather than distinctive
zh: Google Fonts 字体搭配画廊，以标题加正文样张展示；拿来找起点，再用真实文案和字号验证，搭配偏稳妥、不出彩。

name: Utopia
best_for: Fluid type and space scales that interpolate between a small and a large viewport, output as CSS clamp()
how_to_use: Set min and max viewport, base size and ratio in the type calculator and copy the clamp() custom properties; the space calculator produces matching fluid spacing
zh: 流式字号与间距刻度生成器，在大小两个视口间插值并输出 CSS clamp()；定好最小最大刻度后抄走。
zh_how: 在字号计算器里设最小与最大视口、基准字号和比率，复制生成的 clamp() 变量；间距计算器给出配套的流式间距。

name: Modern Font Stacks
best_for: System font stacks by typographic classification, no web fonts needed
how_to_use: Copy a stack by classification (System UI, Humanist, Neo-Grotesque, Monospace Code and others) for zero-download, native-feeling type; the CSS also lives in the GitHub repo
zh: 按字体风格分类的系统字体栈，无需加载网络字体；要零成本原生感排版就抄一组，CC0。

name: Typescale
best_for: Visual type-scale calculator with live preview and export
how_to_use: Compare ratios with the real typeface and your own copy, then export the CSS
zh: 可视化字号比例计算器，实时预览可导出；用真实字体比较不同比率。

name: Wakamai Fondue
best_for: Drop a font to see its features, axes, languages and ready CSS
how_to_use: Check what a font can do before designing with it
zh: 把字体文件拖进去就能看特性、可变轴、支持语言并生成 CSS；用一款字体前先摸清它的底细。

name: Capsize
best_for: Trims text boxes to cap height and baseline using font metrics
how_to_use: Use until CSS text-box (text-box-trim and text-box-edge) reaches Baseline; it is in Chrome, Edge and Safari but not Firefox
zh: 按字体度量把文本框精确裁到 cap height 与基线的工具；在 text-box-trim 普及之前都靠它；MIT。
zh_how: 在 CSS text-box（text-box-trim、text-box-edge）进入 Baseline 之前用它；目前 Chrome、Edge、Safari 已支持，Firefox 未支持。

name: Fallback font generator
best_for: Generates metric overrides so a fallback font matches the web font and avoids layout shift
how_to_use: Paste the result into the @font-face for the fallback
zh: 生成字体度量覆盖，让回退字体对齐网络字体、避免布局偏移；结果贴进回退的 @font-face。

name: glyphhanger
best_for: Finds the glyphs a site uses and subsets fonts accordingly
how_to_use: Use for Latin subsetting in build pipelines
zh: 找出页面实际用到的字形并按需裁剪字体的工具；构建管线里做拉丁子集化用。MIT。

name: WhatTheFont
best_for: Identify a typeface from an image
how_to_use: Upload a crop of one clean line of text; results come from the MyFonts catalogue, so cross-check open fonts elsewhere and use 求字体 or 字由 for Chinese
zh: 上传图片识别字体的工具；从一张截图里提取风格 DNA 时，这是第一步。

name: FontDrop!
best_for: Drop a font file to see its glyphs, metrics, OpenType features, language support and name-table metadata
how_to_use: Check a font's licence and vendor fields and its language coverage before adopting it
zh: 拖入字体文件即可查看字形、度量、OpenType 特性、语言覆盖与 name 表元数据；采用字体前先看授权字段和语言覆盖。
caveats: JS app: agents need a browser

name: Transfonter
best_for: Online converter to WOFF2 with subsetting, vertical-metrics fixes and generated @font-face CSS
how_to_use: Use for quick Latin subsetting of fonts you may embed; use cn-font-split for Chinese
zh: 在线把字体转成 WOFF2，可子集化、修正垂直度量并生成 @font-face CSS；拉丁字体快速子集化用它，中文请用 cn-font-split。

name: Practical Typography
best_for: Butterick's web book: the most useful typography rules per minute of reading
how_to_use: Read Typography in ten minutes and Summary of key rules
zh: Butterick 的在线排版书，单位时间收获最大的排版规则集；先读「十分钟排版」与规则摘要两章。

name: Google Fonts Knowledge
best_for: Structured lessons on choosing, pairing and using type, including variable fonts
how_to_use: Look up a topic (pairing, legibility, OpenType features)
zh: Google 的字体知识库，结构化讲解选字、搭配与可变字体；查排版、可读性、OpenType 特性用它。

name: Thinking with Type (3rd edition)
best_for: Ellen Lupton's primer on letter, text and grid, revised with material on non-Latin writing systems and typeface design
how_to_use: Read the Grid chapter before any layout-heavy graphic
zh: Ellen Lupton 的字体入门经典（第三版），讲字母、文本与网格，新增非拉丁文字系统与字体设计内容；做重排版设计前先读网格一章。付费书。
caveats: The old companion site thinkingwithtype.com no longer belongs to the book (it redirects to a Namecheap page); its free lessons are gone

name: The Elements of Typographic Style Applied to the Web
best_for: Bringhurst's principles translated into CSS
how_to_use: Look up a Bringhurst principle (rhythm, measure, proportion) and its web translation; take the principle, not the dated CSS
zh: 把 Bringhurst 的经典排印原则逐条译成 CSS；查网页文字的节奏与比例规则时用。
caveats: Examples predate variable fonts, text-wrap and text-box
Behind a bot wall for scripted fetches

name: Better Web Type
best_for: Web typography course and articles for developers
how_to_use: Take the free course in order (rhythm, scale, line length, pairing), then keep the articles for reference
zh: 面向开发者的网页排版课程与短文，篇幅短、重实操；补字体排印基本功时按课学。

name: Pimp my Type
best_for: Font reviews, pairing and UI-typography advice
how_to_use: Look up font-of-the-week reviews for well-judged open fonts
zh: 字体评测、搭配与 UI 排印建议的博客；每周字体评测里常有判断可靠的开源字。

name: Web Design is 95% Typography
best_for: The classic argument that treating text as UI is most of web design
how_to_use: Read once to recalibrate: treat text as the interface and judge a layout by its reading experience
zh: 经典檄文，主张网页设计九成是字体排印、要把文字当界面看；读一遍校准观念。

name: web.dev: font best practices
best_for: Font loading, preloading, subsetting and font-display strategy
how_to_use: Follow its checklist when adding any web font: self-host or preconnect, preload only the critical file, choose font-display deliberately, subset
zh: web.dev 的字体最佳实践：加载、预载、子集化与 font-display 策略；给网页加任何字体前照做。

name: Source Han Sans / Serif (思源黑体 / 宋体)
best_for: The open pan-CJK standard in seven weights; identical to Noto Sans / Serif CJK
how_to_use: Default open choice for Chinese, Japanese and Korean text; ship subsetted or sliced (cn-font-split), never the full OTC
zh: 开源泛 CJK 标准字体，七个字重，等同 Noto Sans/Serif CJK；中文默认开源选择，上线记得子集化；SIL OFL。
zh_how: 中日韩正文的默认开源选择；上线必须子集化或切片（cn-font-split），不要直接发整包字体文件。

entry_points.label: Source Han Serif / 思源宋体 (GitHub)

name: 猫啃网
best_for: Directory of free-for-commercial Chinese fonts with licence evidence for each
how_to_use: Check here before using any Chinese font found elsewhere
zh: 免费商用中文字体目录，每款附授权证据；别处找到的中文字体先来这核对再用。
zh_how: 在别处看到中文字体，先来这里搜名字核对授权证据；免费商用字体清单页按风格分类。

name: 中文网字计划
best_for: Free CDN of sliced Chinese web fonts plus cn-font-split, the tool that slices any CJK font into unicode-range chunks
how_to_use: Load a sliced font from the CDN for prototypes; for production slice your own licensed font with cn-font-split (npm) so browsers fetch only the characters a page uses
zh: 中文网字计划：免费的中文字体分片 CDN，配套 cn-font-split 可把任意中日韩字体切成 unicode-range 分片，浏览器只加载页面用到的字；Apache-2.0 工具，字体各自授权。
zh_how: 原型阶段直接引 CDN 上的分片字体；正式上线用 cn-font-split（npm）切自己有授权的字体并自托管。
license: Apache-2.0 tooling; fonts keep their own licences
caveats: The CDN domain moved in 2026 (chinese-fonts-cdn.deno.dev is being retired); pin URLs from the CDN page or self-host

name: Requirements for Chinese Text Layout (中文排版需求)
best_for: The W3C reference for Chinese typesetting: punctuation, line breaking, mixed-script spacing, emphasis, vertical text
how_to_use: Look up the rule before arguing about punctuation or line-start prohibitions
zh: W3C 的中文排版需求文档：标点、断行、中西混排间距、强调、竖排；争论标点与行首禁则前查它。
zh_how: 争论标点挤压、行首行尾禁则、中西文间距前先查对应章节；智能体读 w3c.github.io/clreq/ 镜像（w3.org 对脚本返回 403）。

name: 中文文案排版指北
best_for: Widely adopted conventions for spacing, punctuation and proper nouns in Chinese copy
how_to_use: Adopt one convention per product and lint for it
zh: 中文文案排版通行约定：空格、标点与专名的写法；产品里选定一套规则并配工具检查，MIT。

name: Alibaba PuHuiTi (阿里巴巴普惠体)
best_for: Modern Chinese sans in many weights with Latin companions
how_to_use: Download from the official site to keep the licence record
zh: 多字重的现代中文黑体，配西文；从官网下载以留授权记录；免费商用，不可转售字体文件。
license: Free for commercial use under Alibaba's licence terms; no resale of the font files

name: HarmonyOS Sans
best_for: Huawei's system typeface covering Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Latin and more
how_to_use: Use for HarmonyOS apps and as a neutral UI face
zh: 华为系统字体，覆盖简繁中文与拉丁等多文种；鸿蒙应用标配，也可当中性 UI 字体。免费商用。
license: Free commercial use under the HarmonyOS Sans licence agreement

name: MiSans
best_for: Xiaomi's variable Chinese sans with wide weight range
how_to_use: Use the variable version for fine weight steps in UI; download from the official page to keep the licence agreement
zh: 小米的可变中文无衬线，字重范围宽；可变字重适合流动的 UI 层级；依小米协议免费商用。
license: Free commercial use under Xiaomi's licence agreement

name: Smiley Sans (得意黑)
best_for: Open-source condensed oblique Chinese display face with real character
how_to_use: Use for headlines, posters and campaign type only; the condensed oblique forms tire the eye at text sizes
zh: 得意黑：开源的窄体斜势中文标题字，性格鲜明；只适合标题场景，OFL 协议。

name: LXGW WenKai (霞鹜文楷)
best_for: Open-source Kai-style face for warm, literary reading text
how_to_use: Use for literary, editorial and note-taking tone; LXGW WenKai Screen is the build tuned for screens
zh: 开源楷体风格中文字体，气质温润，适合人文阅读类正文与编辑设计；SIL OFL 协议。

name: 方正字库
best_for: China's largest commercial type library
how_to_use: License per use (print, web, app, video) before any commercial use; the same applies to Hanyi and other commercial Chinese foundries
zh: 国内最大的商业字库；商用须按用途购买授权，侵权追责活跃，别存侥幸心理。
license: Commercial licence required per use; enforcement is active
caveats: Infringement claims over unlicensed Chinese fonts are common and actively pursued

name: The Type
best_for: The most serious Chinese-language writing on type and typesetting, including the Kongque punctuation research
how_to_use: Read Kongque for punctuation width and spacing behaviour
zh: 中文圈最认真的字体与排印写作媒体，'孔雀计划'讲清标点宽度与间距；做中文排版必读。

entry_points.label: 孔雀计划 (Kongque: punctuation in Chinese typesetting)

name: 赫蹏 (heti)
best_for: CSS typesetting enhancement for Chinese content: punctuation squeezing, mixed-script spacing, rhythm
how_to_use: Add the heti class to long-form Chinese article containers for punctuation squeezing, CJK-Latin spacing and vertical rhythm; not for app UI
zh: 中文排版增强 CSS 库：标点挤压、中西文混排间距、阅读节奏；用在正文页上；MIT。

name: pangu.js
best_for: Automatically inserts spacing between CJK and half-width characters
how_to_use: Prefer fixing copy at the source; use for user-generated text
zh: 自动在中日韩与半角字符间加空格的库；能改源头文案就先改，用户生成内容靠它兜底；MIT。

name: AutoCorrect
best_for: Linter and formatter for CJK copy: spacing, punctuation, full-width rules
how_to_use: Put it in CI to keep product copy consistent
zh: 中文文案的 lint 工具，自动处理中英文间距、标点和全半角规则；接入 CI 保持文案一致。MIT。

name: Pretendard
best_for: The de-facto Korean UI typeface: Hangul from Source Han Sans with Inter-derived Latin, nine weights plus variable, and a JP build with M PLUS 1p
how_to_use: Default for Korean interfaces; use the dynamic-subset web build, and Pretendard JP when Japanese is needed
zh: 事实上的韩文界面字体：韩文基于思源黑体、拉丁字母源自 Inter，九个字重另有可变版，并有融合 M PLUS 1p 的日文版；韩文界面默认选它。

name: LINE Seed
best_for: LINE's open brand typeface family with Japanese, Korean, Thai, Traditional Chinese and Latin versions
how_to_use: Use for friendly East-Asian multi-script products; in Japan it reads as LINE
zh: LINE 开源品牌字体家族，含日文、韩文、泰文、繁体中文与拉丁版本；适合亲和的东亚多语产品，但在日本 LINE 联想很强。

name: Noonnu (눈누)
best_for: Directory of free-for-commercial Korean fonts with the licence scope of each font
how_to_use: Check here before using any Korean font found elsewhere, and read the scope (print, web, video, embedding)
zh: 可免费商用的韩文字体目录，逐款标注授权范围；用别处找到的韩文字体前先来核对，注意印刷、网页、视频、嵌入各自的范围。

name: Hanyi Fonts (汉仪字库)
best_for: Major commercial Chinese foundry with a very large library and active licence enforcement
how_to_use: Never ship a Hanyi font commercially without a purchased licence; match the licence scope (web, app, video, print) to the use
zh: 国内主要商业字库之一，字库庞大、维权积极；没有购买授权绝不能商用，授权范围（网页、App、视频、印刷）要和用途一致。
caveats: Fonts preinstalled on a computer or bundled with software are not licensed for commercial design work

name: justfont
best_for: Taiwanese foundry and type-education team behind 金萱 (Jinxuan) and other Traditional Chinese families, with a web-font service
how_to_use: Use for Traditional Chinese products and read its type-education articles on Chinese typesetting
zh: 台湾字体公司与字体教育团队，出品金萱等繁体中文字体并提供网页字体服务；繁体中文产品选字、学中文排版都值得看。

name: 100font.com
best_for: Directory of free-for-commercial fonts, mostly Chinese, filterable by script and style, with licence notes and downloads
how_to_use: Second licence check after 猫啃网; confirm on the vendor's own page before shipping
zh: 免费商用字体大全，以中文为主，可按简繁、日韩与风格筛选，附授权说明与下载；猫啃网之后的第二道授权核对，上线前再到厂商官网确认。

name: HelloFont (字由)
best_for: Chinese font manager with licence labels, one-click font switching in design apps and an AI font recogniser
how_to_use: Run the recogniser on a screenshot, then verify the licence before using the match
zh: 字由：中文字体管理工具，标注授权、在设计软件里一键换字，并有 AI 字体识别；识别出结果后先核对授权再用。

name: Qiuziti (求字体)
best_for: Image-based font identification for Chinese, Latin, Japanese and Korean text: the Chinese WhatTheFont
how_to_use: Upload a crop of the characters (JPG or PNG, up to 800 KB) to identify the face, then check its licence on 猫啃网 or the foundry
zh: 上传图片识别字体，支持中、英、日、韩；中文圈的 WhatTheFont。识别后去猫啃网或字厂核对授权。
caveats: A download link here does not grant a licence; many identified fonts are commercial

name: Douyin Sans (抖音美好体)
best_for: ByteDance's open bold display face with 6,763 Chinese characters and 682 Latin, figure and punctuation glyphs
how_to_use: Headlines and campaign graphics only; it carries a strong Douyin association
zh: 抖音品牌创意中心以 OFL 开源的粗体展示字体，收 6763 个汉字和 682 个数字西文符号；只用于标题与活动物料，抖音联想强。

name: Sarasa Gothic (更纱黑体)
best_for: CJK composite font built from Inter, Iosevka and Source Han Sans: UI and monospace styles with exact 2:1 CJK-Latin width
how_to_use: Use for code, tables and terminals that mix CJK and Latin; remove the old version completely before installing an update
zh: 更纱黑体：由 Inter、Iosevka 与思源黑体合成的中日韩字体，含 UI 与等宽样式，中英文严格 2:1 对齐；代码、表格、终端中英混排时用。

name: Requirements for Japanese Text Layout (日本語組版処理の要件)
best_for: The W3C reference for Japanese typesetting: line breaking, punctuation, ruby, mixed scripts and vertical text
how_to_use: Use with clreq when a product ships Japanese as well as Chinese; agents read the GitHub mirror
zh: W3C 日文排版需求：断行、标点、注音（ruby）、混排与竖排；产品同时有日文和中文时与 clreq 一起查。
caveats: www.w3.org answers scripted fetches with a bot wall (403); use the mirror

name: Requirements for Hangul Text Layout and Typography (klreq)
best_for: The W3C reference for Korean text layout: line-breaking and word-break rules, line-head and line-end restrictions, punctuation, spacing and mixed Hangul-Latin text
how_to_use: Look up Korean-specific rules (word-break restrictions, punctuation position, Hangul-Latin spacing) when a product ships Korean
zh: W3C 韩文排版需求：断行与单词分割规则、行首行尾禁则、标点、字距，以及韩文与拉丁字母混排；产品上韩文时查对应规则。
caveats: www.w3.org answers scripted fetches with a bot wall (403); use the mirror

name: Coolors
best_for: Fast palette generator with locking, contrast check and a large explore section
how_to_use: Lock the brand colour, generate around it; verify contrast separately
zh: 快速配色生成器，可锁定单色、查对比度、逛灵感区；锁住品牌色往外生成，对比度另行验证。
caveats: Cloudflare wall blocks scripted fetches: send the link
Contrast and colour-blind checks are basic; verify roles with a contrast tool

name: Realtime Colors
best_for: Preview a palette and font pair on a real page layout, then export tokens
how_to_use: The fastest sanity check of a palette in context
zh: 在真实页面版式上预览配色与字体搭配，可导出 token；给配色方案做体检的最快办法。
zh_how: 把 5 个角色色（文字、背景、主色、辅色、强调色）填进去看真实页面，满意后导出 CSS 变量或 Tailwind 配置，再用对比度工具核对。

name: Happy Hues
best_for: Curated palettes shown applied to a page, with role labels
how_to_use: Learn role assignment, not just swatches
zh: 把精选色板直接套在页面上展示并标注角色，学的是颜色分工，不只是抄色值。

name: Huemint
best_for: Machine-learned palettes previewed on brand and website mock-ups
how_to_use: Generate on the mock-up closest to the deliverable
zh: 机器学习生成配色，直接在品牌和网页样机上预览；在最接近交付物的样机上生成。

name: Adobe Color
best_for: Harmony rules, extraction from images, contrast and colour-blind checks
how_to_use: Extract a palette from a reference photograph, then run the colour-blind simulator and contrast checker pages on the result
zh: 配色和谐规则、从图片取色、对比度与色盲检查一体；拿参考照片提取色板。

name: Color Hunt
best_for: Community palettes sorted by popularity and tag
how_to_use: Treat as a trend indicator
zh: 社区配色方案库，按人气和标签排序；当成流行趋势风向标参考，别当最终方案。

name: A Dictionary of Color Combinations (Sanzo Wada)
best_for: Interactive version of Wada's 348 colour combinations from 1930s Japan
how_to_use: Browse the numbered combinations and copy the swatches as a starting point for unusual pairings; assign roles and check contrast before use
zh: 和田三造 1930 年代 348 组配色组合的交互版；找不落俗套的成熟配色。

name: Nippon Colors
best_for: Traditional colours of Japan with names and values
how_to_use: Named traditional hues for East Asian contexts
zh: 日本传统色数据库，色名与色值俱全；做东方语境配色时，从这里取有出处的颜色。

name: 中国色
best_for: 500+ traditional Chinese colours with name, pinyin, CMYK, RGB and hex, citing the Chinese Academy of Sciences 色谱 colour standard; also served as JSON, llms.txt and an MCP endpoint
how_to_use: Pick colours by name for Chinese cultural contexts and record the name with the value; agents read /colors.json or connect to the MCP endpoint at /mcp
zh: 中国传统色网站：500 多种传统色的名称、拼音、CMYK、RGB 与十六进制值，注明依据中科院《色谱》标准；另提供 colors.json、llms.txt 与 MCP 接口。
zh_how: 按色名取色，并把色名和色值一起记进 token；智能体读 https://zhongguose.com/colors.json，或接入 https://zhongguose.com/mcp（流式 HTTP MCP）。
caveats: In colors.json the hex and RGB values disagree for some colours (for example 杏仁黄): recompute hex from the value you trust

name: Poline
best_for: Palette generator drawing lines between anchors in polar colour space
how_to_use: For generative and illustrative palettes
zh: 在极坐标色彩空间里锚点连线生成配色的工具；做生成式、插画感配色用；MIT。

name: BrandColors
best_for: Official brand colour codes
how_to_use: Look up how brands in a category use colour and download a collection as ASE, CSS or SCSS; confirm each value against the brand's own guidelines
zh: 收录各品牌官方色值的档案站；用来查某个行业的用色惯例。
caveats: Unofficial and not dated per brand: values may be out of date

name: OKLCH Color Picker
best_for: Picker and converter for OKLCH with gamut visualisation (sRGB, P3, Rec2020)
how_to_use: See where a colour leaves the sRGB gamut before building a scale
zh: OKLCH 取色与转换工具，可视化 sRGB、P3、Rec2020 色域边界；建色阶前先看颜色是否超色域。MIT。
zh_how: 先看颜色是否超出 sRGB（或 P3）色域，再据此建色阶；复制 oklch() 值写进 token。

name: Radix Colors
best_for: Twelve-step scales where each step has a defined UI purpose, with matched dark and alpha scales
how_to_use: Read Understanding the scale for the step-to-role mapping (1-2 backgrounds, 3-5 component states, 6-8 borders, 9-10 solids, 11-12 text); agents can pull any scale as CSS variables from the npm package
zh: 十二级色阶，每级有明确 UI 用途，配暗色与透明阶；级别到角色的映射可迁移到任何配色；MIT。
zh_how: 先读 Understanding the scale：1–2 背景、3–5 组件状态、6–8 边框、9–10 实色、11–12 文字；智能体可直接从 npm 包取某个色阶的 CSS 变量。

name: Leonardo
best_for: Generates colour scales by target contrast ratios, with adaptive themes
how_to_use: Specify contrast targets, get colours; the inverse of picking then checking
zh: 按目标对比度反推色阶的工具，支持自适应主题；先定对比度再得颜色，与先选再验相反，Apache-2.0。
zh_how: 先定每级要达到的对比度（例如正文 4.5:1），让工具反推颜色；代码里用 npm 包 @adobe/leonardo-contrast-colors 生成主题。

name: Harmonizer
best_for: Generates consistent, accessible palettes with OKLCH and APCA contrast
how_to_use: Build scales with uniform perceived contrast across hues
zh: 基于 OKLCH 与 APCA 对比度的配色生成器，跨色相保持感知一致；搭整套色阶时用。
caveats: JS app: agents need a browser
Uses APCA, which is not a legal standard; confirm WCAG 2 ratios

name: Tailwind CSS colors
best_for: Widely used 11-step palette defined in OKLCH
how_to_use: Read the OKLCH lightness and chroma curve across 50-950 as a reference; agents can read every value from theme.css in the npm package
zh: 广泛使用的 11 级色阶，用 OKLCH 定义；参考其明度与彩度曲线，安全但因此常见；MIT。
zh_how: 参考 50–950 各级的 OKLCH 明度与彩度曲线；智能体可从 npm 包的 theme.css 读出全部数值。

name: Material Theme Builder
best_for: Generates Material colour roles from a seed using HCT tonal palettes
how_to_use: Export for Compose, Flutter, web
zh: 用 HCT 色调板从种子色生成一整套 Material 色彩角色，可导出 Compose、Flutter 与网页代码；Apache-2.0。

entry_points.label: M3 colour roles (what each generated role is for)

caveats: JS app: agents should use material-color-utilities (code domain) to generate the same schemes

name: tints.dev
best_for: Generates an 11-step Tailwind-style scale from one hex with tweakable curves
how_to_use: Generate an 11-step scale from one hex and tune the curves; agents call /api/<name>/<hex> for the scale as JSON (OKLCH values)
zh: 输入一个 hex 生成 Tailwind 式 11 级色阶，曲线可调；快速起品牌色阶，再用对比度校验。
zh_how: 输入一个 hex 生成 11 级色阶并调曲线；智能体调用 /api/<名称>/<hex> 取 JSON（OKLCH 值）。

name: UI Colors
best_for: Tailwind scale generator with UI previews and contrast grid
how_to_use: Enter a brand hex, add neutral and status scales (success, info, warning, error), preview them on real components and export the Tailwind config
zh: Tailwind 色阶生成器，边调色边在真实 UI 预览和对比度网格里检查；tints.dev 之外的替代。

name: Huetone
best_for: Build accessible palettes in LCH with WCAG and APCA read-outs per step
how_to_use: Tune a whole system while watching contrast
zh: 在 LCH 空间搭建色板，每级同步显示 WCAG 与 APCA 对比度数值；边调整套色彩系统边盯可读性，MIT。

name: Accessible Palette
best_for: Creates palettes with consistent lightness and contrast across hues
how_to_use: Ensures step 600 of every hue passes the same contrast
zh: 生成各色相亮度与对比度一致的色板，保证每个色相的同一阶（如 600）都过同样的对比度。

name: Atmos
best_for: LCH palette builder with shade curves and contrast checking
how_to_use: A more visual alternative for curve editing
zh: LCH 调色板构建器，带色阶曲线和对比度检查；想要更可视化的曲线编辑用它。

name: ColorBox
best_for: Lyft's scale generator: shape hue, saturation and brightness per step with easing curves, then export the scale
how_to_use: Use when a scale needs hand-tuned curves rather than a formula; check the result's contrast steps afterwards
zh: Lyft 出品的色阶生成器：用缓动曲线逐级调整色相、饱和度与明度，再导出；色阶需要手工调曲线而非套公式时用。

name: Reasonable Colors
best_for: Open palette of 6-shade scales where the shade-number gap guarantees contrast: a gap of 2 gives at least 3:1, a gap of 3 at least 4.5:1
how_to_use: Adopt its rule (shade gap = contrast level) when naming colour tokens, so pairings can be checked without a tool
zh: 开源调色板，每色 6 阶，色阶号差值即保证对比度：差 2 至少 3:1，差 3 至少 4.5:1；写颜色 token 时借用「级差即对比度」的规则。

name: Ant Design colour system
best_for: Ant Design's colour system in Chinese: 10-step base palettes generated from one primary by its published algorithm, a 13-step neutral ramp and a data-viz palette
how_to_use: Pick a primary in the page's generator to get color-1 to color-10; in code use @ant-design/colors; agents can read the Markdown twin
zh: Ant Design 色彩体系：由主色按公开算法生成 10 阶基础色板、13 阶中性色与数据可视化色板；国内中后台产品最常见的色阶来源。
zh_how: 在页面的色板生成工具里选主色得到 color-1 至 color-10；代码里用 @ant-design/colors；智能体读 .md 版。

name: InclusiveColors
best_for: Build a whole branded palette at once with hand-tuned hue, saturation and lightness curves while watching which pairs pass WCAG or APCA; export to Tailwind, CSS, Figma or Adobe
how_to_use: Plan which foreground steps must pass on which backgrounds (body text, headings, borders) while editing, then export tokens
zh: 一次搭好整套品牌色板，手调色相、饱和度、明度曲线，同时看哪些前景背景组合通过 WCAG 或 APCA；可导出 Tailwind、CSS、Figma、Adobe。
caveats: Labelled beta by its author

name: Arco Design Palette
best_for: ByteDance Arco Design's palette tool: generates a 10-step swatch from one colour for both light and dark modes, with 14 preset hues; the same algorithm ships as @arco-design/color
how_to_use: Generate the brand scale in the tool, or in code with generate('<hex>', { list: true, dark: true }) from @arco-design/color; check the contrast of each step before assigning roles
zh: 字节跳动 Arco Design 的色板工具：由一个颜色生成浅色与深色两套 10 阶色板，内置 14 组预设色；同一算法以 @arco-design/color 开源（MIT）。
zh_how: 在工具里生成品牌色阶，或在代码里用 @arco-design/color 的 generate('<hex>', { list: true, dark: true })；分配角色前先查各阶对比度。
caveats: The palette page is a JS app: agents should use the npm package
The package has not had a release since October 2021

name: WebAIM Contrast Checker
best_for: The standard quick WCAG contrast check, with an API
how_to_use: API: https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/?fcolor=<hex>&bcolor=<hex>&api
zh: WCAG 对比度速查的事实标准工具，带 API；定文字与背景色时随手核对。
zh_how: 接口：https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/?fcolor=<前景hex>&bcolor=<背景hex>&api，返回比值与 AA/AAA 结果；hex 不带 #。

name: Who Can Use
best_for: Shows how a colour pair performs across vision types
how_to_use: Use to make contrast findings concrete for stakeholders
zh: 展示一对颜色在不同视觉类型下的表现；向需求方解释对比度问题时，用它把后果摆出来。

name: APCA Contrast Calculator
best_for: Reference calculator for APCA lightness contrast with font-size lookup
how_to_use: Use for exploratory perceptual contrast with the font-size lookup; report WCAG 2 ratios as the requirement
zh: APCA 明度对比度的参考计算器，带字号查表；APCA 只是草案，交付时仍要并列 WCAG 2 比值。
caveats: APCA is an independent proposal, not part of the WCAG 3 drafts; WCAG 3's contrast method is undecided
WCAG 2 ratios remain the legal baseline

name: Contrast Grid
best_for: Tests every foreground against every background in a palette
how_to_use: Paste the palette (one colour per line, optionally with token names), screenshot the grid into the design-system docs as the pairing rule
zh: EightShapes 出品、现由 Directed Edges 维护的对比度矩阵：把色板里所有前景背景两两测对比度，截图贴进设计系统文档当搭配规则。
zh_how: 每行粘贴一个颜色（可带 token 名），把生成的对比度矩阵截图放进设计系统文档，作为搭配规则。

name: Color Oracle
best_for: Free colour-blindness simulator for Windows, Mac and Linux that filters the whole screen in real time, so any app or design file can be checked
how_to_use: Toggle it over the design tool or browser to check that states, charts and status colours survive deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia
zh: 免费的色盲模拟器（Windows、Mac、Linux），实时滤镜覆盖整个屏幕，任何软件与设计稿都能查；检查状态色、图表在各类色觉下是否仍可区分。

name: Chrome DevTools: emulate vision deficiencies
best_for: Built-in emulation of blurred vision, reduced contrast, protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia and achromatopsia on any live page
how_to_use: Rendering tab > Emulate vision deficiencies; agents get the same through CDP Emulation.setEmulatedVisionDeficiency and can screenshot each mode
zh: Chrome 自带的视觉缺陷模拟：模糊、低对比、红色盲、绿色盲、蓝色盲、全色盲，可在任何线上页面切换；智能体可经 CDP 切换并逐一截图。
zh_how: Rendering 面板 > Emulate vision deficiencies；自动化时调用 CDP 的 Emulation.setEmulatedVisionDeficiency，逐个模式截图对比。

name: OKLCH in CSS: why we moved from RGB and HSL
best_for: The case for OKLCH: predictable lightness, easy palette generation, wide gamut
how_to_use: Read before defining colour tokens
zh: 讲清为什么该从 RGB、HSL 迁到 OKLCH：明度可预测、色板好生成、色域广；定色彩 token 前读。

name: Designing accessible color systems
best_for: How Stripe built a palette with predictable contrast using a perceptual colour space
how_to_use: The reasoning behind step-number contrast guarantees
zh: Stripe 讲如何用感知色彩空间做出对比度可预测的色板；理解色阶编号保证对比度的原理。

name: Color & Contrast
best_for: Interactive guide to colour science for UI designers
how_to_use: Look up simultaneous contrast and colour-appearance effects
zh: 面向 UI 设计师的交互式色彩科学指南；遇到同时对比等色彩外观效应时来查。

name: Why Color Theory Sucks (and what framework to use instead)
best_for: Practical method for deriving UI colour variations
how_to_use: Useful mental model for darker and lighter variants
zh: 讲界面配色变体推导的实操文章，基于 HSB 给出深浅变化的心智模型；调状态色时参考。

name: Building your color palette
best_for: Why a UI needs greys, a primary and accents in eight to ten shades each
how_to_use: The baseline for a product palette
zh: Refactoring UI 的配色方法论：为什么 UI 需要灰、主色与强调色各八到十阶；产品色板的基线。

name: Material 2: Dark theme
best_for: The clearest reasoning on dark surfaces, elevation overlays and desaturated accents
how_to_use: Read before deriving a dark mode
zh: 对暗色表面、海拔叠层、低饱和强调色讲得最清楚的指南；推导深色模式前先读。
caveats: Material 2 guidance (archived): Material 3 replaces the elevation overlays with surface-container colour roles

name: High definition CSS color guide
best_for: The practical guide to CSS Color 4 and 5: new colour spaces (oklch, oklab, display-p3), gamut, interpolation in gradients and color-mix()
how_to_use: Read before writing colour tokens in oklch or adding P3 colours; use its gamut and fallback advice for older displays
zh: Chrome 团队的 CSS Color 4/5 实用指南：oklch、oklab、display-p3 等新色彩空间、色域、渐变插值与 color-mix()；用 oklch 写颜色 token 前读。

name: Apple HIG: Color
best_for: Apple's colour guidance: system colours with light, dark and increased-contrast values, Liquid Glass colour (updated December 2025), colour management and per-platform rules
how_to_use: Take system colour values from the Specifications tables instead of eyeballing them; for dark mode read the Dark Mode page (contrast at least 4.5:1, aim for 7:1 with custom colours); agents fetch the JSON
zh: 苹果的色彩规范：系统色在浅色、深色、增强对比下的取值，Liquid Glass 色彩（2025 年 12 月更新）、色彩管理与各平台差异；有官方中文版。
zh_how: 系统色数值直接抄 Specifications 表，不要目测；深色模式看 Dark Mode 页（对比度至少 4.5:1，自定义颜色争取 7:1）；智能体取 color.json。
caveats: Perishable: re-read after each OS release
JS-rendered page: agents should fetch the JSON version

name: shadcn/ui
best_for: Copy-in React components on accessible primitives; the code lives in your repo
how_to_use: Retheme through CSS variables before shipping (radius, colour, type, density); new projects default to Base UI since July 2026, Radix is still supported; agents read /llms.txt
zh: 复制进仓库的 React 组件库，底层是可访问性原语；别直接用默认主题上线，用 CSS 变量换肤，MIT。
zh_how: 上线前必须通过 CSS 变量改主题（圆角、颜色、字体、密度）；2026 年 7 月起新项目默认用 Base UI，Radix 仍受支持；智能体读 /llms.txt。

entry_points.label: July 2026: Base UI as the default

caveats: The default theme is the signature look of AI-generated apps; change it

name: Base UI
best_for: Unstyled, accessible React components from the Radix, Floating UI and Material UI authors; shadcn/ui's default primitives since July 2026
how_to_use: Default headless layer for new React design systems; agents read base-ui.com/llms.txt for the component index
zh: Radix、Floating UI 与 Material UI 作者们做的无样式无障碍 React 组件；2026 年 7 月起是 shadcn/ui 的默认底层，新建 React 设计系统的首选行为层，MIT。

name: Ant Design (React)
best_for: The enterprise React library behind most Chinese admin systems; themable through design tokens
how_to_use: Theme with ConfigProvider tokens and algorithms (dark, compact), never CSS overrides; agents fetch any component doc as Markdown by appending .md
zh: 国内后台系统事实标准的 React 组件库；换主题走 ConfigProvider 的 token 与算法，别写 CSS 覆盖。MIT。
zh_how: 用 ConfigProvider 的 token 与算法（暗色、紧凑）换主题，不写 CSS 覆盖；智能体在组件文档地址后加 .md 即可取 Markdown（如 /components/button.md）。

name: Radix Primitives
best_for: Unstyled accessible primitives for React
how_to_use: Keep as the behaviour layer in existing Radix codebases; for new headless work prefer Base UI, which shadcn/ui made its default in July 2026
zh: React 无样式无障碍组件原语，只管行为不管外观；做自定义设计时垫在下面的行为层，MIT。
caveats: shadcn/ui switched new projects to Base UI in July 2026; Radix remains maintained and supported

name: React Aria
best_for: Adobe's headless components with the deepest accessibility and internationalisation work
how_to_use: Choose when a11y and i18n requirements are strict
zh: Adobe 的 headless React 组件库，无障碍与国际化做得最深；这两项是硬要求时选它；Apache-2.0。

name: Ark UI
best_for: Headless components for several frameworks built on state machines
how_to_use: One behaviour layer across React, Vue and Solid
zh: 基于状态机的无样式组件库，一套行为层覆盖 React、Vue、Solid 等多框架；换框架不换交互。MIT。

name: Reka UI
best_for: Unstyled, accessible primitives for Vue (formerly Radix Vue); the base under shadcn-vue
how_to_use: Headless base for custom Vue design systems
zh: 相当于 Vue 版的 Radix：headless 无样式组件库，正适合给自己的 Vue 设计系统打地基；MIT。

name: shadcn-vue
best_for: Community Vue port of shadcn/ui on Reka UI: copy-in components for Vue and Nuxt
how_to_use: Default copy-in kit for Vue and Nuxt; retheme through CSS variables exactly as with shadcn/ui
zh: shadcn/ui 的 Vue 移植版，同样把组件代码复制进项目由自己持有；技术栈是 Vue 或 Nuxt 时的选择，MIT 协议。

name: Nuxt UI
best_for: Full component library for Vue and Nuxt with a token-based theme
how_to_use: Use for Vue or Nuxt apps that want a complete kit (125+ components) themed through app config and CSS variables; agents read ui.nuxt.com/llms.txt
zh: 为 Vue 与 Nuxt 准备的全套组件库，主题用 token 体系定制；做 Nuxt 项目快速起步的选择，MIT。

name: Mantine
best_for: Large, well-documented React component and hooks library
how_to_use: Pragmatic choice for internal tools and dashboards (100+ components and hooks); agents read mantine.dev/llms.txt
zh: 大而全、文档写得好的 React 组件与 hooks 库；给团队做内部工具时的务实选择；MIT。

name: HeroUI
best_for: HeroUI v3 (formerly NextUI): polished React and React Native components on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria
how_to_use: Attractive defaults; customise the theme so the product does not look like the demo
zh: HeroUI v3（原 NextUI）：基于 Tailwind CSS v4 与 React Aria 的 React 及 React Native 组件库，默认就好看；务必改主题，别和官方演示撞脸，Apache-2.0。
caveats: Its default look is instantly recognisable

name: Ant Design Vue
best_for: Vue 3 implementation of Ant Design's components and token theming, maintained by the vueComponent team
how_to_use: For Vue admin systems; theme through ConfigProvider tokens as in the React version
zh: Ant Design 的 Vue 实现，企业级组件一应俱全；搭 Vue 后台管理系统时的常用底座；MIT。

name: Element Plus
best_for: The most common Vue 3 admin component library in China
how_to_use: Theme through CSS variables and SCSS variables
zh: 国内最常见的 Vue 3 中后台组件库，做管理系统时的默认选项；通过 CSS 变量与 SCSS 变量定制主题，MIT。

name: Naive UI
best_for: Vue 3 library with a strong TypeScript theme-override system
how_to_use: Theme in TypeScript through n-config-provider theme overrides; the default look is cleaner than most admin kits
zh: Vue 3 组件库，TypeScript 写就，主题覆盖系统做得好；默认观感比多数后台模板干净，MIT。

name: Vant
best_for: Lightweight mobile Vue components with a WeChat mini-program edition
how_to_use: Default for mobile H5 in the Chinese ecosystem
zh: 轻量移动端 Vue 组件库，有微信小程序版；中文生态做移动 H5 的默认选择；MIT。

name: Forui
best_for: Minimalist, platform-agnostic Flutter widget library
how_to_use: A way out of stock Material look in Flutter
zh: 极简、平台无关的 Flutter 组件库，样式克制；想让 Flutter 应用摆脱默认 Material 长相时的出路。

name: shadcn_flutter
best_for: shadcn-style component set for Flutter
how_to_use: Use when a Flutter app should look like a shadcn web app rather than stock Material
zh: shadcn 风格的 Flutter 组件集，不是 Material 那副默认面孔；想给自己的 Flutter 应用换种气质时用；BSD-3-Clause。

name: React Native Reusables
best_for: shadcn/ui approach for React Native
how_to_use: Use when a React Native app must share the shadcn look and tokens with its web app (styled with NativeWind)
zh: 把 shadcn/ui 的复制进仓库做法搬到 React Native 的组件集；想让 Web 端与原生应用保持同一风格时用，MIT 协议。

name: Tailwind Plus
best_for: The Tailwind team's paid library (formerly Tailwind UI) of UI blocks, site templates and the Catalyst application kit
how_to_use: Reference for well-proportioned default layouts and spacing; restyle before shipping, and do not redistribute the code as a kit
zh: Tailwind 官方付费库（原 Tailwind UI）：UI 区块、站点模板与 Catalyst 应用套件，一次买断终身使用；比例与间距得当的默认布局参考，禁止把代码当套件再分发。
license: Commercial; one-time purchase; no redistribution as a kit
caveats: The pages redirect to a login, so agents cannot browse it

name: coss ui
best_for: Large copy-paste React component library on Base UI and Tailwind from the Cal.com team (successor of Origin UI), with 500+ example 'particles'
how_to_use: Mine the particles for Base UI patterns when moving a shadcn project to Base UI; agents read coss.com/ui/llms.txt (Markdown docs)
zh: Cal.com 团队基于 Base UI 与 Tailwind 的大型复制粘贴 React 组件库（Origin UI 的后继），附 500 多个示例；shadcn 项目迁到 Base UI 时拿来参考。
license: Unclear: repository and the @coss/ui package declare AGPL-3.0-or-later; the docs app declares MIT
caveats: Confirm the licence before copying components into closed-source code: the repo root and @coss/ui are AGPL-3.0-or-later

name: Untitled UI React
best_for: Open-source React components on React Aria and Tailwind CSS v4 that match the Untitled UI Figma kit; PRO adds thousands of sections
how_to_use: Good default when design and code must share one kit; the open-source set is MIT, PRO is a paid licence
zh: 与 Untitled UI Figma 套件一一对应的开源 React 组件（React Aria + Tailwind CSS v4），PRO 版另有大量区块；设计稿与代码想共用一套时的好默认，开源部分 MIT。

name: MUI (Material UI and MUI X)
best_for: The most-used React component suite: Material UI plus MUI X data grid, date pickers and charts; the team also maintains Base UI
how_to_use: Choose for data-heavy React apps that need a mature grid and date pickers; theme it away from stock Material; agents read the Material UI llms.txt
zh: 使用最广的 React 组件套件：Material UI 加 MUI X 数据表格、日期选择与图表，团队也维护 Base UI；需要成熟表格与日期控件的数据型应用选它，记得去掉 Material 原味。
license: MIT (Material UI, MUI X community); MUI X Pro and Premium are commercial
caveats: Stock Material styling makes a product look like a Google template

name: shadcn-svelte
best_for: Community Svelte port of shadcn/ui built on Bits UI
how_to_use: Default copy-in kit for Svelte and SvelteKit; retheme through CSS variables as with shadcn/ui
zh: 社区维护的 shadcn/ui Svelte 移植版（基于 Bits UI）；Svelte 与 SvelteKit 项目的默认复制粘贴组件库，同样用 CSS 变量换肤，MIT。

name: NutUI
best_for: JD's lightweight mobile component library in Vue and React editions, both supporting multi-host mini-programs through Taro
how_to_use: Pick for e-commerce style mobile H5 pages or Taro mini-programs; retheme away from the JD red
zh: 京东风格的轻量移动端组件库，有 Vue 与 React 两个版本，均可通过 Taro 支持多端小程序；做电商类移动 H5 或 Taro 小程序时选，记得换掉京东红。

name: WeUI
best_for: WeChat's official base style library that matches native WeChat visuals
how_to_use: Use for H5 pages opened inside WeChat so they feel native; read it with the WeChat mini-program design guidelines
zh: 微信官方基础样式库，视觉与微信原生一致；在微信里打开的 H5 页面用它显得原生，配合微信小程序设计指南阅读，MIT。

name: Ant Design Mobile
best_for: Ant Group's React component library for mobile web, the mobile sibling of Ant Design
how_to_use: Pick for React H5 apps in the Alipay or Ant ecosystem; theme through its CSS variables
zh: 蚂蚁集团的移动端 React 组件库，Ant Design 的移动版；支付宝或蚂蚁生态的 React H5 应用首选，用 CSS 变量换主题，MIT。

name: Wot UI
best_for: Popular uni-app component library (80+ components, dark mode, i18n, custom themes) for multi-host mini-programs
how_to_use: Pick when the stack is uni-app; test host-specific behaviour on each mini-program platform
zh: 流行的 uni-app 组件库（80+ 组件，暗色模式、国际化、自定义主题）；技术栈是 uni-app 时选，注意在各小程序宿主上分别验证。

name: Floating UI
best_for: The positioning engine for tooltips, popovers, menus and selects: collision-aware placement plus interaction hooks
how_to_use: Use directly when building a custom floating element; most headless libraries already embed it
zh: 提示框、弹出层、菜单、下拉的定位引擎：避让碰撞的定位加交互 hooks；自己造浮层组件时直接用，多数无头组件库已内置它，MIT。
caveats: CSS anchor positioning is not yet Baseline (webstatus.dev: limited, 2026-09); keep a JS positioner until it is

name: TanStack Table
best_for: Headless table and data-grid logic (sorting, filtering, grouping, pagination, virtualisation hooks) for React, Vue, Solid and Svelte
how_to_use: Use when a dense table must match your own design system; you own all markup and styling
zh: 无头表格与数据网格逻辑库：排序、筛选、分组、分页，可配虚拟滚动，支持 React、Vue、Solid、Svelte；密集表格要贴合自家设计系统时用，标记与样式全由你定，MIT。

name: dnd kit
best_for: Toolkit for accessible drag-and-drop and sortable lists with keyboard and pointer sensors, for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and plain TypeScript
how_to_use: Use for kanban boards, reorderable lists and builders; design the drag preview, drop indicator and keyboard instructions explicitly
zh: 可访问的拖拽与排序工具包，支持键盘与指针传感器，覆盖 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 与原生 TypeScript；做看板、可排序列表、搭建器时用，拖拽预览、落点提示与键盘说明都要专门设计，MIT。

name: Sonner
best_for: Emil Kowalski's opinionated toast component for React: stacking, swipe to dismiss and promise states, the toast most shadcn apps ship
how_to_use: Use as is in React, or study its stacking and timing when designing notifications in another stack
zh: Emil Kowalski 的 React 通知（toast）组件，堆叠、滑动关闭与 promise 状态都很讲究，多数 shadcn 应用用的就是它；其他技术栈设计通知时也值得研究它的堆叠与节奏，MIT。

name: Web Awesome (formerly Shoelace)
best_for: Framework-agnostic web components from the Font Awesome team, successor to Shoelace, with themes, design tokens and SSR
how_to_use: Use when a design must work across frameworks or in plain HTML; theme through its CSS custom properties; agents read webawesome.com/llms.txt
zh: Font Awesome 团队的框架无关 Web Components 组件库（Shoelace 的后继），带主题、设计 token 与 SSR；设计要跨框架或用在纯 HTML 里时选它，免费部分 MIT，Pro 付费。
license: MIT (free components); Web Awesome Pro is commercial

name: Magic UI
best_for: Animated marketing components (marquees, beams, bento, text effects) for shadcn projects
how_to_use: Use one or two components with intent (a marquee of logos, one text effect) and restyle them
zh: 面向 shadcn 项目的营销动效组件：跑马灯、光束、bento、文字特效；挑一两个点睛，整页都用就撞脸。MIT。
caveats: A page assembled from these looks like every other AI-built landing page

name: React Bits
best_for: Large set of animated text, backgrounds and interactive components
how_to_use: Take one animated text or background for a single signature moment, then retime it to your motion tokens
zh: 大量动效文字、背景与交互组件的集合；适合取一件做页面的点睛时刻；授权见仓库。
license: MIT + Commons Clause (use freely; do not resell the components)

name: Motion Primitives
best_for: Tasteful, restrained animated primitives built on Motion
how_to_use: Closer to product UI needs than the flashier kits
zh: 基于 Motion 的克制风动效组件集，比炫技类库更贴近产品界面的实际需要，MIT。

name: Aceternity UI
best_for: Eye-catching effect components (spotlights, beams, 3D cards) for React and Tailwind
how_to_use: Use as a technique reference, restyle heavily
zh: 效果炫目的 React 组件库，一眼能看出是模板；当技法参考用，务必大幅改样式。
caveats: Instantly recognisable as a template; restyle heavily or use only as a technique reference

name: Animate UI
best_for: Animated versions of common components
how_to_use: Reference for state-transition polish (tabs, accordions, toggles) before animating your own components
zh: 常见组件的动画版本合集；做状态过渡打磨时的参考；许可见仓库。

name: Inspira UI
best_for: Animated components for Vue and Nuxt, inspired by the React kits
how_to_use: The Vue and Nuxt route to the React-kit effects; take one component for a signature moment and restyle it
zh: Vue 与 Nuxt 的动画组件库，灵感来自 React 系套件；Vue 技术栈要那些效果时用它；MIT。

name: Fancy Components
best_for: Open-source React components and microinteractions with an experimental bent: kinetic typography, physics and cursor effects
how_to_use: Use one effect as a signature moment on an otherwise quiet page; check the performance cost on mobile
zh: 开源的 React 组件与微交互库，偏实验性：动态文字、物理效果、光标效果；在整体克制的页面上只取一个效果做点睛，并检查移动端性能，MIT。

name: Motion
best_for: The standard animation library for the web (formerly Framer Motion): springs, gestures, layout and scroll animation
how_to_use: Import from motion/react in React (motion for vanilla JS, motion-v for Vue); check the installed major version; agents read motion.dev/llms.txt
zh: Web 动画事实标准库（原 Framer Motion）：弹簧、手势、布局与滚动动画；React 从 motion/react 引入，留意大版本。MIT。

entry_points.label: Examples (filter JS, React, Vue; some need Motion+)

caveats: Some examples and premium components require a paid Motion+ membership

name: three.js
best_for: The standard WebGL and WebGPU 3D library for the web: scenes, materials, glTF loading and post-processing
how_to_use: Read the manual before the API docs; in React use react-three-fiber with drei
zh: Web 端 3D 图形的事实标准库，封装了 WebGL 的复杂度；做 3D 场景、产品可视化或创意网页时用，React 项目配 react-three-fiber，MIT 协议。

name: GSAP
best_for: Timeline-based animation platform with ScrollTrigger, SplitText, MorphSVG
how_to_use: Best for sequenced timelines and scroll-driven storytelling (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, MorphSVG); honour prefers-reduced-motion
zh: 时间轴动画平台，带 ScrollTrigger、SplitText、MorphSVG；做编排式滚动叙事的首选；免费但非 OSI 开源。
license: GSAP Standard 'no charge' licence: free for commercial use, including every plugin since April 2025; not allowed inside visual no-code animation builders that compete with Webflow; not OSI open source
caveats: gsap.com sits behind a bot wall for scripted fetches; agents should read the source and README on GitHub (greensock/GSAP)

name: Anime.js
best_for: Lightweight animation engine with timelines, staggering and SVG support (v4 rewrite)
how_to_use: Dependency-light alternative to GSAP for timelines, staggers and SVG line drawing; v4 uses module imports, so import only what you use
zh: 轻量 JS 动画引擎，支持时间线、交错动画与 SVG，v4 已重写；想要少依赖的 GSAP 替代时用，MIT。

name: dotLottie web player (and lottie-web)
best_for: Players for Lottie animations on the web: the dotLottie player for .lottie and JSON files (smaller files, theming, state machines) and the original lottie-web
how_to_use: Prefer .lottie files and the dotLottie player; lottie-web still works but changes rarely
zh: 网页端 Lottie 动画播放器：dotLottie 播放器（支持 .lottie 与 JSON，文件更小、可换主题、有状态机）和老牌 lottie-web；优先用 .lottie 与 dotLottie，MIT。
caveats: lottiefiles.com is behind a Cloudflare wall for scripted fetches

name: Rive runtimes
best_for: Runtimes to play interactive Rive files on every platform
how_to_use: One animation asset across web, Flutter and native
zh: 让交互式 Rive 动画跑在各平台的运行时；一份动画资产跨 Web、Flutter 和原生；MIT。

name: AutoAnimate
best_for: One-line automatic transitions for list and layout changes
how_to_use: Add the one-line hook to lists and layout containers for enter, leave and reorder transitions; cheap polish for admin UIs
zh: 一行接入的列表与布局自动过渡库；给后台界面低成本加精致感；MIT。

name: Lenis
best_for: Smooth-scroll library used on many award sites
how_to_use: Use only when smooth scroll is part of the concept; keep native scroll for product UI
zh: 许多获奖站用的平滑滚动库；劫持滚动有无障碍代价，非必要不上。MIT。
caveats: Scroll hijacking has accessibility and performance costs; respect prefers-reduced-motion

name: Theatre.js
best_for: Visual sequencer for choreographing code-driven animation
how_to_use: Keyframe cinematic hero sequences in its studio UI and play them from code; development has been quiet since 2024
zh: 可视化动画编排序器，用来编排代码驱动的动效；做电影感首屏序列；Apache-2.0。

name: react-three-fiber
best_for: React renderer for three.js with the drei helper library
how_to_use: Declarative 3D scenes and digital-twin views
zh: three.js 的 React 渲染器，配 drei 助手库；要用声明式写法搭 3D 场景、做数字孪生可视化时选它，MIT。

name: Remotion
best_for: Programmatic video in React: motion graphics and product videos from code
how_to_use: Check the company licence threshold before commercial use
zh: 用 React 以代码生成视频，动态图形和产品视频都能写；个人小团队免费，公司超阈值需付费授权。
license: Remotion licence: free for individuals and small teams, paid company licence above a threshold

name: Motion Canvas
best_for: Code-driven animation for explainer videos
how_to_use: Write explainer and diagram animations in TypeScript with the live editor, then render the video
zh: 用 TypeScript 代码驱动的讲解视频动画库；做图表式演示动画的开源选择；MIT。

name: p5.js
best_for: Creative-coding library for generative visuals
how_to_use: Sketch generative posters, patterns and backgrounds in the web editor, then export frames as PNG
zh: 创意编程库，做生成式视觉的入门标配；生成艺术海报与动态背景时上手最快，LGPL-2.1。

name: PixiJS
best_for: Fast 2D rendering engine (WebGL and WebGPU) for games, interactive stories and rich animated interfaces
how_to_use: Use when DOM and SVG animation hit performance limits (thousands of sprites, particles, filters)
zh: 高速 2D 渲染引擎（WebGL 与 WebGPU），用于游戏、互动叙事和复杂动画界面；DOM 与 SVG 动画撞到性能上限（大量精灵、粒子、滤镜）时换用，MIT。

name: Design Tokens Format Module (DTCG 2025.10)
best_for: The W3C Community Group's stable token file format (2025.10, final report of 28 October 2025) with Color and Resolver modules for themes and modes
how_to_use: Write tokens.json to the Format module; use the Resolver module for light, dark and brand sets instead of duplicating files
zh: W3C 社区组的 design token 文件格式，2025.10 为稳定版（2025 年 10 月 28 日终版报告），另有 Color 模块与处理主题和模式的 Resolver 模块；写 tokens.json 按它来。
zh_how: tokens.json 按 Format 模块写；明暗与多品牌用 Resolver 模块组合，不要复制多份文件。

name: Style Dictionary
best_for: Transforms token files into CSS, iOS, Android, Flutter and more
how_to_use: The default token build tool; supports DTCG syntax
zh: 把 design token 源文件编译成 CSS、iOS、Android、Flutter 等各平台代码的标配构建工具，做跨端主题时默认选它，支持 W3C DTCG 格式；Apache-2.0。

name: Tailwind CSS
best_for: Utility-first CSS framework whose v4 @theme variables are the token layer of most AI-generated and shadcn-based UIs
how_to_use: Map the design system's tokens to @theme namespaces (--color-*, --font-*, --spacing, --radius-*) instead of hard-coding values in class names
zh: 原子化 CSS 框架，v4 的 @theme 变量就是大多数 AI 生成界面与 shadcn 项目的 token 层；把设计系统的 token 映射到 @theme 命名空间（--color-*、--font-*、--spacing、--radius-*），别在类名里写死数值，MIT。
zh_how: 先读 Theme variables 文档，把 DESIGN.md 里的颜色、字体、间距、圆角写进 @theme，再用生成的工具类。
caveats: Stock Tailwind defaults (palette, radius, shadows) are the generic AI look; define your own theme

name: tweakcn
best_for: Visual theme editor for shadcn/ui with exportable CSS variables
how_to_use: The quickest way to move a shadcn project off its default look
zh: shadcn/ui 的可视化主题编辑器，导出 CSS 变量；让项目摆脱默认脸的最快路径；Apache-2.0。

name: Terrazzo
best_for: DTCG-native token toolchain with linting and plugins
how_to_use: Lighter DTCG-native alternative to Style Dictionary; its lint rules include a11y/min-contrast for token pairs
zh: 原生支持 DTCG 的 token 构建工具链，带 lint 与插件机制；想要比 Style Dictionary 更轻的选择时用它；MIT。

name: Tokens Studio
best_for: Figma plugin to author tokens and sync them to Git
how_to_use: Author tokens and themes in the Figma plugin, sync the JSON to Git, then build it with Style Dictionary
zh: 在 Figma 里编写 design token 并同步到 Git 的插件；设计师留在 Figma、代码库要单一来源时用它衔接。MIT。

name: Open Props
best_for: Expertly tuned CSS custom properties: sizes, easings, shadows, gradients, colours
how_to_use: Borrow its easing, shadow and size scales as a starting point; import only the props you use
zh: 调好的 CSS 自定义属性集：尺寸、缓动、阴影、渐变、颜色；缓动与阴影阶可直接借走；MIT。

name: Material Color Utilities
best_for: HCT colour space, tonal palettes and dynamic schemes in TS, Dart, Java, Swift
how_to_use: Generate Material schemes in build scripts
zh: Google 的取色算法库：HCT 色彩空间、色调色板与动态配色，多语言实现；构建脚本里生成主题，Apache-2.0。

name: Culori
best_for: Comprehensive colour library with OKLCH, interpolation and gamut mapping
how_to_use: Use in token build scripts to convert to OKLCH, interpolate scales and clamp to the sRGB or P3 gamut
zh: 功能齐全的颜色处理库，支持 OKLCH、插值与色域映射；写 design token 构建脚本时的好帮手，MIT。

name: Color.js
best_for: Colour science library by CSS Color spec editors
how_to_use: Reference implementation behaviour for CSS colour spaces
zh: CSS Color 规范作者写的色彩科学库；要参考 CSS 色彩空间的实现行为时用它；MIT。

name: Panda CSS
best_for: Type-safe, build-time CSS-in-JS for design systems with first-class tokens, semantic tokens, text styles and component recipes
how_to_use: Use when a design system wants tokens and variants defined in TypeScript and compiled to static CSS; agents read panda-css.com/llms.txt
zh: 类型安全、构建时生成的 CSS-in-JS 框架，原生支持 token、语义 token、文字样式与组件 recipe；设计系统想用 TypeScript 定义 token 与变体并编译成静态 CSS 时用，MIT。

name: Satori
best_for: Converts HTML and CSS (a flexbox subset) to SVG; the engine behind generated OG images
how_to_use: Pair with resvg to rasterise; fonts must be supplied as files
zh: 把 HTML 与 CSS 的 flexbox 子集渲染成 SVG，是生成 OG 图的核心引擎；配 resvg 出位图，字体需自备；MPL-2.0。

name: Playwright
best_for: Browser automation with full-page screenshots, PDF output and screenshot assertions
how_to_use: toHaveScreenshot() is the mechanical gate for visual regressions
zh: 浏览器自动化库，整页截图、导出 PDF、截图断言俱全；用 toHaveScreenshot() 做视觉回归的机械关卡，Apache-2.0。

name: Takumi
best_for: Rust image-rendering engine for JSX layouts, a faster Satori alternative
how_to_use: For high-volume OG and social images (and PDFs) from JSX when Satori plus resvg is too slow
zh: Rust 写的 JSX 布局图片渲染引擎，定位是更快的 Satori 替代；大批量生成 OG 图时选它。MIT/Apache-2.0。

name: resvg
best_for: Accurate SVG rasteriser with JS bindings (resvg-js)
how_to_use: Deterministic SVG to PNG in scripts (resvg-js in Node); supply the fonts explicitly
zh: 精度可靠的 SVG 光栅化器，有 JS 绑定（resvg-js）；在构建脚本里确定性地把 SVG 转成 PNG；Apache-2.0 或 MIT。

name: snapDOM
best_for: Fast in-browser DOM-to-image capture
how_to_use: For client-side 'export as image' features; test web fonts and cross-origin images
zh: 浏览器内高速把 DOM 节点截成图片的库，给产品做客户端导出图片功能时用，MIT。

name: sharp
best_for: High-performance image resizing, format conversion and compositing in Node
how_to_use: Produce responsive image sets and AVIF or WebP
zh: Node 里高性能的图像缩放、格式转换与合成库；生成响应式图片集和 AVIF/WebP 用它；Apache-2.0。

name: Typst
best_for: Modern markup-based typesetting system that compiles to PDF quickly
how_to_use: Strong choice for reports, one-pagers and print pieces made from code
zh: 现代标记式排版系统，编译 PDF 很快；用代码做报告、单页与印刷品的好选择；Apache-2.0。

name: Paged.js
best_for: Polyfill for CSS Paged Media: page size, margins, running headers, bleed and crop marks in the browser
how_to_use: HTML to print-ready PDF through a browser
zh: CSS Paged Media 的浏览器 polyfill：页面尺寸、页边距、页眉、出血和裁切标记；HTML 直接出印刷级 PDF。MIT。

name: Vivliostyle
best_for: CSS typesetting engine with strong CJK and vertical-text support
how_to_use: For Chinese and Japanese books and documents from HTML
zh: CSS 排版引擎，中日文与竖排支持扎实；适合用 HTML 排中文、日文的书籍与文档；AGPL-3.0。

name: WeasyPrint
best_for: HTML and CSS to PDF in Python with paged-media support
how_to_use: Server-side HTML to PDF for reports and invoices using @page rules for size, margins and running headers
zh: Python 写的渲染库，把 HTML 与 CSS 直接排成分页 PDF；适合在服务端批量生成报告类文档，BSD-3-Clause 协议。

name: Slidev
best_for: Markdown and Vue slides for developers with themes and PDF export
how_to_use: Decks from Markdown with live Vue components and code highlighting; export PDF or PNG with the CLI
zh: 用 Markdown 和 Vue 写幻灯片，支持主题、实时组件与 PDF 导出；开发者的演示文稿工具，MIT。

name: reveal.js
best_for: Mature HTML presentation framework: nested slides, speaker notes, PDF export and full CSS control
how_to_use: Use when a deck is designed in HTML and CSS; export PDF by printing the ?print-pdf view
zh: HTML 演示文稿框架的标杆；要做完全掌控版式的设计感幻灯片用它；MIT。

name: Marp
best_for: Markdown to slides with PDF and PPTX export
how_to_use: Fast, plain decks from Markdown themed with CSS; the CLI exports PDF, PPTX and images
zh: 把 Markdown 文稿直接转成幻灯片，可导出 PDF 与 PPTX；需要快速出朴素演示稿时用；MIT。
caveats: PPTX export is pre-rendered images by default; --pptx-editable is experimental, so use PptxGenJS when recipients must edit

name: PptxGenJS
best_for: Generates editable PowerPoint files from JavaScript
how_to_use: When the recipient must edit in PowerPoint or Keynote
zh: 从 JavaScript 生成真正可编辑的 PowerPoint 文件的库；交付物必须让对方在 PowerPoint 或 Keynote 里继续改时用它。MIT。

name: fontTools
best_for: Python library and pyftsubset for inspecting and subsetting fonts
how_to_use: Subset to the characters actually used with pyftsubset (--flavor=woff2) and inspect font tables with ttx
zh: 字体处理的 Python 库，pyftsubset 可按实际用到的字符裁剪字体；上线前做子集化减体积，MIT。

name: opentype.js
best_for: Parse fonts and convert text to SVG paths in JavaScript
how_to_use: Outline a wordmark or headline to SVG paths in code (getPath().toSVG) so it renders without the font file
zh: 在 JavaScript 里解析字体文件、把文字转成 SVG 路径的库；要用代码给字标转曲描边时用，MIT。

name: Penpot
best_for: Open-source design tool built on SVG and CSS concepts, with tokens and an MCP server
how_to_use: Self-hostable design source of truth; agents connect through its official MCP server
zh: 开源设计工具，建立在 SVG 和 CSS 概念之上，自带 token 与 MCP server；可自托管的设计源头文件；MPL-2.0。

name: Excalidraw
best_for: Hand-drawn style whiteboard for flows and wireframes
how_to_use: Low-fidelity flows and wireframes before pixels; its .excalidraw JSON can be generated by an agent and reopened for editing
zh: 手绘风格白板，画流程与线框；上像素之前的低保真思考工具；MIT。

name: tldraw
