best_for: Infinite-canvas whiteboard plus a React SDK for building your own canvas tools
how_to_use: Sketch flows on tldraw.com; build on the SDK only after checking its licence
zh: 无限画布与配套 SDK；自己造画布类工具时基于它搭，SDK 商用需购买授权。
license: tldraw licence (SDK requires a licence for commercial use)
caveats: The SDK needs a commercial licence for production use

name: Graphite
best_for: Open-source procedural vector and raster editor in the browser
how_to_use: Watch as an emerging open alternative for node-based procedural vector work
zh: 浏览器里的开源程序化矢量与位图编辑器；矢量工具的新候选；Apache-2.0。

name: Inkscape
best_for: Mature open-source SVG editor with a command line for batch export
how_to_use: Batch-export SVG to PNG or PDF from the command line (inkscape --export-type=png file.svg)
zh: 成熟的开源矢量编辑器，带命令行接口，可批量把 SVG 导出成 PNG 或 PDF；GPL 协议。
caveats: inkscape.org answers scripted fetches with 403

name: Blender
best_for: Open-source 3D suite, scriptable in Python
how_to_use: Scripted renders of product or icon scenes
zh: 开源 3D 创作套件，建模、渲染、动画齐备且可用 Python 脚本化；批量渲染产品或图标场景用，GPL。

name: Figma
best_for: The design tool of record for most product teams: components, variables (tokens and modes), Dev Mode and a REST API
how_to_use: Read the team's variables and components before designing; agents pull file data through the REST API or the Figma MCP server
zh: 多数产品团队的主力设计工具：组件、变量（token 与模式）、Dev Mode 和 REST API；动手前先读团队已有的变量与组件，智能体通过 REST API 或 Figma MCP 取文件数据。

name: pen.dev (formerly Pencil)
best_for: Agent-native design canvas (desktop and IDE) whose .pen files are an open format kept in the repo, with MCP, WebMCP and CLI access
how_to_use: Keep .pen files next to the code so agents and people edit the same design; review agent edits like code
zh: 原 Pencil，面向智能体的设计画布（桌面与 IDE），.pen 为开放格式、放在代码仓库里，可通过 MCP、WebMCP 与 CLI 接入；.pen 与代码放一起，像评审代码一样评审智能体的改动。

entry_points.label: Docs (.pen format, CLI, design and code)

caveats: Free today; the pricing page says paid plans may come later

name: Paper
best_for: Design tool whose canvas is built on HTML and CSS, with an MCP server through which agents read and write frames
how_to_use: Use when designs should hand off as CSS; connect the MCP server so an agent can lay out frames or turn a selected frame into code
zh: 画布基于 HTML 与 CSS 的设计工具，智能体可通过 MCP 读写画板；希望交付物直接是 CSS 时用，接上 MCP 让智能体排版或把选中画板转成代码。
caveats: The free plan caps MCP tool calls (100 per week); Pro is paid per editor

name: MasterGo (莫高设计)
best_for: Leading domestic Figma-class design tool (from the Lanhu team) with prototyping, a developer mode, AI features and an official MCP server
how_to_use: Expect Chinese product teams to deliver files here; read components and styles in developer mode, and connect MasterGo Magic MCP for agents
zh: 国内领先的 Figma 级设计工具（蓝湖团队出品），含原型、研发模式、AI 功能与官方 MCP；国内团队常用它交付设计稿，研发模式里看组件与样式，智能体接 MasterGo Magic MCP。

name: JS Design (即时设计)
best_for: Domestic browser-based UI design tool with real-time collaboration, prototyping, developer annotations and Figma, Sketch and XD import
how_to_use: A common source-file home in Chinese teams; its community (jsdesign-community) holds UI kits
zh: 国产在线 UI 设计工具，多人实时协作、原型交互、开发标注，兼容 Figma、Sketch、XD 文件；国内团队常见的源文件所在地，资源广场另有 UI 套件。

name: Pixso
best_for: Domestic collaborative UI design and prototyping tool with in-canvas AI generation and a Pixso MCP that connects designs to code
how_to_use: Check which domestic tool the client team uses before handoff; connect Pixso MCP when the source files live here
zh: 国产协同 UI 设计与原型工具，画布内 AI 生成与优化设计稿，另有连接设计与代码的 Pixso MCP；交付前先确认对方用哪家国产工具。

name: Modao (墨刀)
best_for: Chinese prototyping and product-collaboration platform: interactive prototypes, whiteboard, UI design with design-to-code, and AI generation
how_to_use: Common for PM wireframes in China; treat its output as structure and flow, not as the visual design
zh: 国产原型与产研协作平台：交互原型、白板、带设计转代码的 UI 设计，以及 AI 生成；常见于产品经理的线框稿，把它当结构与流程参考，不当视觉设计。

name: Lanhu (蓝湖)
best_for: The dominant Chinese design-handoff platform: auto-generated spec annotations, slices, clickable prototypes and Axure hosting for engineers
how_to_use: Expect engineers in China to read specs here; upload from the design tool with consistent naming so annotations and slices stay usable
zh: 国内最主流的设计交付平台：自动生成标注、切图、可点击原型，并可在线展示 Axure；国内工程师多在这里看规范，从设计工具上传时命名要规范，标注与切图才好用。

name: Storybook
best_for: The standard workshop for building, documenting and testing UI components in isolation, with visual, interaction and accessibility tests
how_to_use: If the project has a Storybook, render new components as stories in every state before building screens; agents read storybook.js.org/llms.txt
zh: 在隔离环境里开发、记录与测试 UI 组件的行业标准工作台，支持视觉、交互与无障碍测试；项目里有 Storybook 就先把新组件的各个状态写成 story，再拼页面，MIT。

name: awesome-design-systems
best_for: Table of public design systems with links to components, voice and source
how_to_use: Find a system from a comparable domain, then read its component and voice pages
zh: 公开设计系统清单，附组件、文案语调与源码链接；找同类域的系统来对照。

name: design-resources-for-developers
best_for: Very large categorised list of design resources for developers
how_to_use: Breadth; verify quality yourself
zh: 面向开发者的超大型分类设计资源清单；胜在广，质量自己把关；MIT。

name: awesome-web-animation
best_for: Libraries, tools and articles on web animation
how_to_use: Find a specialised animation library
zh: 网页动画相关的库、工具与文章的精选清单；找某个专项动画库时从这里翻起；CC0。

name: awesome-creative-coding
best_for: Resources for generative art and creative coding
how_to_use: Starting point for generative graphics
zh: 生成艺术与创意编程的资源大清单，教程、工具、社区俱全；入门生成图形时当起点索引。

name: awesome-shadcn/ui
best_for: Index of shadcn-compatible component registries and themes
how_to_use: Find a registry before building a component
zh: shadcn 兼容组件注册表与主题的索引站，动手写组件前先查有没有人做过，MIT。

name: Awesome Design Tokens
best_for: Curated list of design-token tools, platforms, articles and talks
how_to_use: Scan before choosing a token pipeline (Figma sync, transformers, documentation) to see the options beside Style Dictionary and Terrazzo
zh: design token 相关工具、平台、文章与演讲的精选清单；选 token 流水线（Figma 同步、转换、文档）前先扫一遍，看看 Style Dictionary 与 Terrazzo 之外的选项。

name: Rauno Freiberg: Web Interface Guidelines
best_for: Non-obvious details that make web interfaces feel right: interactivity, typography, motion, touch, accessibility
how_to_use: Use as a polish checklist after the structure is sound
zh: Rauno 总结的网页界面细节清单：交互、字体、动效、触控、无障碍；结构理顺后当打磨核对表用。
caveats: Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines (listed under AI > agent skills) grew out of this list and is the maintained, agent-installable version

name: Invisible Details of Interaction Design
best_for: Essay on the reasoning behind great interactions: metaphors, kinetic physics, responsiveness, frequency and novelty
how_to_use: Read before designing any gesture
zh: Rauno 的交互设计随笔，讲隐喻、运动物理、响应速度与新鲜感背后的推理；设计任何手势前读。

name: Design Engineering at Vercel
best_for: What design engineers do and the standards they hold
how_to_use: Shared vocabulary for design-minded engineers
zh: Vercel 讲设计工程师做什么、持什么标准；给有设计感的工程师的共同语言。

name: How we redesigned the Linear UI
best_for: A disciplined product redesign: reduce, align, rebuild the theme system in LCH
how_to_use: Model for a redesign that keeps equity
zh: Linear 复盘自家界面改版：删繁、对齐、用 LCH 重建主题系统；想改版又保住品牌资产时参照。

name: Atomic Design
best_for: Brad Frost's free web book on building interface systems
how_to_use: Read chapter 2 for the mental model
zh: Brad Frost 的免费网络书，讲如何搭建界面体系；第二章的心智模型最值得一读。

name: Every Layout
best_for: Algorithmic CSS layout primitives that adapt without breakpoints
how_to_use: The rudiments are free; they change how responsive layout is specified
zh: 讲算法化 CSS 布局原语的书，不靠断点自适应；基础篇免费，会改变你写响应式的方式。

name: Ahmad Shadeed
best_for: Deep, visual CSS articles on layout, defensive CSS and RTL
how_to_use: Look up the component you are about to build
zh: Ahmad Shadeed 的深度图解 CSS 博客，讲布局、防御性 CSS 与 RTL；做组件前先查有没有对应文章。

name: Defensive CSS
best_for: Patterns that keep layouts from breaking with real content
how_to_use: Checklist for long text, missing images, overflow
zh: 防御性 CSS 模式集：长文本、缺图、溢出等真实内容下的不翻车写法；上线前当清单查。

name: Maggie Appleton
best_for: Illustrated essays on language-model interfaces and tools for thought
how_to_use: Perspective for AI product concepts
zh: 关于语言模型界面与思维工具的插画式长文；给 AI 产品概念找视角。

name: userinterface.wiki
best_for: Raphael Salaja's living manual of interface craft, from animation principles to modern web APIs, with demos and an agent skill
how_to_use: Read the entry for the interaction you are about to build; open it in a browser, the site is JS-rendered
zh: Raphael Salaja 维护的界面工艺活手册：从动画原则到现代 Web API，附演示与智能体技能；实现交互细节前先读对应条目。
caveats: JavaScript-rendered: plain fetches get only the navigation

name: Jhey Tompkins
best_for: Inventive CSS and interaction demos with explanations, often the first to use new platform features
how_to_use: Search his demos before building a scroll, hover or anchor-positioning effect
zh: Jhey Tompkins 的创意 CSS 与交互演示及讲解，常率先用上新平台特性；做滚动、悬停、锚点定位效果前先搜他的演示。

name: Adam Argyle (nerdy.dev)
best_for: CSS and UI craft from the author of Open Props and the GUI Challenges series
how_to_use: Use the GUI Challenges posts for accessible, modern implementations of common components
zh: Open Props 作者 Adam Argyle 的 CSS 与 UI 工艺博客，GUI Challenges 系列尤佳；常见组件的现代、无障碍实现参考。

name: Smashing Magazine
best_for: Long-running practitioner magazine on UX, CSS, accessibility and design systems
how_to_use: Browse /category/<ux-design|css|accessibility> or search a pattern name; articles are long, practical and dated
zh: 老牌从业者杂志，涵盖 UX、CSS、无障碍与设计系统；按分类或模式名搜深度实践文章，注意发表日期。

name: Baseline and Web Platform Status
best_for: Baseline labels (newly or widely available) for web platform features; webstatus.dev and its JSON API give each feature's status and dates
how_to_use: Before a design depends on popover, anchor positioning or view transitions, query webstatus.dev or its API for the feature's Baseline status
zh: web.dev 的 Baseline 可用性标签（新近可用 / 广泛可用）；webstatus.dev 及其 JSON API 给出每个特性的状态与日期，设计依赖新特性前先查。
zh_how: 要用 popover、锚点定位、视图过渡等新特性前，查 webstatus.dev 或调 API（q=name:popover）看它是否已 Baseline。

name: Improving frontend design through Skills
best_for: Anthropic on why models converge on generic design (distributional convergence), which prompt axes move output (typography, themes, motion, backgrounds) and a ~400-token aesthetics prompt; published 2025-11-12
how_to_use: Read with the current skill: several remedies it recommended in 2025 are flagged as tells by 2026 detectors
zh: Anthropic 分析模型为何产出千篇一律的设计、哪些提示词轴向有效；注意部分旧解法如今已成破绽。

name: Prompting for frontend aesthetics
best_for: Cookbook showing which prompt levers change front-end aesthetics (typography, themes, motion, backgrounds)
how_to_use: Evidence for which instructions actually move output
zh: Anthropic 的食谱笔记，实测哪些提示词杠杆能改变前端美学（字体、主题、动效、背景）。

name: Design for the AI age
best_for: Linear's view on designing software where AI agents are users and collaborators
how_to_use: Framing for AI-product briefs
zh: Linear 谈"AI 是用户也是协作者"时代的软件设计；接 AI 产品 brief 前用它校准框架。

name: AI and design systems
best_for: How design systems become the constraint layer for AI-generated UI
how_to_use: Argument for investing in tokens before generation
zh: 论述设计系统如何成为 AI 生成界面的约束层；是先投 token 再谈生成的论据。

name: Why Chatbots Are Not the Future of Interfaces
best_for: Amelia Wattenberger's illustrated essay on why a text box is a poor default interface for language models, and what to design instead
how_to_use: Read before defaulting an AI feature to a chat panel; use it to argue for inline, contextual controls
zh: Amelia Wattenberger 的图解长文：为什么输入框不是大模型的好默认界面、该设计什么替代；AI 功能默认做聊天框之前读。

name: Malleable software (Ink & Switch)
best_for: Ink & Switch's essay on restoring user agency in locked-down apps, and how AI changes who can reshape software
how_to_use: Read when a brief proposes generated or user-customisable UI; use it to decide what users should be able to reshape
zh: Ink & Switch 的长文：在封闭应用时代把改造软件的能力还给用户，以及 AI 如何改变谁能塑造软件；做生成式或可定制界面前读。

name: Visual design rules you can safely follow every time
best_for: A plain list of visual design rules with brief explanations
how_to_use: Use as a lint list for a finished screen
zh: 一份朴素但每次都可安全遵守的视觉设计规则清单，附简短解释；完稿后当检查表逐条过。

name: Laws of UX
best_for: The perception and cognition principles designers cite (Fitts, Hick, Jakob, Miller, proximity, peak-end...) with sources
how_to_use: Match the scenario to a law, then cite its takeaways and origin; each law page lists sources
zh: 设计师常引用的感知与认知定律合集（Fitts、Hick、Jakob、Miller 等），附出处；给决策找依据时报定律名。

name: Refactoring UI
best_for: Tactical UI design book for developers by the Tailwind authors
how_to_use: Start with the free Medium article (entry point), then the chapters on hierarchy, spacing and colour; the single best purchase for an engineer who designs
zh: Tailwind 作者写给开发者的 UI 设计战术书，付费；先读免费的“7 个作弊技巧”文章，再读层级、间距、配色章节。

entry_points.label: Free article: 7 practical tips for cheating at design (Medium)

caveats: Medium blocks scripts (403) on the free article

name: 7 Rules for Creating Gorgeous UI
best_for: Erik Kennedy's rules: light comes from the sky, black and white first, double your whitespace
how_to_use: Run the seven rules (light from the sky, black and white first, double the whitespace, text over images…) as a quick pass on a finished screen
zh: Erik Kennedy 的七条 UI 法则：光从天上来、先用黑白、留白翻倍；适合当自查清单。

name: Gestalt principles
best_for: Overview of the grouping principles behind layout decisions
how_to_use: Reference when explaining grouping choices
zh: 格式塔分组原则的入门综述；向人解释布局分组决策时引用它。

name: Dieter Rams: ten principles for good design
best_for: The ten principles, from the source
how_to_use: A yardstick for restraint
zh: Dieter Rams 好设计十原则的原始出处；需要一把克制与功能的标尺时回来对照。

name: The Web's Grain
best_for: Frank Chimero on designing with the nature of the web instead of against it
how_to_use: Read when a layout fights the medium
zh: Frank Chimero 谈顺着网页媒介的本性去设计，而不是对抗它；版式跟媒介较劲时读。

name: Magic Ink
best_for: Bret Victor's argument that most software is information design, not interaction design
how_to_use: Reframe dashboards and tools as graphics to be read
zh: Bret Victor 的长文，主张多数软件本质是信息设计而非交互设计；做仪表盘时换成「被阅读的图形」视角。

name: Practical UI
best_for: Adham Dannaway's rule-based book and Figma kit for logical, accessible interface design
how_to_use: Adopt its explicit rules (spacing, hierarchy, contrast) as a critique checklist
zh: Adham Dannaway 基于规则的界面设计书与 Figma 套件，逻辑清晰、兼顾无障碍；把它的明确规则当评审清单，付费。

name: NN/g: 10 usability heuristics
best_for: The standard heuristic-evaluation framework
how_to_use: Tag critique findings with the heuristic violated
zh: NN/g 的十大可用性启发式，启发式评估的标准框架；给评审发现打标签就按违犯的是哪条来。

name: Nielsen Norman Group articles
best_for: Decades of research-based UX guidance
how_to_use: Search before asserting a usability claim
zh: Nielsen Norman Group 几十年来基于研究的 UX 文章库；要下任何可用性断言之前先来这里搜一遍。

name: Baymard Institute
best_for: Large-scale e-commerce and form usability research; articles free, full database paid
how_to_use: Check before designing checkout, search, filters or forms
zh: 电商与表单可用性的大样本研究机构；做结账、搜索、筛选或表单前查结论，文章免费、库付费。

name: NN/g: response time limits
best_for: The 0.1 s, 1 s and 10 s limits that govern feedback design
how_to_use: Cite for loading-state decisions
zh: 0.1 秒、1 秒、10 秒三条响应时限，决定反馈设计；做加载态与骨架屏决策时引用。

name: Growth.Design case studies
best_for: Product UX teardowns told as comics, tied to psychology principles
how_to_use: Read the teardown of a comparable flow; agents append /markdown to any case-study URL for clean text
zh: 用漫画形式拆解产品 UX，逐条挂心理学原理；做某类流程前找对应案例读。

name: LukeW
best_for: Luke Wroblewski's notes on forms, mobile and input design with data
how_to_use: Search for form-design evidence
zh: Luke Wroblewski 的随笔站，表单、移动端与输入设计居多且带数据；给表单方案找证据时搜这里。

name: GOV.UK design principles
best_for: Ten principles for user-centred services
how_to_use: Start with user needs; do the hard work to make it simple
zh: 英国政府的十条服务设计原则，'从用户需求出发''下功夫让它简单'都出自这里。

name: UX Myths
best_for: Common UX misconceptions with research that refutes them
how_to_use: Settle arguments such as the three-click rule
zh: 常见 UX 误解合集，每条附反驳的研究证据；争论三次点击规则之类时拿来定胜负。

name: Built for Mars
best_for: Peter Ramsey's step-by-step UX case studies of real products (onboarding, banking, checkout) plus 1,400+ UX examples
how_to_use: Read the case study for the flow you are designing; feeds exist for case studies and UX Bites
zh: 逐步拆解真实产品的 UX 案例（注册引导、银行、结账），另有 1400+ 条 UX 小例；设计某个流程前读对应案例。

name: MeasuringU
best_for: Quantitative UX research: benchmarks, SUS and sample sizes explained with data
how_to_use: Use when a claim needs numbers rather than opinion (task time, SUS norms, how many users to test)
zh: 定量 UX 研究：基准、SUS 与样本量，用数据讲清楚；需要数字而不是观点时查。
caveats: Article pages sit behind a SiteGround bot check for scripts

name: NN/g: Design critiques
best_for: How to run and participate in useful critiques
how_to_use: Structure for critique sessions
zh: NN/g 讲如何组织和参与真正有用的设计评审；要给团队评审会立规矩时读。

name: Design critiques at Figma
best_for: Several critique formats and when each works
how_to_use: Pick a format for the feedback needed
zh: Figma 介绍内部几种设计评审形式及各自适用场景；按想要的反馈类型挑一种来组织评审。

name: Nine rules for running productive design critiques
best_for: Jake Knapp's concise critique ground rules from GV: the designer owns the work, everyone else helps
how_to_use: Share before a critique
zh: GV 的 Jake Knapp 总结的设计评审九条规则：设计师是负责人，其他人是来帮忙的；开评审会前发给与会者对齐预期。
caveats: library.gv.com (Medium) was unreachable from our probe network on 2026-09-27; confirm in a browser

name: 13 ways designers screw up client presentations
best_for: Mike Monteiro on presenting design work with authority
how_to_use: Read before presenting options
zh: Mike Monteiro 讲设计师向客户提案的 13 个翻车点；给客户讲方案之前读一遍。
caveats: Medium blocks scripts (403)

name: Articulating Design Decisions
best_for: Tom Greever's book on explaining and defending design decisions
how_to_use: The method behind rationale sections
zh: Tom Greever 讲如何向干系人解释与捍卫设计决策的书；写设计理由的方法论来源。

name: Shape Up
best_for: Basecamp's free book: shaping work, breadboarding and fat-marker sketches
how_to_use: Use breadboards to settle flow before visuals
zh: Basecamp 的免费书，讲 shaping、面包板图和粗马克笔草图；先定流程再画视觉时按它做。

name: The Dribbblisation of Design
best_for: The classic critique of surface-first design and the four layers of product design
how_to_use: Antidote to styling before understanding
zh: 批评“表面先行”设计的经典文章，提出产品设计四层次；没搞懂就 styling 的解药。

name: Don't Make Me Think
best_for: Steve Krug's short classic on web usability
how_to_use: First usability book to read
zh: Steve Krug 的可用性小书，第一本该读的可用性经典；付费。

name: The Design of Everyday Things
best_for: Don Norman on affordances, signifiers, mapping and feedback
how_to_use: The vocabulary of interaction design
zh: Don Norman 的设计经典，affordance、signifier、映射与反馈这套词汇的出处；做交互设计绕不开的一本，付费。

name: Grid Systems in Graphic Design
best_for: Mueller-Brockmann's definitive manual on grids
how_to_use: Reference for poster, editorial and deck layout
zh: Mueller-Brockmann 的网格系统圣经；做海报、编辑版式和幻灯片排版时的案头参照。

name: The Elements of Typographic Style
best_for: Robert Bringhurst's reference on proportion, rhythm, spacing and the details of Latin typesetting (v4.0)
how_to_use: Consult the chapters on rhythm and proportion (measure, leading) and on the page before inventing a rule; the link is Typographica's review, the book is in print from Hartley & Marks
zh: Bringhurst 的排印经典（第 4 版），比例、节奏、间距与西文排版细节的出处；定规则前先查它，付费书。

name: Interaction of Color
best_for: Albers on how colours change each other
how_to_use: Why a colour looks wrong in context
zh: Albers 讲颜色如何互相改变的经典；某个颜色放进版面就变味时，答案在这里。付费书。

name: Designing Interface Animation
best_for: Val Head's book on purposeful UI animation
how_to_use: Depth on motion in design systems
zh: Val Head 讲有目的的界面动效的书，关于设计系统中动效的深度读物；付费。
caveats: Publisher site blocks scripts (403)

name: Microcopy: The Complete Guide
best_for: Kinneret Yifrah's guide to interface words
how_to_use: Reference for error, empty-state and button copy
zh: Kinneret Yifrah 写的界面文案指南；写报错提示、空状态和按钮文案时翻它准没错。

name: Form Design Patterns
best_for: Adam Silver's inclusive form patterns
how_to_use: Before designing any complex form
zh: Adam Silver 的包容性表单设计模式书；动手设计任何复杂表单之前先读；付费。

name: Smart Interface Design Patterns
best_for: Vitaly Friedman's video course and checklists on complex UI patterns
how_to_use: Tables, filters, navigation, forms at depth
zh: Vitaly Friedman 的复杂界面模式视频课与清单；表格、筛选、导航、表单往深挖时看。付费。

name: Learn UI Design
best_for: Erik Kennedy's comprehensive visual UI course
how_to_use: For engineers building real visual skill
zh: Erik Kennedy 的系统化视觉 UI 课，覆盖面完整；工程师想练真视觉功夫的付费课程。

name: Shift Nudge
best_for: Matt D. Smith's interface design course
how_to_use: Alternative with strong typography and layout modules
zh: Matt D. Smith 的界面设计课程，字体与版面模块尤其扎实；系统补视觉功底的付费课。

name: CSS for JavaScript Developers
best_for: Josh Comeau's course that builds a real mental model of CSS
how_to_use: When layout bugs block design fidelity
zh: Josh Comeau 的 CSS 课，专为 JS 开发者建立真正的 CSS 心智模型；布局 bug 挡住设计还原度时报它，付费。

name: web.dev: Learn Responsive Design
best_for: Free course on modern responsive design techniques
how_to_use: Container queries, fluid type, theming
zh: web.dev 的免费响应式设计课程：容器查询、流式字体、主题化；把设计落地前端前补一遍。

name: Google UX Design Certificate
best_for: Structured introduction to the UX process
how_to_use: Process fundamentals for newcomers
zh: Coursera 上的结构化 UX 流程入门课；很适合给新人系统打流程基础；付费。

name: Build UI
best_for: Courses and recipes on building polished interactive UI in React and Motion
how_to_use: Use /recipes as reference implementations for interaction details
zh: 用 React 与 Motion 构建精致交互界面的课程与配方；/recipes 可当交互细节的参考实现。

name: 优设网
best_for: The largest Chinese design learning site: tutorials, trend reports, tool news
how_to_use: Search a topic in Chinese; quality varies by author
zh: 国内最大的设计学习站，教程、趋势报告、工具资讯都有；中文搜主题方便，质量随作者参差。

name: 腾讯 ISUX
best_for: Tencent's social UX team writes up real product and brand design cases
how_to_use: Case studies of mass-market Chinese products
zh: 腾讯社交 UX 团队的博客，复盘真实产品与品牌设计案例；看国内大众产品的设计打法。

name: 腾讯 CDC
best_for: Tencent's customer research and design centre
how_to_use: User-research and enterprise-product perspective
zh: 腾讯用户研究与体验设计中心的博客；看国内大厂如何做用研与企业级产品设计。

name: 阿里巴巴设计
best_for: Alibaba Design's D20 summit site: talks and case write-ups from Alibaba's design teams
how_to_use: Use the talks for commerce and enterprise design at scale; Alibaba Design's free 3D and AI assets live on 堆友 (d.design)
zh: 阿里巴巴设计 D20 峰会站，收录各设计团队的分享与案例；看超大业务量下的电商与企业级设计方法。
caveats: JavaScript app; the old team-blog content is no longer the front page

name: Ant Design 语雀专栏
best_for: Long-form writing from the Ant Design team on enterprise product design
how_to_use: Depth behind Ant Design's patterns
zh: Ant Design 团队关于企业级产品设计的长文专栏；想理解 Ant 模式背后的深度读这里。

name: 少数派
best_for: Chinese publication on apps, tools and digital craft
how_to_use: App reviews reveal what Chinese power users value
zh: 中文应用、工具与数字生活媒体；从应用评测看国内重度用户在意什么。

name: UXRen
best_for: Chinese UX community with translations of international articles
how_to_use: Find Chinese translations of canonical articles
zh: 中文 UX 社区，译介国外经典文章较多；找某篇国外 UX 名篇的中译版时先来搜。

name: Woshipm (人人都是产品经理)
best_for: The largest Chinese product-management community, with many UX, interaction and industry teardown articles
how_to_use: Search Chinese product patterns and teardowns; the 产品设计 channel (/category/pd) is the most relevant; quality varies
zh: 人人都是产品经理：国内最大的产品经理社区，有大量交互、体验与行业拆解文章；看“产品设计”频道，质量参差。

name: Juejin (稀土掘金)
best_for: The largest Chinese developer community; its front-end channel covers CSS, animation, component libraries and design-to-code practice
how_to_use: Search in Chinese for how domestic teams implement a pattern (Taro, mini-programs, ECharts); quality varies by author
zh: 稀土掘金：国内最大的开发者社区，前端频道覆盖 CSS、动效、组件库与设计还原实践；中文搜国内团队的实现方式，质量随作者参差。

name: Dribbble
best_for: Designer community of shots; strong for visual styling ideas
how_to_use: Use for visual treatment ideas only; verify against real products
zh: 设计师晒 shots 的社区，视觉样式强、真实感弱；只取视觉处理灵感，拿真产品验证。
caveats: Concept shots ignore real content, states and accessibility
Plain fetches get an empty 202 shell

name: Behance
best_for: Full project case studies across branding, illustration, UI and motion
how_to_use: Search by field and tool; read the process, not just the cover
zh: 全领域设计案例社区，品牌、插画、UI、动效都有完整项目；按领域与工具搜，看过程别只看封面。
caveats: Blocks scripts (403) as of 2026-09-27

name: Layers
best_for: Smaller, higher-signal community for product designers
how_to_use: Find working designers' real projects
zh: 规模较小、信噪比高的产品设计师社区，能看到在职设计师的真实项目而非作品集包装。

name: Figma Community
best_for: Shared design files, UI kits and plugins, including many Chinese design-system kits
how_to_use: Inspect how a system is constructed, not just how it looks
zh: Figma 社区的文件、UI kit 与插件库，含大量中文设计系统套件；看系统怎么搭而非只看外表；许可逐文件定。

name: ArtStation
best_for: The main portfolio community for illustration, concept art, 3D and game art; strong for art direction outside UI
how_to_use: Search by medium and subject for illustration and 3D styles; credit artists and never lift work
zh: 插画、概念设计、3D 与游戏美术的主力作品集社区；找 UI 之外的美术风格参考，引用要署名，绝不挪用。
caveats: Cloudflare challenge for scripts (403, 2026-09-27)
Artwork is the artists' copyright; many opt out of AI training with the NoAI tag

name: Are.na
best_for: Designer-run research boards with unusually thoughtful curation
how_to_use: Search channels for a concept and follow the people who built good ones; agents query the public search API for channels and blocks
zh: 设计师经营的研究图板社区，策展异常用心；按频道搜概念，来源常在设计圈之外。
zh_how: 按概念搜频道，顺着好频道找到策展的人；智能体调公开搜索 API（/v2/search/channels?q=）拿频道与内容块。

name: Pinterest
best_for: Visual search engine for moodboarding across every discipline
how_to_use: Use visual search on a reference image to find relatives
zh: 跨全学科的视觉搜索引擎，情绪板主力；拿参考图做以图搜图找同类。

name: Cosmos
best_for: Ad-free visual bookmarking for creatives with strong aesthetic curation
how_to_use: Follow clusters for art-direction references
zh: 无广告的视觉收藏夹社区，策展审美在线；建情绪板、找艺术指导参考时关注合辑。

name: Savee
best_for: Bookmarking feed used by graphic and art directors
how_to_use: Collect art-direction references into boards; members can connect the read-only MCP so an agent searches their saves and the public library
zh: 平面设计师与美术指导爱用的图片收藏流；做情绪板时找宽泛的 art direction 灵感。
caveats: The MCP and REST API act for a signed-in member (free tier exists) and are read-only

name: Same Energy
best_for: Visual search engine that finds images with the same feel
how_to_use: Start with one image, explore its neighbours
zh: 以图搜图的视觉搜索引擎，专找「感觉一样」的图；拼情绪版时从一张图出发逛它的邻居。

name: Designspiration
best_for: Inspiration search by keyword and colour
how_to_use: Find references matching a palette
zh: 按关键词和颜色搜灵感图的网站，给情绪板找与色板匹配的参考图时用。

name: Eagle
best_for: Local asset manager for collecting and tagging references
how_to_use: Personal reference library
zh: 本地素材管理器，收集参考图并打标签管理；建个人灵感库用；付费。

name: PureRef
best_for: Lightweight reference-board app
how_to_use: Keep references visible while working
zh: 轻量的参考图板应用；干活时把参考图一直钉在屏幕旁边看。

name: Sidebar
best_for: Five hand-picked design links a day: a low-noise daily reading feed
how_to_use: Subscribe by email or RSS and skim daily; save what matters, ignore the rest
zh: 每天只推五条精选设计链接的订阅源；低噪音的日常设计阅读。

name: Dense Discovery
best_for: Thoughtful weekly newsletter across design, tech and culture
how_to_use: Breadth beyond the UI bubble
zh: 每周一期的精选 newsletter，横跨设计、科技与文化；用来跳出 UI 圈子换换脑子。
caveats: SiteGround bot check blocks scripts

name: TLDR Design
best_for: Daily design and tooling news digest
how_to_use: Skim the daily email or /design/archives for tool releases and product updates
zh: 每日设计与工具新闻摘要邮件，跟新工具发布和行业动态用的轻量信息源。

name: Muzli
best_for: Aggregated inspiration feed
how_to_use: Install the browser extension for a new-tab feed, or browse /inspiration/ collections; high volume, mixed quality
zh: 聚合式的设计灵感订阅流；量大质杂，只适合当日常背景输入。

name: Design Compass (디자인 나침반)
best_for: Korean design news covering local design systems, rebrands and tools
how_to_use: Follow for the Korean design scene (KRDS, Toss, Kakao); an English edition lives at /en/
zh: 韩国设计资讯（디자인 나침반），关注本地设计系统、品牌升级与工具；了解韩国设计动态（KRDS、Toss、Kakao），有英文版。

name: 站酷 ZCOOL
best_for: The largest Chinese designer community across every discipline
how_to_use: Search in Chinese by category; the domestic equivalent of Behance
zh: 国内最大的设计师社区，覆盖各设计门类；按分类中文检索，地位相当于本土版 Behance。

name: 花瓣
best_for: Chinese Pinterest-style image collecting
how_to_use: Moodboards with Chinese-market references
zh: 国内的 Pinterest 式图片收藏社区，画板即情绪板；找中国市场的视觉参考时用。

name: UI中国
best_for: Chinese UI designer community: app and web UI portfolios, UI kits and job posts
how_to_use: Search by category for domestic app and web UI work; check dates, many kits are old
zh: 国内 UI 设计师社区，作品与招聘信息集中；了解本土 UI 风向和同行作品集的地方。
caveats: Blocks scripts (403) and times out from outside mainland China

name: 优设导航
best_for: The most complete Chinese design-site directory; contains promoted links
how_to_use: Locate Chinese tools and asset sites
zh: 国内最全的设计网站导航，找中文工具与素材站从这入手；注意其中含推广链接。

name: 即时设计资源广场
best_for: Chinese design tool with a large shared-resource community
how_to_use: Domestic UI kits for Ant Design, TDesign, HarmonyOS
zh: 即时设计国内的资源共享社区；找 Ant Design、TDesign、HarmonyOS 的国产 UI kit；授权以各文件为准。

name: Figma.Cool (Figma 中文社区)
best_for: Chinese Figma community with localisation, plugin and component-kit guides
how_to_use: Use to find Chinese-language Figma resources, plugins and localisation help for domestic teams
zh: Figma 中文社区，提供汉化、插件与组件库教程；给国内团队找中文 Figma 资源与汉化帮助。

name: AI Tools Directory (AI工具集)
best_for: Large Chinese directory of 1,000+ AI tools, including domestic design, image and video generators
how_to_use: Use to discover current domestic AI design tools; verify each tool before recommending it
zh: AI 工具集：收录 1000+ 工具的中文 AI 导航，含国产设计、图像与视频生成工具；用来发现新工具，推荐前逐个核实。
caveats: Contains promoted listings

name: Xiaohongshu (小红书)
best_for: The lifestyle platform where Chinese designers and brands post moodboards, case notes and visual trends
how_to_use: Search design keywords in Chinese (海报排版, 品牌升级, UI 灵感) to see what the domestic audience responds to right now
zh: 国内设计师与品牌晒灵感板、案例笔记和视觉趋势的主阵地；用中文关键词搜，看国内受众当下买账的风格。
zh_how: 搜“海报排版”“品牌升级”“UI 灵感”等关键词，按最热与最新各看一轮；把它当趋势信号，不当质量标准。
caveats: Redirects to a login wall: not agent-readable
Engagement-ranked feed: a trend signal, not a quality filter
